first_line_orig: بسم الله المتکبر المتجبر. تبارک الذی بیده الملک یبدع ما یشاء بامره کن فیکون لله الامر
subjects: @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @trust and reliance in God; turning to Him at all times, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @prayer for protection, @absolute freedom; independence of God

first_line: Blessed be He unto whom bow down in adoration all that dwell in the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and verily God hath ever been supremely great [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله المتقدس المتقدر. تبارک الذی یسجد له من فی السموات و الارض و ما بینهما و کان الله عظیما عظیما

first_line: Glorified be He Who hath sent down the Book wherein lieth guidance and remembrance for a people who hearken. Verily We, even We, have revealed the Book of Justice containing Our decrees for those who act [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله العلی العظیم. سبحان الذى نزل الکتاب فیه هدى و ذکرى لقوم یسمعون و انا نحن نزلنا کتاب العدل فیه حکم من لدنا لقوم یعملون
subjects: @free will and predestination; fate, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @justice and wrath of God, @Word of God is its own standard, @tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering

title: Prayer for the hajj, for Mirza Muhammad 'Ali Qazvini
first_line: I bear witness that there is no God but Him, and I testify unto Muhammad and 'Alí and Fá?imih and ?asan and ?usayn and 'Alí and Muhammad and Ja'far [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. اشهد ان لا اله الا هو و اشهد لمحمد و علی و فاطمه و الحسن و الحسین و علی و محمد و جعفر
subjects: @family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam, @the Imamate; the Caliphate, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @chastisement and requital, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

title: Hirz fi's-sijn li-Siyyid Hasan
first_line: Praise be to God Who hath brought into being, through His command, whatsoever is in the heavens and on the earth, and beyond them they who have believed in God and His signs - these verily shall be brought into His presence. They that have believed and persevered in the days of God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. الحمد لله الذی ابدع ما فی السموات و ما فی الارض بامره ثم الذین آمنوا بالله و آیاته اولئک هم علی الله یعرضون و ان الذین امنوا ثم صبروا فی ایام الله
subjects: @suffering and imprisonment, @steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness, @prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause, @high station of the true believer

first_line: Follow thou the command of God in this hour, and fear not. Dwell thou in the shelter of security, for verily We are thy Protector. Be patient and grieve not, for verily We are thy Witness [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسمه العلی العظیم. ان اتبع حکم الله فی الحین و لا تخف و اسکن بیت الامن فانا کنا علیکم حافظون ان اصبر و لا تجزع فانا کنا علیکم شاهدون
subjects: @contention and conflict, @chastisement and requital, @consolation and comfort, @rejection, opposition and persecution, @rejection of Muhammad, @trust and reliance in God; turning to Him at all times

title: Letter to Haji Mirza Hasan 'Ali, Khal-i-Asghar, in Masqat
first_line: May it be submitted unto your honored presence that, shouldst thou graciously inquire after this lowly one's condition, praise be unto God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بعرض عالی میرساند که هرگاه از طریق مرحمت جویای حال حقیر باشید لله الحمد و المنة
subjects: @prayer for specific individuals; groups, @law of pilgrimage, @Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc., @Shaykhis

title: Letter to Khal-i-Asghar I
first_line: Now, at the time of writing, it is the Most Great Festival. Praise be unto God, even as He loveth and is well-pleased... let them be sent unto Shiraz that they may become apprised of the mention of the tradition [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو الله المتکبر العزیز المستعان. حال تحریر یوم عید اکبر است الحمد لله کما هو یحب و یرضی ... جهة شیراز فرستاده باشند که مطلع از ذکر حدیث شوند
subjects: @business; financial; property matters

title: Khutbata'l-Baladiyya
first_line: Praise be to God Who standeth alone in grandeur and is singular in His bestowals, Who hath raised up the heavens unto the celestial realm and hath brought forth resplendent light [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. الحمد لله المتوحد فی الکبریاء والمتفرد فی الآلاء الذی قد ارفع السماء للعماء و قد انشأ السناء للذرالبقاء
subjects: @transcendence; unknowability of God, @prayer for spiritual recognition

first_line: God, no God is there but Him, the All-Healing, the All-Healing! Say: God is the Supreme Healer, transcending all healing, and none can resist His sovereign might [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الاشفی الاشفی. الله لا اله الا هو الاشفی الاشفی قل الله اشفی فوق ذااشفآء لن یقدر ان یمتنع عن ملیک سلطانه
subjects: @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @health and healing; material and spiritual healing, @transcendence; unknowability of God

first_line: Glorified be He before Whom bow down in adoration all who dwell in the heavens and on the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, for He is the Creator, the Incomparable [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحان الذی یسجد له من فی السموات و من فی الأرض و ما بینهما و انه لهو المبدع المنیع
subjects: @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @absolute freedom; independence of God, @God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih], @forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God

first_line: Glorified be He before Whom bow down in adoration whatsoever is in the heavens and on earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and verily He is the Mighty, the All-Wise. We have indeed known that which was sent down in the Book, and We were truly among those who bore witness [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو الاکبر الارفع الاظهر الامنع الاعلی. سبحان الذی یسجد له من فی السموات و الارض و ما بینهما و انه لهو العزیز الحکیم و لقد علمنا مانزل فی الکتاب و انا کنا شاهدین و ان ما قد فصل

first_line: Be assured that in the state of slumber, the soul's condition is akin to that of the sun in its station; though it has not departed from the body, yet through its light, the realms of the celestial kingdom are beheld [4o]
first_line_orig: فایقن ان فی النوم مثل الروح مثل الشمس فی مقامها لم یخرج من الجسم بل بنوره یشاهد ملکوت السموات
subjects: @soul; spirit after death, @meaning; importance of dreams and visions, @transience; worthlessness of the physical world

first_line: Glorified be He Who hath sent down the Command in this Hour according to an established decree. Verily, there hath been sent down this Day that which was expounded unto Us, and We, verily, are witnesses unto all things. And at daybreak did We send down a Book unto him who formerly affirmed the Cause of thy Lord [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسمه العلی العظیم. سبحان الذى نزل الامر فى الحین على امر مستقر و لقد نزل الیوم ما فصلت الینا و انا نحن لکل شاهدون و ان الصبح نزلنا کتابا الى الذى صدق امر ربک من قبل
subjects: @exhortations and counsels, @trust and reliance in God; turning to Him at all times, @wisdom [hikmat], @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

first_line: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name—O Thou Who art the Alif of the Father, and the Bá of the Bayán, and the Tá of the All-Forgiving [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله النصار. سبحانک اللهم انی اسئلک باسمک یا لالف الاب و باء البیان و تاء التواب
subjects: @meanings of letters and numbers; jafr (gematria), @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @justice and wrath of God

title: Answer to Mirza Ahmad-i-Azghandi
first_line: Glorified be He before Whom bow down in adoration all who dwell in the heavens and all who dwell upon the earth. Say: all are prostrate before Him. And praise be unto God, Whom all who dwell in the heavens and all who dwell upon the earth do glorify; say: all are humbly obedient unto Him [3.5s]... ...As the Persian children say, the root principles of religion are five and its derivatives six. This indeed is thy Temple
first_line_orig: بسم الله الامنع الاقدس. سبحان الذی یسجد له من فی السموات و من فی الارض قل کل له ساجدون و الحمد لله الذی یسبح له من فی السموات و من فی الارض قل کل له قانتون شهد الله

title: Ziyarat for the ten letters
first_line: Verily all glory from God, and from all them that have believed in God and His signs, be upon you, O ye Letters [3.5s]
first_line_orig: انما البهاء من الله ثم من کل من آمن بالله و آیاته علیکم یا ایتها الحروف

title: Ziyarat for the first [to believe]
first_line: If, on that day, thou art in the presence of Him Whom God shall make manifest, then shall He suffice thee before God for all mention and praise. But if thou findest thyself in the night.. [4o]
first_line_orig: فاذا کنت مثل ذلک الیوم عند من یظهره الله فاذا لیکفینک بین یدی الله عن کل ذکر و ثناء و لکن اذا کنت فی اللیل

title: Answer to Mirza Sulayman
first_line: In the Name of Him Who is the Most Exalted, the Most High, Whom God hath made to be obeyed and honored, endued with majesty [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسمه العلی الاعلی. بسمه العلی الاعلی الذی جعله الله عنده مطاعا مکر ما دام مجدا جعلت
subjects: @trust and reliance in God; turning to Him at all times, @fellowship with the wayward and ungodly, @tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering, @the Word of God; influence and centrality of, @rejection, opposition and persecution, @steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness

title: Letter concerning the Nubuwwat al-Khassa
first_line: It is with sanctity that the heart of Khalil is uplifted, as it hath been alluded in the divine Book, with the loftiest gems of truths and the most resplendent forms of devotion. For whatsoever appears with radiance and becomes manifest in the horizons, are indeed the signs of those who abide by the Covenant and the qualities of the people of unity [4o]
first_line_orig: هو العزیز. تقدس فؤاد خلیلی بان اشیر الله فی الکتاب باعلی جوهریات الحقائق و اجلی عبادات الرقایق لان کلما یلوح بالاشراق و یظهر فی الآفاق من اشارات اهل المیثاق و شئونات اهل الوفاق
subjects: @wisdom [hikmat], @celestial spheres [aflak]; planets; astronomy, @mystical themes, @divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity

first_line: This is God, your Lord; His is the creation and the command. There is no God but Him, the Mighty, the Best-Beloved. He it is Who giveth life and bringeth death [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الامنع الاقدس. ذلکم الله ربکم له الخلق و الامر لا اله الا هو العزیز المحبوب هو الذی یحی و یمیت

title: Letter to Haji Mirza Siyyid 'Ali, Khal-i-A'zam, from Kinar Takht
first_line: It is submitted that on Wednesday night, the nineteenth, We departed from the port of Bushihr in the company of Akbar, who was bound for his native land [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو قبله گاها. معروض مى دارد که شب چهارشنبه نوزدهم ازبندر بوشهرحرکت نموده به اتفاق اکبر که وارد بلد وطن باشد

first_line: O Thou my God! Thou art the Adored One, the Lord of beneficence and bounty. Thou art the Beloved Lord, the Possessor of all things visible and invisible [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. اللهم انت الله المعبود مالک الخیر و الجود و انت الرب المودود واجد کل موجود و مفقود
subjects: @Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc., @the Imamate; the Caliphate

title: Letter concerning the Nubuwwat al-Khassa
first_line: Praise and glory befit that Most Sacred Being, Who from time immemorial hath existed through the reality of His own Most Holy Essence, and in Whose sanctuary of sanctity no created thing hath ever been mentioned beside Him, and Who will [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو العزیز. حمد و ثناء ذات اقدسی را سزاوار است که لم یزل بوجود کینونیت ذات اقدس خود بوده وموجودی در ساحت قدس او با او مذکور نبوده و لایزال
subjects: @petitions to authorities, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

title: Letter to Mulla Husayn II (from Mukha)
first_line: Glorified be He Who hath caused the Spirit to descend upon thy heart, that thou mayest be numbered among the warners. Follow thou what is revealed unto thee from this glorious Book, for verily We did send it aforetime unto thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. سبحان الذی قد نزل الروح علی قلبک لتکونن من المنذرین ان اتبع مایلقی الیک من کتاب کریم و لقد ارسلنا من قبل الیک
subjects: @personal instructions, @justice and wrath of God, @the divine emanation; the all-pervading bounty of God, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @trust and reliance in God; turning to Him at all times, @steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness, @laws of God; of the Kitab-i-Aqdas

title: Letter to Haji Siyyid 'Ali Kirmani (from Medina)
first_line: I have read this, thy letter. Hearken thou, therefore, to that which is imparted unto thee by leave of God, for verily the mention of thy Lord's Name is truth itself, guiding unto the straight path [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. قد قرئت کتابک هذا فاستمع لماذا القی الیک باذن الله فان ذکر اسم ربک لهو الحق یهدیک الی صراط مستقیم
subjects: @power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant, @service to others; to the Cause of God, @steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @transcendence; unknowability of God

first_line: As to what thou hast asked concerning the diverse opinions of the people regarding Tahirih, verily the essence of the matter concerning her is that it behooveth all to remain silent [3.5s]
first_line_orig: و ان ما سئلت من اختلاف الناس فی حق الطاهرة فان مجمل القول فی حقها انه حق علی الکل ان یصمتوا
subjects: @Tahirih [Qurratu'l-'Ayn], @multiple meanings; interpretations in scripture, @laws of God; of the Kitab-i-Aqdas, @changing and unchanging parts of religion, @piety; righteousness; fear of God [taqwa]

title: Answer to Siyyid Ahmad Aqa-Zadih
first_line: O thou who art young in years, tender of body, and freshly weaned from thy mother's milk! Praise be to God, who hath, through His command, brought into being whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth [4o]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. یا صغیر السن یا رطب البدن یا قریب العهد من شرب اللبن الحمد لله الذی انشاء ما فی السموات و الارض بامره
subjects: @transcendence; unknowability of God, @prayer for spiritual recognition, @prayer for steadfastness; obedience, @Qur'an and Hadith quotation and interpretation

first_line: Glory be unto Him Who is the Lord of all that are in the heavens and on the earth
first_line_orig: هو العزیز. الحمد لله الذی له ما فی السموات و الارض و هو الحکیم الخبیر و هو الذی یبدع ما یشاء بامره و هو اللطیف الصنیع
subjects: @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @heaven and paradise; heaven and hell, @station of the Manifestation of God, @suffering and imprisonment, @forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God

title: Answer to Mirza Muhammad 'Ali
first_line: Praise be to God, Who bestoweth His remembrance upon whomsoever He willeth. Verily, there is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the Wise. O my God, how shall I call upon Thee, seeing Thou art the All-Seeing One... As for that which thou hast asked concerning the matter of Tahirih in the sacred land, permission was granted her aforetime to depart when turmoil arose therein [4o]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. الحمد لله الذی یمن علی من یشاء بذکره و انه لا اله الا هو العزیز الحکیم یا الهی کیف ادعوک و انک تری ... و ان ما سئلت من حکم الطاهرة علی الارض المقدسة فقد اذنت لها من قبل بالخروج لما تقع بها الفتنه هنالک
subjects: @the Imamate; the Caliphate, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam

title: Du'a Hajat
first_line: O Lord! Send down Thy mercy upon me, for verily all mercy is Thine.... O Lord! Unto Thee I repair for refuge and toward all Thy signs I set my heart. O Lord! Whether traveling or at home
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. اللهم انزل علی رحمتک فان لک الرحمة کلها اللهم صل على محمد حبیبک و الانبیآء
subjects: @prayer for protection, @trust and reliance in God; turning to Him at all times, @prayer for forgiveness

title: Li'l-Khalil
first_line: Verily, I am God, no God is there but Me. I have existed from the beginning that hath no beginning as an eternal Being. Verily, I am God, no God is there but Me, and I shall endure unto the end that hath no end as an eternal Being. O Name of the All-Merciful [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الله اکبر تکبیراً کبیرا. اننی انا الله لا اله الا انا کنت من اول الذی لا اول له کباناً دائماً اننی انا الله لا الله لا الله الا انا لاکون الی آخر الذی لا آخر له کباناً دائماً ان یا اسم الرحیم
subjects: @He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @the Word of God; influence and centrality of, @infinity and eternity

title: Answer to Mirza Muhammad 'Ali Qazvini
first_line: Know thou, O noble brother! Plant thy feet firmly upon the beauteous path of God, and know that God, glorified be He, created naught [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. فاعلم یا اخ الجلیل و اثبت قدمیک علی صراط الله الجمیل و اعرف ان الله سبحانه ما خلق شیئا
subjects: @trust and reliance in God; turning to Him at all times, @consolation and comfort, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God, @steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness

first_line: It behooveth you to await the Day of the appearance of Him Whom God shall manifest. Indeed My aim in planting the Tree of the Bayán
first_line_orig: فلتراقبن یوم من یظهره الله فانی ما اغرست شجرة البیان الا لتعرفنی و اننی انا اول ساجد له
subjects: @He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah, @the Bab; the Primal Point; station and claims of the Bab, @proclamation to people of the Bayan, @the Bayan, its laws and their abrogation, @station of the Manifestation of God

first_line: Say: Now hath the leave been granted from the Book of God, and by this let them that are lowly rejoice [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسمه العلی العظیم. قل الآن جاء الاذن من کتاب الله و ان بذلک فلیفرح الخاشعون
subjects: @wisdom [hikmat], @servitude; submission to God; repentance, @obedience to; authority of the Manifestations of God, @trust and reliance in God; turning to Him at all times, @contention and conflict

title: Li-Sulayman Khan
first_line: Say: God is most exalted above all that are exalted. None in the heavens or on earth or whatsoever lieth between them hath power to resist His supreme ascendancy [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الله اعز بسم الله الرفیع ذی الرفاعین. قل الله ارفع فوق کل ذی ارفاع لمن یقدر ان یمتنع عن سلیط سلطان ارفاعه من احد لا فی السموات و لا فی الارض و لا ما بینهما

title: Letter to Mulla 'Abdu'l-Karim Qazvini
first_line: In the name of God, the Most Bountiful, the Lord of Grace, in the name of God, the Possessor of Generosity, the Source of Munificence. Verily, it rejoiceth me, O My name, that thou art mirrored in the eternal tablets, wherein God hath recounted the mysteries of His Lord [4o]
first_line_orig: الله اکرم. بسم الله الکرم ذی الکارمین بسم الله الکرم ذی الکرما قد بهجتنی ان یا اسمی فی المرآت الازلیه حیث قد حکی الله عن ربه
subjects: @preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings, @spiritual emotions and susceptibilities, @divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity

first_line: Blessed be He Who bestoweth His grace upon whomsoever He willeth through His command. Say: In this, then, let the believers rejoice. Verily, We have read the books which thou didst send down before, and We are witness unto all [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسمه العلی العظیم. تبارک الذی یمن علی من یشاء بامره قل فیذلک فلیفرح المومنون و لقد قرئنا کتب الذی نزلتها من قبل و انا لکل شاهدون
subjects: @rejection, opposition and persecution, @acknowledgment of gift; of monetary contribution, @review of publications, @personal instructions, @steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness, @chastisement and requital

first_line: Glorified be He Who is established upon the Throne, Who knoweth whatsoever descendeth from the heaven to the earth, and whatsoever ascendeth unto heaven, and whatsoever existeth between them [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو بسم الله المتکبر المتقدس. سبحان الذی قد استوی علی العرش یعلم مانزل من السماء الی الارض و ما تعرج الی السماء و ما یبدع بینهما
subjects: @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @the Imamate; the Caliphate

title: Hirz li-Aqa Mahmud
first_line: Glorified be He Who knoweth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on the earth. They who have believed in God and in His signs—these are they who shall triumph [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. سبحان الذی یعلم ما فی السموات و ما فی الارض و ان الذین آمنوا بالله و آیاته فأولئک هم الفائزون
subjects: @praise and encouragement, @recompense; reward for belief; right action, @tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

title: Tawqi'a Aqa Siyyid Husayn
first_line: Glorified be God, the Lord of lords, unto Whom belong the most exalted similitudes! All in the heavens sing His praise [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو الملک المقدس. سبحان الله الربب ذی الربابین له الامثال العلیا یسبح له ما فی السموات

title: Letter to the first pillar (tasbih)
first_line: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Do Thou guard, through Thy mighty protection, those four Manifestations from Thy presence... Glory be unto Him Who hath created the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth betwixt them through a command more nigh than [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو الاکبر. سبحانک اللهم فاحفظ تلک المظاهر الاربعة من عندک بحفظ عظیم ... سبحانک الذی خلق السموات و الارض و ما بینهما بامر اقرب من ان

first_line: Lauded and glorified art Thou, O Lord my God! Thou art supreme over the realm of being and Thy power pervadeth all created things.
first_line_orig: سبحانک اللهم یا الهی انک انت القادر على الامکان والمقتدر على الاکوان فی قبضتک ملکوت الانشاء تخلق کیف تشاء
subjects: @forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God, @Greatest Name, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @sacrifice of self; mystery of sacrifice, @steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness

first_line: The Cause, once veiled in mystery, hath now been proclaimed; the Hour is nigh, and the Moon hath been cleft asunder [4o]
first_line_orig: بسم الله العلی المتکبر القاهر. قد جاء امر فی حکم مستتر اقتربت الساعة و انشق القمر
subjects: @chastisement and requital, @suffering and imprisonment, @proofs of the Manifestations of God, @prophecy and fulfillment, @imagery in the Qur'an, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @station of the Manifestation of God

title: Prayer for the mirrors
first_line: Say: O God! Verily Thou art the Power of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them. Thou bestowest strength upon whomsoever Thou willest... By the life of Him Whom God shall make manifest, wert thou to persevere in this and turn unto all who are on earth, none would stand against thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الله اکبر تکبیراً کبیرا. قل اللهم انک انت قوآء السموات و الارض و ما بینهما لتؤتین القوة من یشآء ... و لعمر من یظهره الله لو تدومن بذلک و لتقبلن على من على الارض لن یقابلنک من احد
subjects: @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah

first_line: There is no power nor strength save in God, the Most Exalted, the Most Great. O God! Bestow Thy blessings, grant Thy peace, and shower Thy benedictions. I beseech Thee by the sanctified realms [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. و لا حول و لا قوة الا بالله العلی العظیم اللهم صل و سلم و بارک و المفازات اقسم علیک
subjects: @prayer for assistance; intercession, @family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam

first_line: Praise be to God Who hath brought into being, through His command, whatsoever is in the heavens and on earth, and beyond them those who have believed in God and His signs - these shall verily be brought into His presence. O my God! I testify before Thee in this my station that verily Thou art God, there is no God but Thee, alone, without peer [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. الحمد لله الذی ابدع ما فی السموات و الارض بامره ثم الذین آمنوا بالله و آیاته فاولئک هم علی الله یعرضون یا الهی اشهد لدیک فی موقفی هذا بانک انت الله لا اله الا انت وحدک لا شریک لک
subjects: @prayer for forgiveness, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @servitude; submission to God; repentance

first_line: Praise be to God, Who hath exalted Himself in His transcendence above all contingent beings, Who hath raised Himself through His loftiness above all created things, Who hath made Himself inaccessible through His inscrutability to all existing things, and Who hath asserted His sovereignty [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الاتقن الاتقن. الحمد لله الذی قد استعلی بعلوه فوق کل الممکنات و استرفع بارتفاعه فوق کل الموجودات و استمنع بامتناعه فوق کل الکائنات و استسلط باستسلاطه
subjects: @station of the Manifestation of God, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @meanings of letters and numbers; jafr (gematria)

title: Tablet to Nawruz Firuz
first_line: Verily, I am God, no God is there but Me. From the beginning that hath no beginning, I have been a Light, and verily, I am God, no God is there but Me. Unto the end that hath no end shall I remain a Light [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الله اعظم هوالاعز الاجل الامنع الارفع الاقدس من الله تعالی. اننی انا الله لا اله الا انا کنت من اول الذی لا اول له نواراً [ ] اننی انا الله لا اله الا انا لاکونن الی اخر الذی لا اخر له نورا
subjects: @transcendence; unknowability of God, @absolute freedom; independence of God, @rendering assistance to God; victory [nusrat]

title: Letter to the wife of the Bab, in Bushihr
first_line: O my sweet spirit! May God, the Most High, protect thee. Think not that the interruption of letters stems from [3.5s]... …God is my witness that since the time of our separation, such griefs encircled me as are beyond description
first_line_orig: بسم الله تعالی. جان شیرین من حرسک الله تعالی لا تحسبن انقطاع الکتب من ملل
subjects: @consolation and comfort, @expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness, @business; financial; property matters

first_line: Glorified be God, the Preserver, the Healer; exalted is He, the Sufficient, the Fulfiller; glorified is He, the Pure, the Disposer; magnified is He, the Sustainer, the Self-Sufficient [4o]
first_line_orig: هو الله العزیز. سبحان الله الحافی الشافی سبحان الله الکافی الوافی سبحان الله الصافی النافی سبحان الله المکفی المکتفی

first_line: Glory be unto Thee, O Lord my God! Nothing whatsoever escapeth Thy knowledge, nor is there anything that could slip from Thy grasp… O Lord! Render victorious Thy forbearing servants…
first_line_orig: سبحانک اللهم یا الهی لا یعزب من علمک من شیء ولا یفوت عن قبضتک من شیء ولا یعجزک من شیء
subjects: @martyrs and martyrdom, @prayer for martyrs, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God, @humility; meekness; lowliness

first_line: Praise be to God, Who doeth whatsoever He willeth by His Command. Glorified and exalted is He above all that they describe. O my God! Thou art God Who hath testified to Thine own Self, before all things, that verily Thou art God, there is no God but Thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. الحمد لله الذی یفعل ما یشاء بامره سبحانه وتعالی عما یصفون یا الهی انت الله الذی قد شهدت لنفسک قبل کل شیء بانک انت الله لا اله الا انت
subjects: @tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering, @forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @prayer for forgiveness

first_line: Praise be to God Who, through His triumph, aideth whomsoever He willeth of His servants. Rejoice ye and be patient, for verily the end belongeth unto the God-fearing. We have, in truth, sent down unto you this Book [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو العزیز. الحمد لله الذی یؤید بنصره من یشآء من عباده ان ابشروا و اصبروا فان العاقبة للمتقین و لقد نزلنا الال الیکم ذلک الکتاب
subjects: @personal instructions, @thankfulness; gratitude, @knowledge; recognition of God, @obedience to; authority of the Manifestations of God, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @praise and encouragement, @chastisement and requital

title: Letter to the fourth pillar (takbir)
first_line: God is exalted above that which you magnify. God is greater than that which you glorify. God is more manifest than that which you have revealed [4o]
first_line_orig: بسم الله المتظهر المتسخر. الله اکبر عما انتم تکبرون الله اعظم عما انتم تعظمون الله اظهر عما انتم تظهرون

title: Letter to Him Whom God shall make manifest
first_line: He is God, no God is there but Him, the Almighty, the Best Beloved. All that are in the heavens and on the earth and whatever lieth between them are His.
first_line_orig: هو الابهی. الله لا اله الا هو العزیز المحبوب له ما فی السموات و ما فی الارض و ما بینهما و هو المهیمن القیوم
subjects: @He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah, @power of the Manifestation of God, @rejection by the people of the Bayan, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity

title: Risaliy-i-Raj'at - Answer to questions from the Letters of the Living
first_line: Glorified be He before Whom bow down in adoration all who dwell in the heavens and all who dwell upon the earth, and unto Him do all works return. Praise be unto God, before Whom glorifieth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on earth, and unto Him shall all return. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him... And concerning the question about the Return, know thou that the Day of the Manifestation of Him Whom God shall make manifest - exalted be His mention [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الامنع الاقدس. سبحان الذی یسجد له من فی السموات و من فی الارض و ان الیه کل یعملون و الحمد لله الذی یسبح من فی السموات و من فی الارض و ان الیه کل ینقلبون شهد الله انه لا اله الا هو له ... و بعد اینکه سئوال از رجعت شده بدانکه یوم ظهور من یظهره الله عز ذکره

first_line: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Thou, verily, art the Truth; there is no God but Thee. Thou hast manifested the mystery of Thy hidden Essence [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو انت العزیز المتکبر الجبار الوهاب. سبحانک اللهم انک انت الحق لا اله الا انت قد اظهرت سر مکنونیتک

first_line: Lauded be Thy Name, O Lord our God! Thou art in truth the Knower of things unseen. Ordain for us such good
first_line_orig: سبحانک اللهم انک انت علام الغیوب قدر لنا من الخیر ما قد احاط به علمک فانک انت الملک العزیز المحبوب

first_line: Praise be to Thee, O Lord, my Best-Beloved! Make me steadfast in Thy Cause and grant that I may be reckoned among those who have not violated Thy covenant
first_line_orig: سبحانک رب یا محبوبی ثبتنی على امرک ثم اجعلنی من الذین ما نقضوا میثاقک وما اتبعوا اصنام ظنونهم ثم اجعل لی
subjects: @prayer for spiritual recognition, @presence [liqa'] of Manifestation of God is presence of God, @walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life, @prayer for steadfastness; obedience, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

title: Li-Mulla Sadiq
first_line: God testifieth concerning His servant that he hath believed in God and His signs, and was among the truthful ones. O God! Thou knowest all things, and whatsoever they who act for Thy sake do perform, and Thou hast promised through the tongue of Thy chosen ones unto them that show patience [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. شهد الله لعبده انه قد آمن بالله و آیاته و کان من الصادقین اللهم انک تعلم کل شیء و ما یعمل العاملون لوجهک و انک قد وعدت علی لسان اولیائک للذین یصبر
subjects: @tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness

first_line: Verily I am Thy servant, O my God, and Thy poor one and Thy suppliant and Thy wretched creature
first_line_orig: فاننی انا یا الهی عبدک وفقیرک وسائلک ومسکینک ونازلک ومستجیرک ما کان رضائی
subjects: @transcendence; unknowability of God, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @spiritual emotions and susceptibilities, @servitude; submission to God; repentance

first_line: May my spirit be sacrificed for Thee! From the time of the setting of the Sun of Glory from Thy presence until now - the afternoon of Thursday, the twenty-eighth of the month [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو العزیز الدائم المتعال. فداک روحی از حین غروب آفتاب شرف حضور الی الآن که عصر روز پنجشنبه بیست و هشتم شهر
subjects: @expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness, @acquiescence and resignation; contentment, @personal instructions

title: Letter to Haji 'Abdu'l-Vahhab
first_line: He is God, exalted is He! He Who is supported and obeyed and glorified. May God preserve you. Although not recognizing the honor of attaining the presence
first_line_orig: هو الله تعالی. قبله مؤید و مطاع ممجد ادام الله فضلکم اگرچه بصورت تشرف حضور را درک نکرده ولی یحکم الارواح جنود مجنده رشته محبت
subjects: @petitions to authorities, @spiritual communication; connections of the heart, @expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness, @consolation and comfort

title: Letter to the third pillar (tawhid)
first_line: In the name of God, the Peerless, the Ever-Faithful. Say: God, my Lord! All give praise unto Him. Say: God, my Lord! All prostrate to Him
first_line_orig: بسم الله الفرد المعتمد. قل الله ربی کل له لمسبحون قل الله ربی کل له یحمدون قل الله ربی
subjects: @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @trust and reliance in God; turning to Him at all times

first_line: Say: O my God! O Thou Who art the Maker of the heavens and of the earth, O Lord of the Kingdom! Thou well knowest the secrets of my heart… O Thou Who art the Lord of grace abounding!...
first_line_orig: بسم ربک الباری الملک الکافی المتعال المستعان. قل اللهم فاطر السموات و الارض مالک الملک تعلم ما فی نفسی و لا یعلم ما فی نفسک سواک و تشهد ما انا علیه و لا یشهد ذلک غیرک
subjects: @prayer for praise and gratitude, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God, @prayer for nearness to God, @detachment; severance; renunciation; patience, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @prayer for forgiveness

title: Khasa'il-i Sab'ih (Treatise of the Seven Directives)
first_line: The first command of the seven religious practices is to carry the blessed, protective circle. The second of them is to abandon the water pipe.
first_line_orig: الامر الاول من الشعائر السبعة هو حمل الدائرة المنیعة المبارکة و الثانی منها ترک الغلیان
subjects: @Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc., @Imam Husayn

title: Letter to the second pillar (tahmid)
first_line: Praise be to God who created the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lies between them by His command "Be" and it is. Might belongs to God alone, who created everything by His command
first_line_orig: بسم الله المتمجد المتقدس. الحمد لله الذی خلق السموات و الارض و ما بینهما بامره کن فیکون و انما العزة لله الذی خلق کل شیء
subjects: @personal instructions, @creation of the world, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God

title: Answer to Mirza Muhammad 'Ali Nahri and his friend
first_line: Praise be to God who was revealed to the servants by the light of His glory radiating from the face of majesty, with no peer or likeness in the station of the inmost heart nor the concealed beauty
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. الحمد لله الذی قد تجلی للعباد بنور عزته المتشعشعة من وجه الجلال بلا مثل و لا شبه فی حکم الفؤاد و لا الجلال
subjects: @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @transcendence; unknowability of God

first_line: Glorified be Thy Name, O Lord! In whom shall I take refuge while Thou art in truth my God and my Beloved
first_line_orig: سبحانک رب الى من الوذ وانک انت الهی ومحبوبی والى من استجیر وانک انت ربی ومالکی والى من اهرب
subjects: @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @humility; meekness; lowliness, @spiritual transformation, @divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity, @fire and light; fire and water, @prayer for forgiveness

title: Letter to Shaykh 'Ali 'Azim
first_line: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him. His is the creation and the command. He giveth life and causeth death, then causeth death and giveth life, and verily He is the Ever-Living Who dieth not. In His grasp is the dominion of all things; He createth whatsoever He willeth by His command, and verily, He hath power over all things. Indeed, the glory from God resteth upon the people of guidance [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو الاکبر شهد الله اله لا اله الا هو العزیز المحبوب هو الاعظم بسم الله الامنع الاقدس. شهد الله انه لا اله الا هو له الخلق و الامر یحیی و یمیت ثم یمیت و یحیی و انه هو حی لا یموت فی قبضته ملکوت کلشیء یخلق ما یشآء بأمره انه کان علی کل شیء قدیراً و انما البهاء القوم من الله فی اصحاب الهدی
subjects: @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @symbolism, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @spiritual transformation

title: Letter to Mirza Asadu'llah Dayyan
first_line: God is the Most Great Judge! In the name of God, the judgment, master of all judges. In the name of God, the judgement, master of all who judge. You have looked at the tablets of abad [seven in abjad?], which has been ornamented with the lights
first_line_orig: الله ادین بسم الدین ذی الدیانین …. قد نظرت الی الواح ابد بما قد طرز من انوار تجلی افقه جل و عز فلله الحمد کما هو اهله و مستحقه
subjects: @defending the Faith; protecting the Cause; apologetics, @the Word of God; influence and centrality of, @walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life

first_line: You asked about the statement of God, powerful and glorified, regarding the status of the prostration of the angels and the arrogance of Iblis when He, glorified and exalted, said
first_line_orig: و اما ماسألت قول الله عز و جل فی حکم سجود الملائکه وا استکبار ابلیس حیث قال جل و علا استکبرت ام
subjects: @angels, @The Primal Will; self-generation of the Primal Will, @mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision

first_line: It is not possible to describe God as rising above something or sitting upon something. The meaning of "the throne" in what was revealed in the revelation from the Friend
first_line_orig: و لا یمکن ان یوصف الله باستعلائه علی شیئی و لا باستوائه علی شیئی لان ما
subjects: @symbolism, @interpretation of words and passages in scripture, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

title: Letter to the household, from Masqat
first_line: Read the book of your Lord God, there is no other god but Him. It descended by His permission from Ali, the Praiseworthy. Verily, the path of God in the heavens and the earth is in the decree of the book
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. اقرء کتاب ربک الذی لا اله الا هو قد نزل باذنه من لدن علی حمید و انه فی حکم الکتاب
subjects: @procession; appearance of the Word from God, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

title: Letter to the wife of the Bab, in Shiraz
first_line: Although from the revolution of earth and heavens and the succession of night and day it is evident that [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو العزیز. اگرچه از انقلاب ارض افلاک و نقلبات لیل و نهار ظاهر است که چه
subjects: @tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering, @consolation and comfort, @expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness

first_line: In the name of God, greatness possessing all who are great. In the name of God, greatness possessing all the great ones. Praise be to God for what has shown forth from the lights of the morn of eternity
first_line_orig: الله عظيم الله اعظم. بسم الله العظم ذی العاظمین بسم الله العظم ذی العظماء والحمد لله علی ما اشرق من انوار صبح الازل و اطراز ذکر الاول کما هو اهله و مستحقه
subjects: @the Word of God; influence and centrality of

title: Ziyarat Imam Husayn (Siyyidu'sh-Shuhada)
first_line: The peace of God, the One, the Single, be upon thee, O just and beloved Sovereign, O noble and awe-inspiring King, and upon Muhammad and 'Alí and Fá?imih and ?asan and the Imáms, and upon thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو العلی المتکبر الاعلی. سلام الله الواحد الاحد علیک یا سلطان العادل المحبوب و ملیک الفاضل المرهوب و علی محمد و علی و فاطمه والحسن والائمة و علیک
subjects: @eulogies; reminiscences, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @martyrs and martyrdom, @visitation Tablets

first_line: He—glorified be His mention—resembleth the sun. Were unnumbered mirrors to be placed before it, each would, according to its capacity
first_line_orig: فان مثله جل ذکره کمثل الشمن لو یقابلنه الی ما لا نهایة مرایا کلهن لیستعکسن من تجلی الشمس
subjects: @Manifestation of God as sun, @call to action, @differences in human capacity

first_line: Glorified be He before Whom boweth down in adoration whatsoever dwelleth in the heavens and on earth and all that lieth between them, and He, verily, is the Most High, the Most Exalted [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله المتکبر المتنور المتفطر المتعزز المتقدر المتقدس المتفضل المتجلل المتجمل ... الممتنع المنیع. فسبحان الذی یسجد له من فی السموات و من فی الارض و ما بینهما و هو العلی المتعالی العظیم
subjects: @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @creation of the world

first_line: Praise be to Thee, O my God! How oft have I wanted to mention you with the words of the saints and praise you with the praise of those who have drawn nigh, despite knowing that every mention appearing from someone other than You will not reach you
first_line_orig: هو الله العزیز المتعال. فسبحانک اللهم یا الهی حینئذ ارید ان اذکرک بذکر المقدسين واسبّحک بتسبيح المقربين مع علم بانّ کلّ ذکر الذي يظهر من عند غيرک
subjects: @transcendence; unknowability of God, @The Primal Will; self-generation of the Primal Will, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

first_line: Verily, know that I previously saw in a dream in that House [the Kaaba?] where I was sitting that in its midst was a masoleum on which was a domed sepulcher. When I approached the masoleum, I saw Muhammad al-Jawwad exit from the sepulcher
first_line_orig: و انک لتعلم انی رایت فی المنام من قبل فی ذلک البیت الذی انا کنت جالسا فیه ان وسطه مرقد
subjects: @accounts of dreams and visions, @family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam, @forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God

title: Prayer for Mulla Hasan
first_line: O loved one! Stand at the door of the One Who Answers, and trust in God, my Lord and your Lord. There is no God but Him, the Hearing, the Knowing
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. یا ایها الحبیب قف علی باب المجیب و اتکل علی الله ربی و ربک الذی لا الله الا هو السمیع العلیم
subjects: @prayer for protection, @power of prayer, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @trust and reliance in God; turning to Him at all times, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

title: Letter to Mulla Hasan Bajistani
first_line: O questioner! Know that God does not decree disease for a soul unless it is for the errors its hands have wrought. That is naught but a penance for its sins
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. یا ایها السآئل فاعلم ان الله لا یحکم بمرض لنفس الا بما قدمت ایدیه من الخطایا و ذلک ما کانت
subjects: @tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering, @mindfulness; concentration; focus, @servitude; submission to God; repentance, @bringing oneself to account each day, @spiritual transformation, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @health and healing; material and spiritual healing, @effort; striving

title: Letter to Hajj Sulayman Khan (from Medina)
first_line: Verily, this book has been written by the hand of this, the Remembrance, Exalted and Wise. Verily, he is exalted upon the straight path. Verily, he knows the invisble world of the heavens and the earth
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. ان هذا کتاب قد سطرت من ید الذکر هذا علی حکیم و انه لعلی علی صراط مستقیم و ان ربک یعلم غیب السموات
subjects: @the Word of God; influence and centrality of, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

first_line: Glory be unto Thee, O Lord my God! I beg Thee to forgive me and those who support Thy Faith.
first_line_orig: سبحانک اللهم فاغفر لی وللذین هم قد حملوا امرک انک انت الملک الغفار الکریم وادخل اللهم عبادک الذین هم یومئذ
subjects: @forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God, @acknowledgment of gift; of monetary contribution, @prayer for spiritual recognition, @transcendence; unknowability of God

title: Letter to Aqa Muhammad Husayn Ardistani
first_line: God testifieth, etc. He is the Most Mighty. After the basmala God testifieth, etc. So testify that there is no god but Him, the Help-in-Peril, the Self-Subsisting
first_line_orig: هو الاکبر. شهد الله الخ هو الاعظم بعد البسملة شهد الله الخ فلتشهدن علی انه لا اله الا هوالمهیمن القیوم
subjects: @preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings, @superiority; incomparability of the Word of God

first_line: Praise be to God, Who bestoweth through His command His grace upon whomsoever He willeth. Say: verily, the ultimate victory belongeth unto the God-fearing. We have indeed read the Book which We revealed by God's leave, and We learned of the mention of Abraham's name [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسمه العلی العظیم. الحمد لله الذی یمن علی من یشاء بامره قل ان العاقبة للمتقین و لقد قرئنا کتاب الذی نزلنه باذن الله و علمنا بذکر اسم ابراهیم
subjects: @Moses, @tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God

title: Khatt li'sh-Shaykh Rafi'-i-Rashti
first_line: Bless Him who sends down the spirit of command on whom He will. Verily, rejoice and do not fear. God, your Lord, is both forgiving and thankful
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. تبارک الذی ینزل علی من یشاء و روح الامر ان ابشروا لا تخلف فان الله ربک لغفور شکور و انه لا اله الا هو قد نزل الکتاب لامره
subjects: @the Word of God; influence and centrality of, @forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God

title: Prayer written at the request of Karbala'i 'Ali Asghar Khurasani
first_line: God bore witness to His servant that he believed in God and His verses, and he was of those who are guided. O my God! I bear witness to You by that which you bear witness to Yourself and the saints who have drawn nigh among Your servants
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. شهد الله لعبده انه من بالله و ایاته و کان من المهتدین الهی انی اشهدک بما تشهد لنفسک
subjects: @prayer for praise and gratitude, @prayer for forgiveness, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @justice and wrath of God

first_line: Verily, today, by consensus, the Messenger of God designated the Hidden Awaited One and the Mighty, Victorious Qa'im whom God must manifest so that he may fill the earth with justice after it had been filled with oppression and injustice
first_line_orig: و ان الیوم بالاجماع وصی رسول الله محمد الغائب المنتظر و القائم المقتدر المنتصر

first_line: The glory of Him Whom God shall make manifest is immeasurably above every other glory
first_line_orig: و ان بهاء من یظهره الله فوق کل بهاء وان جلاله فوق کل جلال وان جماله فوق کل جمال وان عظمته فوق کل عظمة

first_line: I recognize, O my God, that whenever something is related to Thee, the decree of the Will is applicable to it, and whenever it is related to itself, the decree of Purpose is established in it
first_line_orig: وانی لاعلم یا الهی ان الشیئی لما ینسب الیک یظهر حکم المشیة فی صقعه و اذا ینسب

first_line: Praise be to God, Who created the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them through His command "Be!" and it is. Unto God belongeth all dominion, both both aforetime and hereafter [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله المتقوم المتکرم المتقدم المتعظم. الحمد لله الذی خلق السموات و الارض و ما بینهما بامره کن فیکون و لله الامر من قبل و من بعد

first_line: O God our Lord! Protect us through Thy grace from whatsoever may be repugnant unto Thee
first_line_orig: ربنا اعصمنا بفضلک عما یکره رضاک وهب لنا ما انت تستحق به وزد لنا بفضلک وبارک واعف عنا

first_line: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him, the Help-in-Peril, the Self-Subsisting. He is the Ever-Living. In the Name of God, the Most Living, the Most Living. God, there is none other God but He, the Most Living, the Most Living. Say: God is the Most Living, transcendent above every possessor of life. None can [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو المحیی. شهد الله انه لا اله الا هو المهیمن القیوم هو الحی بسم الله الاحیی الاحیی الله لا اله الا هو الاحیی الاحیی قل الله احیی فوق کل ذا احیاء لن یقدر ان

first_line: Say: O my God, verily you are the Creator of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lies between them. You give creation to whom You will and take creation from whom You will

first_line: God is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The likeness of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp, a lamp, a lamp, enclosed in crystal upon crystal. The crystal well-nigh shineth of itself [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. الله نور السموات و الارض مثل نوره کمشکوة فیها المصباح المصباح المصباح المصباح فی بلوره فوق بلوره البلورة تکاد من فیها مثل ما یضیء

title: Du'a' fihi ismu'l-A'zam
first_line: O God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name, O God, O Lord, O Most Merciful, O Inaccessible, O Most Holy, O He, O Mighty One, O Best-Beloved, O All-Compelling, O Manifest, O Single, O Inaccessible, O All-Subduing, O Self-Subsisting [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الامنع الاقدس. اللهم انی اسئلک باسمک یا الله یا رب یا رحمن یا منیع یا قدوس یا هو یا عزیز یا محبوب یا قاهر یا ظاهر یا فرد یا ممتنع یا مهیمن یا قیوم یا قائم
subjects: @prayer for spiritual recognition, @day of Resurrection; Judgement

first_line: In the name of God the exalting, master of those who exalt through God. God the exalting, master of the exalting. Say: Praise be God! Verily You exalt the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lies between them
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرفع ذی الرفاعین. بالله الله الرفع ذی الارفاع قل اللهم انک انت رفاع السموات و الارض و ما بینهما ثم کل القادرین قل اللهم انک انت

title: Letter to the wife of the Bab, in Chihriq
first_line: He is the Most Glorious, the Most Splendid, the Most Beautiful, the Most Great, the Most Luminous! My dear soul, at all times the praise of God dwells in one's heart
first_line_orig: هو الابهی الاجل الاجمل الاعظم الانور. جان عزیز من در هر حال بتسبیح حق قلب خود را ساکن نموده و از فضل الهی یوم وصل را سائل بوده
subjects: @consolation and comfort, @expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness, @acquiescence and resignation; contentment

first_line: Praise be God, the god possessing two gods. To Him belongs the beautiful names. That which is in the heavens, and the earth, and whatsoever lies between them praises Him
first_line_orig: سبحان الله الاله ذی الالاهین له الاسماء الحسنی یسبح له ما فی السموات و الارض و ما بینهما انا کل له عابدون ان یا حسین قد طلع مطلع الالوهیة باسم الاول الحسین

title: Letter to Qahir
first_line: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him. His is the Kingdom and the Dominion, and then the Glory and the Power, and then the Might and the Empyrean, and then the Strength and the Brilliance, and then the Sovereignty and the human realm. He giveth life and causeth death, then causeth death and giveth life, and verily He is the Ever-Living Who dieth not, and the King Who passeth not away, and the Just One Who wrongeth not, and the Sovereign Who changeth not, and the Single One from Whose grasp nothing escapeth, whether in the heavens or on the earth or whatever lieth between them. He createth whatsoever He willeth by His command. Verily, He hath power over all things. [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الله اکبر. شهد الله انه لا اله الا هو له الملک و الملکوت ثم العز و الجبروت ثم القدرة و اللاهوت ثم القوة و الیاقوت ثم السلطنة و الناسوت یحیی و یمیت ثم یمیت و یحیی و انه هو حی لا یموت و ملک لا یزول و عدل لا یجور و سلطان لا تحول و فرد لا یفوت عن قبضته من شیء لا فی السموات و لا فی الارض و لا ما بینهما یخلق ما یشاء بامره انه کان علی کلشیء قدیرا

first_line: Say: O my God, verily you are the Helper of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lies between them. You give aid to whom you will and take aid from whom you will
first_line_orig: قل اللهم انک انت نصار السموات و الارض و ما بینهما لتؤتین النصر من تشاء و لینزعن النصر عمن یشاء
subjects: @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

title: Tablet revealed in the year '60
first_line: The spirit of prayer which animates My soul is the direct consequence of a dream
subjects: @Declaration; advent of the Bab, @accounts of dreams and visions, @mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision, @Imam Husayn

first_line: In the name of God, by God, praise be to God! I commit my affairs to God. I have no success except through God, and no help save from God. Whatsoever blessing we have comes from God
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. بسم الله و بالله و الحمد لله و الجات امری الى الله و ما توفیقی الا بالله و ما النصر الا من عند الله
subjects: @trust and reliance in God; turning to Him at all times, @angels

first_line: The fourteen holy personages of his grandfather, his father, and his paternal uncle the sayyid and those who await the Remembrance say: Praised be God for all of His manifestations
first_line_orig: بسم الله الاصبر الاصبر ذوالعز والبقا. حضور معظمه جده و والده و خاله سید ١٤ و منتظرین ذکر میشود که الحمد لله علی ظهور انه کلها والله ولی و ولیکن افوض امری الی الله و هو خیر الناصرین و ان البها من کتاب الله علی کل المؤمنین و کل

first_line: Say: O my God! Verily, you are Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lies between them. You give lordship to whom you will and take lordship from whom you will
first_line_orig: الله اکبر. قل اللهم انک انت صحاب السموات و الارض و ما بینهما لتؤتین الصحبة من تشآء
subjects: @divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @prayer for nearness to God

title: Li-Siyyid Husayn-i-Turshizi
first_line: In the name of God the manifest, master of all who are manifest. In the name of God the mighty, master of all who are mighty. In the name of God the hidden, master of all who are hidden
first_line_orig: هو. بسم الله الظهر ذی الظهرین بسم الله البطن ذی البطانین بسم الله القدر ذی القدارین بسم الله العلم ذی العلامین بسم الله السلط ذی السلطاء بسم الله الحکم ذی الحکماء ...

first_line: I have sought refuge with the Possessor of the Dominion and the Kingdom. I have sought shelter with the Posessor of Power and Sovereignty. I have trusted in the Living who neither sleeps nor dies
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. تحصنت بذی الملک و الملکوت و اعتصمت بذی العزة و الجبروت
subjects: @prayer for protection, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @trust and reliance in God; turning to Him at all times

first_line: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him, the Almighty, the Best-Beloved. Fix your gaze

title: Letter to Shaykh 'Ali 'Azim
first_line: God bore witness that there is no god but Him, the Almighty, the Best-Beloved. He is the Most Great. In the name of God, the Supreme, the Supreme. Assist the Cause by negating the negative and confirming a thousand confirmations
first_line_orig: شهد الله انه لا اله الا هو العزیز المحبوب هو الاکبر بسم الله الاعظم الاعظم الله لا اله الا هو الاعظم الاعظم. فاستقرن الامر بنفی النفی و اثبات الف الاثبات بنصر ربک الطی هو
subjects: @alchemy; the elixir

first_line: There are seven general stages. The first is the stage of the inorganic being. From the mineral kingdom, it ascendeth to the stage of the plant

subjects: @degrees of spirit and the kingdoms of existence, @evolution; human evolution, @seven stages of creation, @spiritual transformation, @presence of; reunion with God

title: Li'th-Thamara
first_line: God is the Most Great, Great is He! This is a book from God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting to God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting. Say: All are originated by God
first_line_orig: الله اکبر تکبیرا کبیرا. هذا کتاب من عند الله المهیمن القیوم الی الله المهیمن القیوم قل کل من الله مبدئون ... هذا کتاب من علی قبل ملل ذکرالله للعالمین الی من یقول اسمه اسم الوحید ذکرالله للعالمین

first_line: O God! O Single One! O Unique One! O Peerless One! O Eternal One! O He who takes for Himself neither lord nor offspring! You are the One among many, the Hope

first_line: In the Name of God, the victor of the most victorious, proclaim: God will assist all those who arise to serve Him. No one is able to deprive Him of His majesty, His dominion, His sovereignty, for in the heaven and the earth and in all the realms of God He is the victorious and the conqueror!

first_line_orig: ان هذا کتاب نزلت آیاته الى التی آمنت بآیات ربها وکانت من القانتین ان اشهدی

first_line: Is there any remover of difficulties save God? Say: Praised be God! He is God! All are His servants and all abide by His bidding!

first_line: God, no God is there but Him, the Most Great, the Most Great! The decree hath become established through the negation of negation and the affirmation of affirmation [3.5s]

title: Letter to Mulla 'Abdu'l-Karim Qazvini
first_line: God is the Most Great, Great is He! O Karim! We have endowed you with a wahid from God
first_line_orig: الله اکبر تکبیرا کبیرا. ان یا کریم قد وهبناک واحداْ من حق واحد الاول لتحفظن کل ما نزل من عند الله و لتبلغن الى اسم الوحيد ولتسئلن عمن يکتب آيات الله ما انتم مراد الله لا تعلمون

first_line: O name of Nabil Ali! Give greetings to those who are in the house of truth and keep watch over their affairs

first_line: Tell the students that the amr [matter/cause] is not yet mature nor has it reached its appointed time

first_line: O Lord, my God! O Thou the Most Lauded, the Most Holy, the Most Tender, the Most Bountiful! Remove our difficulties by Thy grace and bounty. Thou art, verily, the All-Merciful, the All-Bountiful
first_line_orig: بسم الله البر العطوف. اللهم یا سبوح یا قدوس یا حنان یا منان فرج لنا بالفضل و الاحسان انک انت الرحمن المنان
subjects: @prayer for tests and difficulties, @forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God

first_line: Praise be unto Thee, O Lord. Forgive us our sins, have mercy upon us and enable us to return unto Thee

first_line: I bear witness that there is no God except God alone. There can be no doubt about this. And I testify that Muhammad is indeed His servant, and His Messenger
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. اشهد ان لا اله الا الله وحده لا شريک له و اشهد ان محمد عبده و رسوله اللهم صل علي محمد

title: Fi'l-Maut wa'l-'Ama' (on death, and "the cloud")
first_line: Glorified be He in Whose Hands lie the kingdoms of the heavens and of the earth. There is no God but Him, the One, the All-Compelling, the Single, the All-Powerful... As to the meaning of that other tradition mentioned in the Book, that God was in a cloud with air above it and air beneath it [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. سبحان الذی بیده ملکوت السموات و الارض لا اله الا هو الواحد المتکبر الاحد المقتدر ... اما معنی الحديث الآخر الذی سئل فی الکتاب ان الله کان فی عماء فوقه هواء و تحته هواء
subjects: @the cloud ['ama], @transcendence; unknowability of God, @absolute freedom; independence of God

first_line: Praise be to God Who hath devised all geometric forms, granting each the capacity to occupy the realm of signs [4o]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. الحمد لله الذی اخترع کل الهندسیات بما قبلت نفسها فی مقام الدلالات

first_line: Praise be to God, Who hath borne witness unto His own Self, by His own Self, that verily He is God, there is no God but Him, alone, without peer [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. الحمد لله الذی شهدت لنفسک بنفسک بانک انت الله لا اله الا انت وحدک لا شریک

title: Tafsir al-Hamd
first_line: Verily all glory from God be upon the first Vahid and upon them that bear likeness unto that Unity, wherein naught can be seen save the first Vahid. And then bear thou witness [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الاعظم الاعظم. و انما البهاء من الله علی الواحد الاول و من تشابه ذلک الواحد حیث لا یری فیه الا الواحد الاول و بعد فاشهد
subjects: @progressive revelation; renewal of religion, @interpretation of words and passages in scripture, @multiple meanings; interpretations in scripture, @prophecy and fulfillment, @Word of God and human limitations, @oneness; unity of religion, @oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God

title: Commentary on the Qur'an I
Commentary on the Qur'an II
Tafsir-i Kun wa Yakun
first_line: Praise be to God, the Source of creation, the Originator of invention, and the Creator of whatsoever lieth within the heavens and the earth, beside Whom there is no other God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. الحمد لله مبدع الابداع و منشیء الاختراع وخلاق ما  في السموات وما في الأرض الذي لا اله الّا هو

title: Letter to Rahim
first_line: Verily I am God; there is no God but Me! From the beginning that hath no beginning I have been the Best of creators, and verily I am God; there is no God but Me, and unto the end that hath no end I shall ever remain the Best of creators... O Name of the All-Glorious! When the sun hath set, none knoweth wherein it dwelleth, nor shall it rise again save on the Day of Him Whom God shall make manifest, that Lord of all the worlds [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الامدد الامدد. و اننی انا الله لا اله الا انا کنت من اول الذی لا اول له خیرالائلهین و اننی انا الله لا اله الا انا لاکونن الی آخر الذی لا آخر له خیرالائلهین ... ان یا اسم الابهی اذا غربت الشمس لم یحط علم بانها فیمن و لا یطلع الا یوم من یظهره الله ذلک رب العالمین

first_line: Glorified art Thou, O my God, Lord of the heavens and of the earth and whatsoever lieth betwixt them, that I should make mention of Thee by my remembrance of Thee, or extol Thee through my praise within Thy dominion [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. سبحانک اللهم رب السموات و الارض و ما بینهما من ان اذکرک بذکری ایاک او ان اثنی علیک بثنائی فی ملکک

title: Salavat-i-Hayakil-i-Tis'ati 'Ashar
first_line: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Shower Thy blessings upon the Primal Temple with all Thy most effulgent Glory, and all Thy most exalted Majesty, and all Thy most beauteous Beauty, and all Thy most supreme Grandeur, and all Thy most radiant Light, and all Thy most expansive Mercy [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الاعظم الاعظم. سبحانک اللهم صل على هيکل الاول بکل بهائک ابهاه وکل جلالک اجله وکل جمالک اجمله وکل عظمتک اعظمها وکل نورک انوره وکل رحمتک اوسعها
subjects: @prayer for praise and gratitude, @transcendence; unknowability of God, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @prophecy and fulfillment

title: Prayer for Friday evening
first_line: Glorified art Thou, O Lord my God! This is the night of Friday, wherein I beseech Thee, through Thine own Self, for there existeth not within Thy knowledge any equal to Thy justice, nor any like unto Thee, nor any similitude, nor any peer. Creation is Thy creation, and the Command proceedeth from Thee and returneth unto Thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الامنع الاقدس. سبحانک اللهم یا الهی هذه لیلة الجمعه لاسئلنک ما فیها بک اذ لا شئ فى علمک عدلک و لا مثلک و لا شبهک و لا قرينک الخلق خلقک و الامر منک اليک و حدک
subjects: @charitable associations; humanitarian activities, @firmness in the Covenant, @law of pilgrimage, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @transcendence; unknowability of God

title: Javab-i-'Alim-i-Rashti
first_line: Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds, and verily all blessings rest upon the first Vahid at every moment. And furthermore, let it not be hidden from any soul who hath believed in God, His Book, His Messenger, the Imáms of Guidance and the Manifestations of His Cause, that in this Day no matter is more vital than the recognition of the Source of Religion [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. الحمد لله ربّ العالمین و انّما الصّلوة علی الواحد الاوّل فی کلّ حین و بعد مخفی نباشد بر هیچ فردی که مؤمن بود بخداوند و کتاب او و رسول او و ائمّۀ هدی و مظاهر امر او بر اینکه امروز هیچ امری اهمّ از معرفت مبدء دین ندانسته
subjects: @proofs of the Manifestations of God, @interpretation of words and passages in scripture, @return of the Manifestations of God, @superiority; incomparability of the Word of God, @oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God, @rejection, opposition and persecution, @rejection of Muhammad

title: Ziyarat for 'the second to believe' on 'Id al-Fitr
first_line: Verily the All-Glorious Glory, the Most Exalted Majesty, the Most Beauteous Beauty, and the Most Supreme Grandeur [3.5s]
first_line_orig: انما البهاء الابهی و الجلال الاجلل و الجمال الاجمل و العظمة الاعظمی

title: Du'a'a'l-Qahriyya 'Ala'n-nafy
first_line: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee, by Thy Firstness which transcendeth all things, to reckon all those possessing the alif [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الاقهر الاقهر. سبحانک اللهم لاسئلنک باوليتک التى انها هى ممتنعة فوق کل شئ ان تعد من کل ذات الف ينسب الى دون الحق بقدرتک على کل شئ
subjects: @purity of heart; sincerity of intention; sanctity, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God, @prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause, @transcendence; unknowability of God

title: Letter to Mirza Siyyid Hasan-i-Khurasani (from Bushihr)
first_line: Read thou the Book wherein is remembered the Name of thy Lord, then humble thyself before His decree. Verily, there is no God but Him, the Self-Sufficient, the All-Praised. And verily this is a Book sent down through the decree of the Remnant of God, the manifest Imam of Truth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. اقرء کتاب ذکر اسم ربک ثم اسجد لحکمه انه لا اله الا هو لغنی حمید و انه لکتاب قد نزل من حکم بقیة الله امام حق مبین
subjects: @corruption; misinterpretation of the Word of God, @the Word of God; influence and centrality of

title: Ziyarat for the first [to believe]
first_line: Verily I am God, no God is there but Me, and aught except Me is but My creation. Say, worship Me then, O ye, My creatures. Verily, I am God; there is no God but Me. I have been from all eternity the Ancient One [3.5s]... ...the first to know Me was I Myself, the Lord of the letters of ‘Azím (‘Alí), then it was the possessor of eight exalted and glorious letters (Mullá Husayn)
first_line_orig: بسم الله الابهی الابهی. اننی انا الله لا اله الا انا و ان ما دونی خلقی قل أن یا خلقي إیاي فاعبدون إنني أنا الله لا إله إلا أنا کنت أزلا قدیما
subjects: @heaven and paradise; heaven and hell, @justice and wrath of God, @murder; causing physical harm, @martyrdom of the Bab, @power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

title: Ziyarat for the Point
first_line: Verily all glory from God rest upon thee, O thou sacred dust, and all exaltation be upon thee, O thou sanctified earth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الامنع الاقدس. انما البهاء من عند الله علیک یا ایتها التربة المقدسة ثم الجلال علیک یا ایتها التربة الممتنعة

first_line: O cherished friend! Praise be to God, Who hath enriched the luminous leaf in the land of Há with the mystery of the twin Mounts [4o]
first_line_orig: هو المحبوب بسم الله الفطار الجبار المختار القهار السخار الفطار الستار الغفار البطاش اذ لا اله الا هو و ان الله کل یرجعون. یا حبیب الحمد لله الذی قد اغن الورقة النور فی ارض الهاء بالسّر الطورین

title: Ziyarat-i-Hurufi'l-Vahid
first_line: Verily, if upon such a day - the Day of Friday - thou shouldst find thyself in the presence of Him Whom God shall make manifest, blessed indeed art thou, and this shall suffice thee in place of visiting the Letters of Unity [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الامنع الاقدس. فان کنت مثل ذلک الیوم یوم الجمعة بین یدی من یظهره الله طوبی لک لیکفیک عن زیارة حروف الواحد
subjects: @expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness, @prophecy and fulfillment, @visitation Tablets, @spiritual transformation, @martyrs and martyrdom, @apocalyptic imagery

title: Ziyarat dar shab-i-jum'ah
first_line: If thou findest thyself in the likeness of the night within the garden of sanctity and the precincts of fellowship... Verily, their sustenance doth come to them both morn and eve [4o]
first_line_orig: فاذا کنت فی مثل للیلة فی روضة القدس و حضیرة الانس... للرزق یاتیهم رزقهم بکرةً و عشیاً

first_line: If the concealed command, which is fundamental yet deemed imaginary, be mentioned anywhere, or if reference be made to any station or to the knowledge of all things, it is by virtue of the majesty of the station of Divine Unity [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هو العلی المتکبر. امر مستور که رکن است موهوم تصور شود اگر در جائی ذکر مقامی یا علم بکل شیء ذکر شده بواسطه عظمة مقام توحید بوده
subjects: @proofs of the Manifestations of God, @divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity

title: Letter to Muhammad Karim Khan Kirmani
first_line: Praise be to God Who hath revealed Himself unto all creation through the radiant splendours of His Countenance, rising from the horizon of His Will... Verily, We have promised the sinful ones a grievous chastisement, and boiling waters, and scorching heat [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الخالق الباری المصور المقتدر القدیر. الحمد لله الذی تجلی علی الامکان باشراق انوار وجهه الطالع من افق مشیته... انا اوعدنا الاثیم بالعذاب الالیم و السموم و الحمیم

first_line: Praise be to God Who createth whatsoever He willeth by His command, and verily He knoweth that which is in the heavens and that which is on earth. Glorified and exalted be He above all that they describe. O my God! How can I call upon Thee when my sins have encompassed me [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی یبدع ما یشاء بامره و انه لیعلم ما فی السموات و ما فی الارض سبحانه و تعالی عما یصفون یا الهی کیف ادعوک و ان ذنوبی قد احاطتنی
subjects: @events in the life and ministry of the Bab, @servitude; submission to God; repentance, @prayer for forgiveness, @tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering

first_line: Write thou the first verse on Thursday upon green silk with ten exalted lines, and keep it with thee, then write thou the second verse [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. اکتب شعر الاول یوم الخمیس علی حریرات الخضراء مع عشر علیات و اجعله عندک ثم اکتب شعر الثانی

first_line: And secondly, I invoke blessings upon the noblest of His creation, Muhammad, who dispelled error and affliction [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحیم. وصلیت فی الثانی علی خیر خلقه محمد من زاح الضلالة و العلت

title: Inscription on the Bab's signet ring
first_line: Praise be unto Him; there is no God but Him. This is a Path revealed by His behest, and all shall pass thereon
first_line_orig: سبحان الله ان الذی لا اله الا هو هذا صراط من لدنه کل عليه تمرّون

title: Treatise on the education of children
first_line: Praise be to God Who hath brought forth the Primal Will from naught, through itself, for itself, of itself, and made it the embroidered vesture of His Own Being's Countenance [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسمه المکنون العلی العظیم. الحمد لله الذی ابدع المشیة لا من شیئ بنفسها لنفسها من نفسها و جعلها طراز قمص طلعة حضرة کینونته
subjects: @transcendence; unknowability of God, @The Primal Will; self-generation of the Primal Will, @the Imamate; the Caliphate

title: Ziyarat for the first [to believe]
first_line: Verily all glory be upon thee, O primal temple, and all majesty be upon thee, and all beauty be upon thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: و إنما البهاء علیک ان یا هیکل الأول ثم الجلال علیک ثم الجمال علیک

title: Javabu'l-Fa'
first_line: Glorified art Thou, O Lord my God! I and all things bear witness unto Thee that verily Thou art God, and that there is none other God but Thee, alone, without peer. Thine is the Kingdom and the Dominion, Thine the Glory and the Power, Thine the Might and the Empyrean, Thine the Strength and the Brilliance, Thine the Sovereignty and the human realm, Thine the Glory and the Majesty, Thine the Splendor and the Perfection, Thine the Countenance and the Beauty, Thine the Mercy and the Bounty, Thine the Awe and the Justice, Thine the Symbol and the Similitudes, Thine the Stations and the Reverence, Thine the Power and the Action, Thine the Joy and the Words [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحانک اللهم یا الهی لاشهدنک و کل شیء علی انه لا اله الا انت وحدک لا شريک لک  لک الملک و الملکوت و لک العزة و الجبروت و لک القدرة و اللاهوت و لک القوة و الياقوت و لک السلطنة و الناسوت و لک العزة و الجلال و لک الطلعة و الکمال و لک الوجهة و الجمال و لک الرحمة و الفضال و لک الهيبة و العدال و لک المُثُل و الأمثال و لک المواقع و الإجلال و لک القوة و الفعال و لک البهجة و المقال

title: Du'a' li'l-Ithbat (prayer of affirmation)
first_line: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thine Own Primal Nature, which transcendeth and standeth far above all things, to aid every being marked with the letter Alif who is connected to the Tree of Truth, through Thy power over all things [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحانک اللهم رب لأسئلنک بأولیتک التی هي ممتنعة فوق کل شيء أن تنصرن کل ذات الف تنسب إلی شجرة الحق بقدرتک على کل شيء

title: Letter to the wife of the Bab, in Maku
first_line: Do not expect any assistance from thy brothers. They will not help; it is enough that they refrain from insults. Overlook their faults. Even Our enemies have not caused the like of what resulted from the acts of Siyyid 118 in Isfahan

title: Admonishment to Najafi in reference to Mulla 'Ali Bastami
first_line: Verily, We raised up 'Alí from His resting-place and sent Him unto thee. Hadst thou recognized Him, thou wouldst have bowed down before Him [3.5s]... Verily, We raised up 'Alí from His resting-place and sent Him unto thee. Hadst thou recognized Him, thou wouldst have bowed down before Him
first_line_orig: انّا بعثنا علياً من مرقده وارسلناه اليک لو عرفته لسجدت بين يديه

title: Letter to Khal-i-Asghar II
first_line: It hath been some time since word hath reached Us from those regions. Though the reason for this silence may lie in the accumulation of sorrows
first_line_orig: هو العلی الاعلی العظیم. مدت زمانی است که از آن طرفها خبری نیست اگر چه سبب تراکم احزان است ولی دنیا را بقائی نیست که انسان را عوارضات عرضیه محزون سازد

title: Epistle to Muhammad Shah 1 (Kitabu'l-Muluk)
Prayer for Laylatu'l-Qadr
first_line: Praise be to God, Who hath created the heavens and the earth by His command, and beyond them those who have believed in God and His signs - these shall verily be gathered unto Him. O my God! How can I call upon Thee, when Thou hast ever been unknowable except through Thine own Self, and shalt ever thus remain [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم. الحمد لله الذى خلق السموات و الارض بامره ثم الذين آمنوا بالله و آياته فاولئك

title: Kitabu'l-'Adl
Letter to the Sharif of Mecca
first_line: O sherif!… All thy life thou hast accorded worship unto Us, but when We manifested Ourself unto thee, thou didst desist from bearing witness unto Our Remembrance
first_line_orig: أن يا شريف...قد عبدتنا في عمرك واذا عرفناك انفسنا ما قلت في حق ذكرنا انّه لعلى حقّ منيع

first_line: All men have proceeded from God and unto Him shall all return. All shall appear before Him for judgment
first_line_orig: انّما البدء من الله انّما الرّجع اليه انّما العرض عليه انّما النّشر اليه والبعث اليه

first_line: …Throughout eternity Thou hast been, O my Lord, and wilt ever remain the One true God, while all else save Thee
first_line_orig: يا الهي انت الحقّ لم تزل وما سواك محتاجٌ فقير وانا

title: Farewell address to the Letters of the Living
first_line: O my beloved friends! You are the bearers of the name of God in this Day. You have been chosen as the repositories of His mystery
first_line_orig: ای یاران عزیز من شما در این ایام حامل پیام الهی هستید خداوند شما را برای مخزن اسرار خویش انتخاب

first_line: O Muhit! You regard yourself as one of the most outstanding figures of the Shaykhi community

title: Words to Mulla Husayn
first_line: The days of our companionship are approaching their end... In this pilgrimage upon which We are soon to embark, We have chosen Quddus as Our companion.

title: Words spoken at the examination in Tabriz
first_line: I am, I am, I am the promised One! I am the One whose name you have for a thousand years invoked

first_line: O God, my God! Would that a thousand Ishmaels were given Me, this Abraham of Thine
subjects: @sacrifice of self; mystery of sacrifice, @teaching the Cause; call to teach, @martyrs and martyrdom, @suffering and imprisonment, @Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael, @power of prayer

first_line: May God requite you for your noble intentions. So lofty a purpose is to Me

first_line: O thou who art the first to believe in Me! Verily I say, I am the Báb, the Gate of God, and thou art the Babu'l-ab
