title: Words spoken at the Bab's martyrdom
first_line: Had you believed in Me, O wayward generation, every one of you would have followed

title: Words uttered at the Shrine of Imam Husayn
first_line: O God, my God, my Beloved, my heart's Desire!

title: Words to Manuchihr Khan
first_line: When We departed from Shiraz, cholera raged over the province of Fars, and Husayn Khan escaped with all deliberate speed from the city

title: Words to Manuchihr Khan
first_line: In the presence of God, there is no past, present, or future. There is an eternal now

title: Words to Shaykh Hasan-i-Zunuzi, upon revealing a commentary on the Qur'an
first_line: Which do you prefer, this commentary which I have revealed, or the Ahsanu'l-Qisas, My previous commentary on the Surih of Joseph? Which of the two is superior, in your estimation?

title: Words to the people of Mecca, from the Kaaba
first_line: I am the Qa'im whom you were expecting!! I am the Qa'im whom you were expecting!! I am the Qa'im whom you were expecting!!
first_line_orig: انّى انا القائم الذى كنتم به تنتظرون انّى انا القائم الذى كنتم به تنتظرون انّى انا القائم الذى كنتم به تنتظرون

title: Kitab-i-Aqdas (The Most Holy Book)
first_line: The first duty prescribed by God for His servants is the recognition of Him Who is the Dayspring of His Revelation and the Fountain of His laws
first_line_orig: ان اول ما کتب الله علی العباد عرفان مشرق وحیه و مطلع امره الذی کان مقام
notes: LAC.213-257, ROB3.275 et al, BKOG.351 et al, GPB.206 et al, EBTB.155, EBTB.189, MMAH.199, GSH.133, LL#027

title: Kitab-i-Iqan (The Book of Certitude)
first_line: No man shall attain the shores of the ocean of true understanding except he be detached from all that is in heaven and on earth....  Verily He Who is the Daystar of Truth and Revealer of the Supreme Being holdeth, for all time, undisputed sovereignty…. But, O my brother, when a true seeker determineth to take the step of search…
first_line_orig: الباب المذکور فی بیان ان العباد لن یصلن الی شاطی بحر العرفان الا بالانقطاع

title: Kitab-i-'Ahd (Book of the Covenant)
first_line: Although the Realm of Glory hath none of the vanities of the world, yet within the treasury of trust and resignation
first_line_orig: اگر افق اعلی از زخرف دنیا خالیست ولکن در خزائن توکل و تفویض از برای وراث

title: Kitab-i-Badi'
first_line: Thy letter, containing certain unsubstantiated accounts and false reports, was received by this servant. On the one hand, it opened the portals of joy… By God! The relationship between the Revelation of the Primal Point (the Bab) and this most wondrous, this most glorious Revelation is identical to that of the Revelation of John, son of Zechariah (John the Baptist), and the Spirit of God (Jesus)... It would be more acceptable in My sight for a person to harm one of My own sons or relatives rather than inflict injury upon any soul
first_line_orig: مکتوبت که مشعر بر بعض روایات غیرمحققه و اخبارات غیرصادقه بود باین عبد فانی

title: Lawh-i-Ibn-i-Dhi'b (Epistle to the Son of the Wolf)
first_line: Praise be to God, the Eternal that perisheth not, the Everlasting that declineth not, the Self-Subsisting that altereth not.... O God, my God! Attire mine head with the crown of justice... Thou seest me, O my Lord, with my face turned towards the heaven
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الباقی بلا فناء و الدائم بلا زوال و القائم بلا انتقال المهیمن

title: Lawh-i-Sarraj
first_line: Thy letter hath been made present before the Throne and hath reached the Seat of Him Who is known through naught else but Himself, and that which it contained [3.5s]... ...Shake off, O heedless ones, the slumber of negligence, that ye may behold the radiance which His glory hath spread through the world.
first_line_orig: نامه آنجناب بین یدی العرش حاضر و بر مقر انه لایعرف بما سواه واصل و ما فیه

title: Suriy-i-Haykal (Surih of the Temple)
first_line: Glorified is He Who hath revealed His verses to those who understand. Glorified is He Who sendeth down His verses to those who perceive…. By those words which I have revealed, Myself is not intended, but rather He Who will come after Me.
first_line_orig: سبحان الذی نزل الایات لقوم یفقهون سبحان الذی ینزل الایات لقوم یشعرون سبحان

first_line: Praise be unto God Who hath fulfilled His promise and sent down the Promised One from the heaven of His Will, making manifest that which was inscribed... The first Light hath appeared, shone forth, gleamed and flashed [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی وفی بالوعد و انزل الموعود من سماء مشیته و اظهر ما کان مسطورا... اول نور ظهر و اشرق و لاح و ابرق

first_line: In this day the rustling of the Divine Lote-Tree hath been raised up, and the Sun of Utterance hath dawned and shone forth from the horizon of the heaven of inner meanings, and the Path hath been made manifest [3.5s]... ...The days of the Manifestations of God have, in one sense, been referred to as the Day of God. Yet these days, as they are mentioned in all the Holy Books… How can I choose to sleep, O God, my God, when the eyes of them that long for Thee are wakeful... I have risen this morning by Thy grace, O my God, and left my home trusting wholly in Thee... This, Thy servant, seeketh to sleep in the shelter of Thy mercy... I have wakened in Thy shelter, O my God
first_line_orig: امروز حفیف سدره منتهی مرتفع و آفتاب بیان از افق سماء معانی مشرق و لائح صراط

first_line: Praise be unto Him Who is unique in His love and singular in His affection; verily, He is the Lord of all beings and the Sovereign of creation [3.5s]... ...The companions of God are, in this day, the lump that must leaven the peoples of the world. They must show forth such trustworthiness, such truthfulness and perseverance, such deeds and character that all mankind may profit by their example
first_line_orig: الحمد للّه الذی تفرد بالمحبة و توحد بالوداد انه لمولی العباد و مالک الایجاد

title: Tablet of the Sun of Truth
first_line: Sanctified praise, transcendent above the tongues of all created things and hallowed beyond the mention of all beings, befitteth the sacred court of the Ancient King [3.5s]... ...Praise be to Thee, O Lord, my Best Beloved! Make me steadfast in Thy Cause and grant that I may be reckoned among those
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از السن ممکنات و منزه از ذکر موجودات ساحت قدس سلطان قدمی را سزا است

title: Javahiru'l-Asrar (Gems of Divine Mysteries)
first_line: O thou who treadest the path of justice and beholdest the countenance of mercy! Thine epistle was received, thy question was noted
first_line_orig: یا ایها السالک فی سبل العدل و الناظر الی طلعه الفضل قد بلغ کتابک و عرفت سوالک

first_line: Glory be unto Him Who hath rent asunder the veils on the Day of Return, and shattered the idols of vain imaginings through the Name of the Lord of all Days [3.5s]... ...The purpose of interpretation is this: that none become deprived of that which is evident, and be veiled from that which is intended
first_line_orig: البهاء لمن خرق الاحجاب فی یوم الماب و کسر اصنام الاوهام باسم مالک الایام ... قَد جِئت بِاَمرِ الله وظَهَرت لِذکره وخُلِقْت لِخدمتهِ العزیز المحبوب

first_line: All praise be unto God - praise wherewith the clouds pour forth their rain, and through which they who are nigh unto Him perceive the fragrance of the garment of their Lord, the All-Bountiful - praise [3.5s]
first_line_orig: لله الحمد حمدا یمطر به السحاب و یجد المقربون عرف قمیص ربنا الوهاب حمدا

title: Lawh-i-Istintaq (Tablet of the Interrogation)
first_line: Glorified art Thou, O Thou through Whom the Essence is realized within the Essence, and the Ancient Being is adorned with the mantle of Names [3.5s]... ...My name is Bahá’u’lláh (Light of God), and My country is Núr (Light). Be ye apprized of it.
first_line_orig: سبحانک یا من بک حقق الذات فی الذات و تردی کینونة القدم برداء الاسماء... این عبد تا ان یوم از لسان عظمت ایات قهریه باین شان استماع ننموده

first_line: Praised be our Lord, Who hath revealed from the droplet the waves of the sea and from the atom the rays of the sun [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لربنا الذی اظهر من القطره امواج البحر و من الذره انوار الشمس و فصل من

first_line: O 'Andalib! Hearken unto the Call, for verily it appeareth at one time in the name of the Beloved, and at another time in Mine Own name, the Well-Beloved, and again at times [3.5s]... ...The Hand of Omnipotence hath established His Revelation upon an unassailable, an enduring foundation. Storms of human strife are powerless to undermine its basis… O people of the earth! Make not the religion of God a cause of variance among you.
first_line_orig: یا عندلیب اسمع الندآء انه یظهر مره باسم الحبیب و اخری باسمی المحبوب و تاره

first_line: Praise be unto Him Who hath, through His sovereignty, manifested whatsoever He hath willed, and Who hath adorned this Day through its connection with His Name, as recorded in the Books of Heaven [3.5s]... ...One day during My childhood, I set out intending to visit the grandmother of the Most Great Branch at a time when she was the wife of Mirza Isma'il-i-Vazir
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی اظهر بسلطانه ما اراد و زین الیوم بنسبته الیه و سمیه فی کتب السماء

first_line: The perspicacious soul hath ever been moved to shame and contrition, inasmuch as he describeth Him Who is the Purpose of all existence [3.5s]... ...Say:  O concourse of Persian divines In My name ye have seized the reins of men, and occupy the seats of honor, by reason of your relation to Me
first_line_orig: انسان بصیر لازال منفعل و خجل چه که وصف مینماید مقصودیرا که جمیع ارکان

title: Tafsir-i-Hurufat-i-Muqatta'ih (Commentary on the Disconnected Letters) = Lawh-i-Ayat-i-Nur (Tablet of the Verse of Light)
first_line: Praise be to God who created the letters in the worlds of the divine Cloud beyond the pavilions of holiness… Know that the first tokens brought into existence by the pre-existent Cause in the worlds of creation are the four elements… Strive therefore to recognize amongst the primary substances those things which are in equilibrium
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی خلق الحروفات فی عوالم العما خلف سرادقات القدس فی رفارف الاسنی

title: Suriy-i-Muluk
first_line: This is a Tablet from this Servant, who is called ?usayn in the kingdom of names, to the concourse of the kings of the earth.
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من هذا العبد الذی سمی بالحسین فی ملکوت الاسما الی ملوک الارض کله

first_line: Praise and glory beseem that Desired One of all the worlds, Who hath unlocked the gates of exposition through the letters and through the Word [3.5s]... ...Ponder and reflect upon that which hath come to pass: The sister of this Wronged One hath been miles distant from the truth while the aforementioned handmaid hath attained nearness... We have consented to bear the afflictions of the earth for the sake of exalting the blessed and Most Sublime Word
first_line_orig: حمد و ثنا مقصود عالمیان را لایق و سزاست که بحروف ابواب بیان را گشود و بکلمه

title: Tablet to Varqa I
first_line: Sanctified praise, transcendent above all mention of glorification and exaltation, beseemeth the court of that Divine Object of all desire, Who [3.5s]... ...This heedless and prattling have understood this Revelation to be like unto the events of the past. Up to this moment they have not comprehended
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از ذکر تقدیس و تنزیه و فوق آن بساط حضرت مقصودی را لایق و سزاست که

first_line: Glorified art Thou, O Thou through Whose Name the sincere have hastened to the Dayspring of the lights of Thy countenance, and they who are nigh have rushed unto the Orient of Thy signs [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحانک یا من باسمک سرع الموحدون الی مطلع انوار وجهک و المقربون الی مشرق آیات

first_line: Praise be unto God Who hath gladdened His servant through the sweet-scented breezes of the utterance of His chosen ones, they whose faces He hath graciously preserved from turning unto aught else but Him [3.5s]... ...Glory be unto Thee, O Thou by the sweetness of Whose utterance they that uphold Thy oneness have hastened unto the threshold of Thy door
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی سر خادمه بنفحات بیان اولیائه الذین کرم وجوههم عن التوجه الی غیره

first_line: The Most Exalted Pen hath stirred, and desireth to make mention of His loved ones who have turned themselves unto the Dawning-Place of Revelation [3.5s]... ...My God, my God! Separation from Thee hath destroyed me, and the sorrow of Thine exile and the hardship Thou hast sustained in Thy path hath consumed me…  My God, my God! If Thou prevent me from drawing nigh unto Thee, being present before Thy throne... My God, my God! Thou dost behold the impoverished one who hath stood at the gate of Thy wealth, the ailing one
first_line_orig: قد تحرک القلم الأعلی و اراد ان یذکر اولیائه الذین اقبلوا الی مشرق وحی

first_line: Praise be unto Him Who is the All-Desired One, unto Whom belongeth all glory and majesty, Whose power hath prevailed over the clamor of the opposers, the tumult of the transgressors, and the might of the oppressors [3.5s]... ...The question of the Huquq dependeth on the willingness of the individuals themselves. From every true believer who is willing to tender the Right of God spontaneously
first_line_orig: حمد حضرت مقصودی را لایق و سزاست که غوغای معرضین و ضوضای معتدین و سطوت ظالمین

first_line: Glorified and sanctified is our Lord, the Lord of the angels and the Spirit! The revealed verses have encompassed the world and the clear evidences [3.5s]... ...O thou who gazest towards the Supreme Horizon, upon thee be the Glory of God, the Lord of men. The intention of "the Kingdom" (Malakut) in its primary sense and degree is the scene of the transcendent glory
first_line_orig: سبوح قدوس ربنا و رب الملائکه و الروح آیات منزله عالم را فراگرفته و بینات

first_line: Praise befitteth the Best-Beloved Who, through His pure and consummate power, created the heavens of utterance [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد محبوبی را لایق و سزاست که بقدرت کامله بحته خود خلق فرمود سموات بیان را

first_line: Sanctified praise, transcending reality and metaphor, beseemeth and befitteth the Most Exalted Lord, Who from the Point hath fashioned the four pillars [3.5s]... ...On the first day that the Ancient Beauty ascended His Most Great Throne in the garden named Ri?ván, the Tongue of Glory gave utterance to three blessed words.
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از حقیقت و مجاز حضرت بینیازیرا لایق و سزاست که از نقطه چهار رکن

title: Suriy-i-Nush
first_line: Glorified be He Who hath sent down the verses in truth unto the Prophets and Messengers, and Who doth now send down what hath ever been [3.5s]... ...Announce unto My servants the advent of the One Who came unto them with the power of truth bearing the name of ‘Alí
first_line_orig: فسبحان الذی نزل الایات بالحق علی النبیین و المرسلین و ینزل حینئذ علی ما کان

title: Lawh-i-Ruh
first_line: Glorified be He in Whose grasp lieth the dominion of the realm of verses, Who directeth them as He pleaseth through His command [3.5s]
first_line_orig: فسبحان الذی فی قبضته ملکوت ملک الآیات یصرفها کیف یشآء بأمر

first_line: Praise be unto Him Who hath adorned Himself with utterance and Who alone possesseth expression, He before Whom the oceans of inner meanings have bowed down whensoever [3.5s]... ...He it is Who in the Old Testament hath been named Jehovah, Who in the Gospel hath been designated as the Spirit of Truth… the task of executing the laws, the ordinances and statutes that have been sent down in the Book hath been delegated unto the men of the divine Houses of Justice [rijal-i-buyut-i-'adliyyih-yi-ilahiyyih]... It is beloved of God that all should speak in Arabic, which is the richest and vastest of all languages
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی توحه بالکلام و تفرد بالبیان الذی خضعت بحور المعانی عندما

title: Suriy-i-Sabr (Lawh-i-Ayyub)
first_line: This is the remembrance of God in the City of Patience regarding Job, Our servant, Whom We sheltered under the shade of that Holy Tree planted in His heart
first_line_orig: ذکر الله فی مدینه الصبر عبده ایوبا اذ آویناه فی ظل شجره القدس فی فواده و اشهدناه

first_line: No soul has or will ever comprehend the essence of divine wisdom.  In reality, the rational mind is a most great sign in humans and blessed are those who realize (its potential)
first_line_orig: حمد محبوبی را لایق و سزاست که باصبع قدرت حجبات مجلله عظیمه را خرق فرمود و

first_line: Sanctified praise, transcending word and utterance, befitteth and beseemeth the Sovereign of unfading majesty, Who hath revealed all sacred books and scriptures [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از لفظ و بیان سلطان بیزوالی را لایق و سزاست که جمیع کتب و صحف و زبر

first_line: Praise and thanksgiving befit the people of God in such wise - they who in their inmost beings surge like an ocean [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد و شکر در مقامی حزب الله را لایق و سزاست آنانکه در باطن بمثل بحر مواجند و

title: Lawh-i-Sultan
first_line: O King of the Earth! Hearken unto the call of this Vassal: Verily, I am a Servant Who hath believed in God
first_line_orig: یا ملک الارض اسمع ندآء هذا المملوک انی عبد آمنت بالله و آیاته و فدیت نفسی فی

first_line: O Ibrahim! Indeed thy name hath been mentioned in this most exalted station before the presence of the Lord of all mankind [3.5s]... ...O Lord my God! Thy knowledge of me doth verily surpass my understanding of my own self. I implore Thee to enable me to so rise to serve Thee
first_line_orig: یا ابراهیم قد حضر اسمک فی هذا المقام الاعلی امام حضور مولی الوری ذکرک

first_line: Sanctified praise, free from the taint of extinction and decay, befitteth the most holy and exalted court of the Eternal One [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از شائبه فنا و زوال ساحت امنع اقدس حضرت لایزالی را لایق و سزاست که

title: Lawh-i-Jamal-i-Burujirdi II
first_line: All praise be unto Him Who hath become one through His majesty, Who standeth alone in His grandeur, Who is sanctified above all weariness, and Who is exalted beyond all earthly hopes and desires [3.5s]... ...We verily mention Our friends collectively, greet them from the direction of My Prison, send them salutations and remember them every morn and eve… Detachment is as the sun…
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی توحد بالجلال و تفرد بالاجلال و تقدس عن الملال و تنزه عن الامال

first_line: Praise be to Him Who hath sent down that which lay concealed in the heaven of His will, and revealed that which was treasured within His knowledge [3.5s]... ...The Afnans arrived in Beirut. After some time they received permission to come in small groups. Finally, they entered the shelter of grace
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی انزل ما کان مکنونا فی سماء مشیته و اظهر ما کان مخزونا فی علمه

first_line: Glorified is God, the Lord of the earthly realm and the Kingdom above, glorified is God, the Possessor of majesty and omnipotence, glorified is God! [3.5s]... ...As for thy mention of the Obligatory Prayer: in truth, anyone who readeth this with absolute sincerity will attract all created things
first_line_orig: سبحان الله مالک الملک و الملکوت سبحان الله صاحب العز و الجبروت سبحان الله

first_line: Praise be to the Lord of the Worlds, Who hath summoned all peoples, as one, through His Most Great Name, in such wise that [3.5s]... ...As to the question thou has asked concerning the minimum amount of property on which Huquq is payable, this was mentioned in His exalted and glorious presence and the following is what the Tongue of Grandeur uttered… Blessed is he who in the prime of his youth and the heyday of his life
first_line_orig: حمد مولی العالم را سزاست که جمیع امم را وحده باسم اعظم دعوت نمود بشانی که

first_line: This is the Day of Return and the Lord of all necks is established upon the Throne of Utterance and doth summon all the peoples of the world [3.5s]... ...Another letter of thine, which made mention of the hallowed and blessed days of Ri?ván, was received.... Blessed is the house that hath attained unto My tender mercy... We have enjoined upon all to become engaged in some trade or profession, and have accounted such occupation to be an act of worship
first_line_orig: یوم یوم ماب است و مالک رقاب بر عرش بیان مستوی و احزاب عالم را ندا میفرماید

first_line: O Beloved of My heart! Where is the All-Hearing, and where is the All-Seeing? The Verses do speak, the clear Signs proclaim, the Sun beareth witness, and the Moon testifieth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا محبوب فوادی این السمیع و این البصیر آیات ناطق بینات متکلم شمس شاهد ماه و

title: Haft Vadi (The Seven Valleys)
first_line: Praise be to God Who hath made being to come forth from nothingness; graven upon the tablet of man a measure of the mysteries of His eternity
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی اظهر الوجود من العدم و رقم علی لوح الانسان من اسرار القدم و

first_line: Praise be to God Who hath manifested through the Alif the Most Great Steadfastness, and through the Bá the station of distinction between all things [3.5s]... ...In regard to what thou hast written concerning his honour the learned Sahib, upon him be the grace of God... And that which you have mentioned about Shalmaghani and what Shalmaghani has uttered in relation to this Supreme Manifestation of God
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی اظهر من الالف الاستقامه الکبری و بالباء شان الامتیاز بین الاشیاء... استدعای دیگر آنکه خدمت جناب صاحب یگانه سلام برسانید انشآءالله در این دار فانی بامری فائز شوند

title: Lawh-i-Nasir
first_line: The Pen of the Most High hath never ceased to make mention of the names of His loved ones…. All praise be unto Thee, O Lord, in that Thou hast sent down from the heaven of Thy bounty that whereby the worlds are purified
first_line_orig: قلم اعلی لازال بر اسم احبای خود متحرک و جاری و آنی از فیوضات لابدایات خود

first_line: This is a Book from which the trees inhale the fragrance of springtime, and from which the sons perceive the sweet perfume of their tender, bountiful Father [3.5s]... ...The beginning of all things is the knowledge of God, and the end of all things is strict observance of whatsoever hath been sent down
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب یجد منه الاشجار عرف الربیع و الابناء رآئحه الاب المشفق الکریم

first_line: The servant beareth witness unto that which God Himself hath witnessed, and acknowledgeth that which the Most Exalted Pen hath acknowledged ere the creation of all things, that verily He [3.5s]... ...And now concerning thy question about the Manifestations of God. Know thou that, even in the wombs of their mothers, the Manifestations possessed stations
first_line_orig: شهد الخادم بما شهد الله و اعترف بما اعترف به القلم الاعلی قبل خلق الاشیاء انه

title: Suriy-i-Qamis
first_line: O ye dwellers in the immortal realm on high! Hearken unto the Call of God from this stirring Breeze that moveth in this atmosphere [3.5s]... ...By the righteousness of God! These are the days in which God hath proved the hearts of the entire company of His Messengers and Prophets… Whosoever ariseth to aid our Cause God will render him victorious over ten times ten thousand souls
first_line_orig: ان یا اهل البقا فی الملا الاعلی اسمعوا ندآء الله عن هذا النسیم المتحرک فی هذا الهواء

title: Ishraqat (Splendours)
first_line: Praise be unto God, incomparable in majesty, power and beauty, peerless in glory, might and grandeur… I magnify Thy Name, O my God, and offer thanksgiving
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی تفرد بالعظمه و القدره و الجمال و توحد بالعزه و القوه و الجلال و

first_line: Praise be to God Who hath manifested His Countenance after the extinction of all things, and hath stirred up the Kingdom of Names through the movement of His Pen [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی اظهر الوجه بعد فناء الاشیاء و هز ملکوت الاسماء باهتزاز قلمه

first_line: O spiritual youth! Upon thee be the eternal Glory of God! Thy letter hath attained unto the presence of His Sacred and Most Exalted Court and hath been graciously heard [3.5s]... ...My God, my God! Do Thou adorn Thy servants with the vesture of understanding,and ordain for them such as shall bring them ever nearer to Thy horizon
first_line_orig: یا جوان روحانی علیک بهاء الله الابدی نامه شما در ساحت عز احدیه بشرف اصغاء

first_line: God, no God is there but Him, Who speaketh in all things. Verily, there is none other God but Him. His is the glory and the majesty [3.5s]... ...Soon will the cry, 'Yea, yea, here am I, here am I' be heard from every land. For there hath never been, nor can there ever be, any other refuge to fly to for anyone

first_line: Sanctified praise, transcending all mention and hearing, befitteth the Lord of Names, Who, from the Sun in the heaven of knowledge, illumineth the world [3.5s]... ...Thou hast written that one of the friends hath composed a treatise. This was mentioned in the Holy Presence, and this is what was revealed in response… Whatever is written should not transgress the bounds of tact and wisdom
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از ذکر و اصغا مالک اسما را لایق و سزاست که از آفتاب آسمان علم عالم

title: Suriy-i-Hajj I (Shiraz)
first_line: These are the verses of God which have been sent down in this hour from the Focal Point of eternity, that Station round which circle the dwellers of the pavilion [3.5s]... ...O Muhammad, when the fragrances of holiness have drawn thee unto them and turned thee unto the land of the All-Merciful that thou mayest discover the breezes of divine praise
first_line_orig: تلک آیات الله قد نزلت حینئذ عن قطب البقاء مقام الذی یطوفن فی حوله اهل سرادق

first_line: Sanctified praise, transcending the mention of servants and the remembrance of contingent beings, befitteth the most holy and most exalted Court of the Desired One [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از ذکر خادم و ذکر ممکنات بساط امنع اقدس حضرت مقصودیرا لایق که

title: Lawh-i-Abdu'r-Razzaq
first_line: Thy letter hath attained unto the Most Great Horizon, and from the garment of its words wafted the sweet-scented fragrance of love for the Lord of Names and Attributes [3.5s]... ...As to thy question concerning the origin of creation. Know assuredly that God’s creation hath existed from eternity, and will continue to exist forever… Thou hast asked Me whether man, as apart from the Prophets of God…
first_line_orig: مکتوب آنجناب بمنظر اکبر وارد و از قمیص کلماتش نفحات حب مالک اسما و صفات

title: Suriy-i-Sultan
first_line: These are the verses of God, sent down in truth from the dominion of eternity, and God hath made them a testimony from His presence [3.5s]
first_line_orig: تلک آیات الله قد نزلت بالحق من جبروت البقاء و جعلها الله حجه من عنده و

first_line: Praise be unto Him Who is the Best-Beloved of all possibility and the Goal of the peoples of the world, Who hath graciously confirmed His chosen ones [3.5s]... ...Say: O men! This is a matchless Day. Matchless must, likewise, be the tongue that celebrateth the praise of the Desire of all nations
first_line_orig: حمد محبوب امکان و مقصود عالمیان را لایق و سزا است که اولیای خود را موید فرمود

first_line: By Thy life, O Beloved of my inmost being and Thou Who art enshrined within my heart, were the very essence of thanksgiving to manifest itself through a hundred thousand tongues [3.5s]
first_line_orig: لعمرک یا محبوب ذاتی و المذکور فی قلبی اگر کینونت شکر بصد هزار لسان ظاهر شود

title: Hurufat-i-'Alin (=Kalimat-i-'Uliya; the Exalted Letters)
first_line: Pure and sanctified art Thou, O my God! How can the pen move and the ink flow after the breezes of loving-kindness have ceased

title: Lawh-i-Salman I
first_line: O Salman! Pass through the realm of being and existence with holy breezes from the City of the Spirit, wafting with the fragrances of the All-Merciful [3.5s]... ...O Salmán! Say: O people! Tread ye in the path of the one true God and ponder the ways and words of Him Who is the Manifestation

first_line: His is the grace and munificence, His the loving-kindness and bestowal. He giveth and withholdeth, for verily He is the All-Powerful, doing whatsoever He willeth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: له الفضل و الجود و له العنایه و العطاء یعطی و یمنع انه هو المقتدر ما یشاء لا

first_line: Praise be unto God! Thanks be unto His loved ones, and glory unto His chosen ones who have not altered His bounty, who have arisen to serve Him, and who have given freely [3.5s]

title: Suriy-i-Hajj II (Baghdad)
first_line: Glorified be He Who hath sent down the verses in truth and doth send down through His command whatsoever He willeth. There is no God but Him, the Mighty [3.5s]... ...I beg Thy forgiveness, O Lord, with the entirety of my being—my tongue, my heart, my breath, my soul, my spirit, my body...  It is incumbent on whomsoever desireth to turn to the most holy direction, to come into the presence of God, the Mighty, the Knowing, to hearken unto the call of God
first_line_orig: فسبحان الذی نزل الایات بالحق و ینزل بامره کیف یشاء لا اله الا هو العزیز

first_line: Praise be to God Who hath uttered a word in the world, and the peoples differed as to its meaning. Among them were those who recognized [3.5s]... ...O Zayn! Such souls as comply with the injunction of God prescribed in the Book are regarded as most excellent in the same estimation of God… O Thou Who art the Lord of all names! I beseech Thee by Thy Name which overshadoweth all things
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی نطق بکلمه فی العالم و اختلفت الاحزاب فی معناها منهم من عرف

We created thee according to these Most Beautiful Names. If thou art able to separate anything in heaven or on earth and marry all of it together again

first_line: Praised be God Who hath manifested through the influence of His Most Exalted Pen unto all who dwell in the kingdom of creation, whereupon every weary one hath spoken [3.5s]... ...Vie ye with each other in the service of God  ...Let not the happenings of the world sadden you. I swear by God! The sea of joy yearneth… Blessed is the spot, and the house… Regarding what ye had written as to the Mashriqu’l-Adhkár’s having been established… It is the binding command of God that in every locality whatever hath been or will be made available for the ?uqúqu’lláh should be submitted to His Holy Presence

first_line: The servant in attendance hath attained unto the precincts of his Lord's mercy, and, having washed his face and hands, hath turned toward the Most Exalted Summit [3.5s]... ...The kings have recognized that it was not in their interest to acknowledge Me, as have likewise the ministers and the divines

Unto God be praise that you were illumined… the treatment is specially designed so that this precious, life-giving substance, which has appeared from the divine mine, may be purified... The appearance of this hidden treasure amongst these people [arbab-i-ulum] is the sign of the coming of age of the world
first_line_orig: کتاب مرسله در ساحت احدیه وارد و ما فیه مشاهده شد لله الحمد که در این فجر... و اینکه سئوال از قول ماریه نمودید

first_line_orig: انک انت یا الهی لما استویت علی کرسی عز فردانیتک و تعلیت علی عرش رحمت

title: Suriy-i-Dhikr
first_line: This is the Súrih of Remembrance, sent down as a token of grace, that perchance the people of the Bayán might renounce that which they possess
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب نقطه الاولی الی الذینهم آمنوا بالله الواحد الفرد العزیز العلیم و فیه یخاطب

first_line: Praise be to God Who hath manifested Himself and revealed His sovereignty, and enforced His command in such wise as to subdue the world and cause the peoples to give utterance [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی ظهر و اظهر سلطانه و انفذ امره علی شان سخر العالم و انطق الامم علی

first_line: Praise befitteth and is worthy of the Most Holy, Most Exalted Court of the Divine Object of all desire, Who hath enabled His branches to arise in defense of the Tree [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد بساط امنع اقدس حضرت مقصودی را لایق و سزاست که افنانش را بر نصرت سدره

first_line: In these days doth the Alif, which standeth upright and through whose arising the world was raised up, lament, and the helpless Há weepeth from both eyes [3.5s]... ...I swear by God! In those days the equivalent of all that hath been sent down aforetime unto the Prophets hath been revealed
first_line_orig: این ایام الف قائمه که از قیامش عالم قیام نمود نوحه مینماید و هاء مسکین از دو چشم

first_line: God willing, may they ever continue to drink from the inexhaustible chalice of His bountiful grace, and with hearts attuned to His mention [3.5s]
first_line_orig: انشاء الله لم یزل و لایزال از کاس عنایت بیزوال بیاشامند و بذکر

first_line: Blessed be this Day wherein the horizon of utterance hath been illumined and the All-Merciful hath been established upon the throne of grandeur and benevolence [3.5s]... ...To discharge one's obligations is highly praiseworthy in the sight of God. However, it is not permitted to solicit Huquq from anyone
first_line_orig: تبارک الیوم الذی فیه انار افق البیان و استوی الرحمن علی عرش العظمه و الاحسان

first_line: Praise, sanctified above the recognition of all contingent beings, befitteth the most sacred court of His Holiness, the Self-Subsisting Lord, Who by a word [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از عرفان من فی الامکان ساحت اقدس حضرت قیومی را لایق و سزاست که بکلمه

first_line: Praise be unto God, Who hath sent down the Sacred Books and sent forth His Messengers, making them the lamps of His guidance amidst His creation. Through them He hath distinguished [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی انزل الکتب و ارسل الرسل و جعلهم سرج هدایته بین خلقه بهم فرق

title: Namaz-i-Hajat and instructions re ablutions
first_line: O Pen of the Most High! Make mention of him who is immersed in the seas of doubt and passion, that perchance thou mayest purify him
first_line_orig: ان یا قلم الاعلی ذکر الذی غرق فی ابحر الظن و الهوی لعل یخلصه ما یجری عنک و

title: Chihar Vadi (The Four Valleys)
first_line: O light of truth and sword of faith And soul of generosity!  No prince hath sky or earth begot
first_line_orig: ای ضیاء الحق حسام الدین راد که فلک و ارکان چه تو شاهی نزاد نمیدانم چرا

first_line: Praise, sanctified beyond the utterance and mention of all who dwell within the realm of contingent being, befitteth the hallowed court of nearness unto the Best-Beloved [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از بیان و ذکر من فی الامکان بساط قرب قدس حضرت محبوبی را لایق و

title: Tarazat (Ornaments)
first_line: Praise and glory beseem the Lord of Names and the Creator of the heavens, He, the waves of Whose ocean of Revelation surge… Glory be unto Thee, O Lord of the world
first_line_orig: حمد و ثنا مالک اسما و فاطر سما را لایق و سزاست که امواج بحر ظهورش امام وجوه

first_line: The convulsions of the tribes have seized them, and trembling hath encompassed the dwellers of the earth, save whom God willeth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: زلازل قبائل را اخذ نمود و اضطراب سکان ارضرا احاطه کرد الا من شاء الله ظاهر شد

first_line: O Haydar-Qabl-'Alí! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness. Convey, on behalf of this Wronged One, greetings unto His honor the Wanderer, and say [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا حیدر قبل علی علیک بهائی و عنایتی جناب سیاح را از قبل مظلوم سلام برسان بگو

first_line: Praise be to the Sovereign of existence and the Lord of the seen and unseen, Whom the clamor of the divines and the opposition of the doctors of law [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مالک وجود و سلطان غیب و شهودیرا لایق و سزاست که ضوضای علما و اعراض فقها

first_line: O Nabil-i-'Ali! Upon thee be My glory, My remembrance and My praise! Blessed art thou, inasmuch as thou hast attained unto My presence and hearkened unto My voice [3.5s]... ...Should a man appear ere the lapse of a full thousand years - each year consisting of twelve months
first_line_orig: یا نبیل قبل علی علیک بهائی و ذکری و ثنائی طوبی لک بما حضرت لدی الوجه و سمعت

first_line: Although at the commencement of every epistle it is incumbent, nay obligatory, upon every soul to make mention of the One Friend, the Peerless Beloved, and the Ultimate Goal [3.5s]
first_line_orig: اگرچه اول هر نامه بر هر نفسی لازم بل واجب ذکر دوست یکتا و محبوب یکتا و مقصود

first_line: The Book which the Wronged One hath sent down is verily the sealed Wine from God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting. Blessed is he who [3.5s]
first_line_orig: کتاب انزله المظلوم انه لهو الرحیق المختوم من لدی الله المهیمن القیوم طوبی لمن

first_line: All praise, sanctified beyond the understanding of created things, befitteth Him Who is the Lord of our hearts' Desire, Who, with but a single glance of loving-kindness, causeth the merest atom [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از عرفان کائنات حضرت مقصودیرا لایق و سزاست که بیک نظر عنایت ذره را

title: Lawh-i-Jawhar-i-Hamd I
first_line: The essence of praise and the pure essence of glorification beseemeth the holy court of the Beloved One, Who hath ever been sanctified from [3.5s]
first_line_orig: جوهر حمد و ساذج ثنا بساط قدس حضرت محبوبیرا لایق و سزاست که لمیزل مقدس از

first_line: The essence of remembrance and praise, and the quintessence of glorification, befitteth the people of understanding, the Party of God, whom the tempests [3.5s]
first_line_orig: جوهر ذکر و ثنا و لطیفه مدح اولی النهی حزب الله را لایق و سزاست که قواصف

first_line: A praise transcending the comprehension of all the peoples of the world befitteth the Lord of contingent being Who, through His all-encompassing Will [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از ادراک عالمیان مقصود امکان را لایق و سزاست که باراده محیطه اش

first_line: O Ahmad! Hearken unto the Call from the direction of Supreme Glory, from the Divine Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing, upon the right hand of the luminous Spot, that verily [3.5s]... ...As for obligatory prayer, it hath been sent down by the Pen of the Most High in such wise that it setteth ablaze the hearts
first_line_orig: یا احمد اسمع الندآء من شطر الکبریاء من سدره المنتهی عن یمین بقعه النورآء انه

first_line: A remembrance from Our presence unto those who have held fast to the mighty Cord of God and have clung to the hem of the robe of their Lord, the All-Forgiving, the Most Bountiful [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکر من لدنا للذین تمسکوا بحبل الله المتین و تشبثوا باذیال ردآء ربهم الغفور الکریم

first_line: Praise be unto the most holy Court of the Desired One, Whose power is sanctified above all the powers of the world [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد ساحت اقدس حضرت مقصودیرا لایق و سزاست که قدرتش مقدسست از قدرتهای عالم و

first_line: Praise befitteth the Beloved One Who hath caused the Sun of the Most Exalted Word to move from the horizon of the Tablet through the stirring of the Supreme Pen [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد محبوبی را لایق و سزاست که آفتاب کلمه علیا را از افق لوح بحرکت قلم اعلی

first_line: Glorified be He Who hath illumined the horizon of utterance with the Sun of His Most Great Remembrance, whereat the limbs of the peoples have trembled [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحان من انار افق البیان بشمس ذکره الاعظم الذی به ارتعدت فرائص الامم الذین

first_line: A praise sanctified beyond the knowledge of all created things befitteth that Ancient Being Who hath ever been and shall ever be [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از عرفان موجودات حضرت بیزوالی را لایق و سزا که لم یزل و لایزال

first_line: Glorified be He Who hath illumined the horizon of the world through the radiance of His Most Great Name, whereby all the tribes were seized with trembling [3.5s]... ...There can be no doubt that whatsoever hath been revealed from the All-Glorious Pen, be it ordinances of prohibitions, conferreth benefits upon the believers themselves
first_line_orig: سبحان من انار افق العالم بنیر اسمه الاعظم الذی به اخذت الزلازل کل القبائل

first_line: Praised be thy deed, O thou who hast attained unto tribulation in the path of God, the Creator of heaven! Blessed art thou, O thou who hast quaffed the cup [3.5s]
first_line_orig: لله عملک یا من فزت بالبلاء فی سبیل الله فاطر السماء نعیما لک یا من شربت کاس

first_line: God is Most Glorious! The Sun of Splendor hath appeared and been made manifest through the Beauty of the Unseen from the Treasury of Mystery, and thereby was It raised up [3.5s]

first_line: A remembrance from Our presence unto him who hath turned unto God, the Lord of all worlds, who hath attained unto His Book in the Most Great Prison, and who hath achieved [3.5s]... ...Thou hast asked Me concerning the nature of the soul. Know, verily, that the soul is a sign of God, a heavenly gem whose reality the most learned of men hath failed to grasp
first_line_orig: ذکر من لدنا لمن اقبل الی الله رب العالمین و حضر کتابه فی السجن الاعظم و فاز

first_line: Praise be to God, Who hath raised up the heaven of utterance and adorned it with luminous stars and illumined its horizon with the sun of remembrance [3.5s]

first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی کان باقیا ببقاء کینونیته و دائما بدوام ازلیته الذی خلق

first_line: This is a Book from Our presence unto him who hath been named the Beloved, that he may be remembered through the remembrance of God - and verily his mention was foreordained [3.5s]... ...Glory be unto Thee, O Lord my God! Purify the hearts of Thy servants with the waters of Thy mercy and loving-kindness
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من لدنا الی الذی سمی بالحبیب لیکون بذکر الله مذکورا و ان ذکره سبق

first_line_orig: یوم الله آمد سریر بیان در قطب امکان ظاهر و مکلم طور بر آن مستوی فرات رحمت از

title: Suriy-i-Qalam
first_line: O Pen of the Most High! Bear thou witness, in thine own self, that verily He is God and that there is none other God but Me
first_line_orig: ان یا قلم الاعلی ان اشهد فی نفسک بانه هو الله لا اله الا انا المهیمن القیوم

first_line: The Sovereign of the Divine Realm and King of Life Who dieth not  hath so established and ornamented the Kingdom of Majesty and Beauty  and the Spiritual Realm of Might
first_line_orig: ملکوت جلال و جمال و جبروت عظمت و اجلال سلطان لاهوت و ملیک حی لایموت را

first_line: The winds of hatred have encompassed the Ark of Ba??á, by reason of that which the hands of the oppressors have wrought

first_line_orig: ایام ایام فرح جدید است چه که در مدینه عشاق عاشقی بکام دل رسید و بما هو

first_line: All praise be unto the Intended One and the Sovereign of existence, Who through the radiant beams of the Sun of His Revelation [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد حضرت مقصود و سلطان وجودی را لایق و سزاست که از پرتو انوار آفتاب ظهور

first_line: Blessed is He in Whose hand is the Kingdom of all things. He createth whatsoever He willeth through a command from His presence, and verily He hath power over all things [3.5s]... ...That so brief a span should have separated this most mighty and wondrous Revelation from Mine own previous Manifestation, is a secret that no man can unravel
first_line_orig: تبارک الذی بیده ملکوت کل شیء یخلق ما یشاء بامر من عنده و انه کان علی کل شیء

first_line: Praise be unto the Beloved, Who alone is worthy and deserving, Who hath guided His friends unto the streams of His mercy and enlightened them [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد محبوبی را لایق و سزاست که دوستان را بجانب فرات رحمت خود راه نمود و آگاه

first_line_orig: یا ملا الارض اسمعوا ندآء المظلوم من شطر السجن انه یقربکم الی الله المهیمن

title: Suriy-i-Fadl
first_line: O Dhabih! We did verily send unto thee aforetime a Tablet, mighty and impregnable, wherein was inscribed that which God hath made a testimony unto all who dwell therein [3.5s]... ...Say: By God! The Sovereign of Words hath assuredly come upon the clouds of the verses, and lo, the words of every contentious polytheist were thunderstruck
first_line_orig: ان یا ذبیح انا ارسلنا الیک من قبل لوحا ممتنعا منیع و فیه ذکر ما جعله الله حجه علی من فی

first_line: These are the verses of God, revealed in truth, and verily they are the spirit of life unto the denizens of the celestial concourse and a heavenly feast [3.5s]

first_line: Sanctified praise, transcending the mention of pen and ink, befitteth the Lord of creation, Who through His blessed and exalted Word [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از ذکر قلم و مداد مالک ایجاد را لایق و سزاست که بکلمه مبارکه علیا

title: Lawh-i-Balaya - Tablet of Tribulations
first_line: Hearken, O Mahdi, unto the call of Him Who is drowning in a sea of tribulation.
first_line_orig: یا مهدی استمع ندآء من کان متغمسا فی بحر البلاء و اذا تمهله الامواج یرفع راسه

title: Lawh-i-Pap (Tablet to Pope Pius IX)
first_line: O Pope! Rend the veils asunder. He Who is the Lord of Lords is come overshadowed with clouds, and the decree hath been fulfilled by God
first_line_orig: ان یا پاپا ان اخرق الاحجاب قد اتی رب الارباب فی ظلل السحاب و قضی الامر من

title: Suriy-i-Qada
first_line: O `Ali! Hearken ye unto the Call of God, thy Lord, from the right-hand side of the Divine Throne, proclaiming "I, verily, I am God, no God is there except I Myself
first_line_orig: ان یا علی اسمع ندآء الله ربک عن یمین العرش بانی انا الله لا اله الا انا المهیمن القیوم

first_line: O Ism-i-Júd! Thou Who surpasseth the number of raindrops, and art inscribed according to the measure of knowledge, the scriptures, the holy books and whatsoever lieth beneath them [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا اسم جود الواج بعدد امطار و کتب علی عدد العلم و الزبر و الصحف و ما دونها ما

first_line: Praise be unto the Omnipotent Hand that hath raised aloft the Standard of Trustworthiness and cast down the decree of treachery, and through the light [3.5s]... ...There are various stages and stations for the Fast and innumerable effects and benefits are concealed therein… In clear cases of weakness, illness, or injury the law of the Fast is not binding
first_line_orig: ستایش ید قدیری را سزاست که علم امانت برافراخت و حکم خیانت برانداخت و بنور

first_line: O Qhulam Qabl-'Alí! Time and again hath thy mention been made in the presence of the Wronged One, as have likewise the letters which thou didst address to the loved ones of God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا غلام قبل علی مکرر ذکرت در ساحت مظلوم مذکور و همچنین نامهائیکه باولیای الهی

first_line: O Muhammad-Qablí-'Alí! The successive letters sent unto thee by the beloved ones of the land of Khá - upon them be My Glory - have been received [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا محمد قبل علی نامهای متتابعه احبای ارض خا علیهم بهائی که بشما فرستادند عبد

first_line: In this day the Sun proclaimeth "The All-Bountiful is come!", and all things cry out "The Creator of the heavens is come!" The Divine Lote-Tree speaketh forth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: امروز آفتاب بقد اتی الوهاب ناطق و اشیاء بقد اتی فاطر السماء متکلم سدره منتهی

title: Suriy-i-Vafa (=Lawh-i-Vafa)
first_line: O Vafa! Render thanks unto thy Lord for having aided thee to embrace His Cause, enabled thee to recognize the Manifestation... As to thy question concerning the worlds of God
first_line_orig: ان یا وفاء ان اشکر ربک بما ایدک علی امره و عرفک مظهر نفسه و اقامک علی ثناء ذکره

first_line: O friends! The falsehood of the past hath hanged the Beloved of a later day, and martyred Him with the leaden bullets of tyranny. Ponder ye upon the souls [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ای دوستان کذب قبل محبوب بعد را آویخت و برصاص ظلم شهید نمود تفکر در نفوس

first_line: Praise befitteth the most exalted, most holy court of the Beloved One, Who hath set His loved ones ablaze with the fire of His love [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد ساحت امنع اقدس حضرت محبوبی را لایق و سزاست که اولیائش را بنار محبتش مشتعل

first_line: My spirit and my soul be a sacrifice unto Thee! From the intimations of the divine Words, this servant hath thus understood that in the Manifestation [3.5s]
first_line_orig: روحی و نفسی لک الفداء از تلویحات کلمات الهیه چنان مفهوم این عبد شده که در ظهور

title: Suriy-i-Dam
first_line: O Muhammad! Hearken unto the call of thy Lord from this Station whereunto the hands of all created things cannot attain [3.5s]... ...Adorn thyself with My virtues, in such wise that should anyone stretch forth the hand of oppression against thee, thou wouldst neither take notice nor contend with him.
first_line_orig: ان یا محمد اسمع ندآء ربک عن هذا المقام الذی لن یصل الله ایدی الممکنات و لا

first_line: The Supreme Pen hath made mention of the loved ones of God in the most eloquent language, and now, in sweeter Persian, doth proclaim [3.5s]... ...Say, O friends! The former lying caused the succeeding Beloved to be hanged and martyred by the bullet of opposition.
first_line_orig: قلم اعلی اولیای الهی را بلغت فصحی ذکر فرمود حال بلسان پارسی احلی میفرماید... بگو ای دوستان کذب قبل محبوب بعد را آویخت و برصاص ظلم شهید نمود تفکر در نفوس کاذبه

first_line: Praise be unto the most holy and exalted court of the Beloved One, Who hath, through a single point of knowledge, in very truth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد ساحت اعز اقدس حضرت محبوبی را سزاست که بیک نقطه علمیه فی الحقیقه اینفانی

first_line: This is the Day whereon the Herald hath proclaimed: "The sovereignty belongeth unto God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting! The mysteries have been revealed and laid bare." [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا یوم فیه نادی المناد الملک لله المهیمن القیوم قد ظهرت الاسرار و کشفت

first_line: Praise be unto God Who hath perfumed the world with the fragrant breezes of His Revelation and illumined the hearts of the sincere ones [3.5s]... ...Upon thee be the peace of God, the Possessor of the earth and the Creator of the heavens

first_line_orig: یا اسم جود نامه علی اصغر علیه بهائی که بانجناب نوشته در ساحت اقدس بشرف اصغاء

first_line: O my God and my Beloved! I know not how to make mention of Thee, nor by what means I may remember Thee, inasmuch as I behold that the very essence of remembrance [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا الهی و محبوبی لم ادر کیف اذکرک و بم اذکرک بعد الذی اری بان حقیقه الذکر

first_line: O Ali, upon thee be My glory! The letter from the honoured Samandar, upon him be My glory, which he addressed unto thee, hath reached this Servant [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا علی علیک بهائی مکتوب جناب سمندر علیه بهائی که بشما نوشته عبد حاضر لدی

first_line: O Beloved of My Heart! Although at the beginning of every utterance, every book, and every scroll there must needs be mention of God, exalted be His glory [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا محبوب فوادی اگرچه اول هر کلام و هر کتاب و هر دفتر باید بذکر حق جل جلاله

first_line: O Nabil, son of Nabil! Sorrows from every direction have encompassed the Wronged One, and this grief is not on account of imprisonment [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا نبیل بن نبیل مظلوم را احزان از هر شطری احاطه نموده و این حزن نه از جهت سجن

first_line: O Nabíl! Upon thee be My salutation! Thou hast ever been and art remembered. There hath befallen thee that which befell the Wronged One [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا نبیل علیک سلامی لازال مذکور بوده و هستی بر تو وارد شد آنچه بر مظلوم وارد

first_line: Hearken unto that which the Beauty of Manifestation singeth forth upon this Mount and in this blessed spot which hath been raised above [3.5s]
first_line_orig: اسمعی ما یغن جمال الظهور فی هذا الطور علی هذه البقعه المبارکه التی ارتفعت عن

first_line: On this day We awoke, and there were present before Our face the images of Our loved ones in 'Ishqábád. Unto each one We have revealed [3.5s]
first_line_orig: اصبحنا الیوم و کان حاضرا امام الوجه صور اولیائی فی عشق آباد انزلنا لکل واحد

first_line: Praise be to God Who hath manifested that which was sanctified above all knowledge, recognition and comprehension [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی اظهر ما کان مقدسا عن علم کلشیء و عرفان کلشیء و ادراک کلشیء

first_line: Praise be to God, Who hath strengthened His chosen servants and His pure handmaidens to recognize the Dawning-Place of His Self and the Orient [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی اید عباده الاصفیاء و امائه الزاکیات علی عرفان مطلع نفسه و مشرق

first_line: Praise be to the Praised One, the Desired One, Who created Muhammad - peace be upon Him - through the sovereignty of might and power, and sent Him forth with truth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لمحمود و مقصود خلق محمدا ص بسلطان القوه و الاقتدار و بعثه بالحق و

first_line: Hearken unto that which the Tongue of God inspireth thee from His sacred, mighty and impregnable dominion, that perchance thou mayest hear the Call [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان استمع ما یلهمک لسان الله عن جبروته المقدس العزیز المنیع لعل تسمع ندآء

first_line: O Name of God! Hearken unto the melodies of the Spirit and turn not unto them that have denied God and His signs [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا اسم الله اسمع نغمات الروح و لاتلتفت الی الذینهم کفروا بالله و آیاته و

first_line: O thou Countenance resplendent with the lights of the Morn of Oneness, speaking forth from the effulgence of eternity [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا ایتها الطلعه المتجلیه من انوار صبح الاحدیه و المستحکیه عن اشراق الازلیه

first_line: O remnant of My lineage! Hearken thou unto My call from the direction of My Throne, that the melodies of the All-Merciful may draw thee unto a station that [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا بقیه آلی اسمع ندائی عن شطر عرشی لتجذبک نغمات الرحمن الی مقام کان عن

first_line: O servant! Your letter hath come before Our presence, and We have understood that which was therein, and verily God is the All-Knowing of what lieth within thy heart [3.5s]... ...And now concerning thy reference to the existence of two Gods. Beware, beware, lest thou be led to join partners with the Lord, thy God
first_line_orig: ان یا عبد قد حضر بین یدینا کتابک و عرفنا بما فیه و کان الله علی ما فی قلبک علیما

first_line: O Ali! Hearken unto that which thy Lord, the Sorrowful, the Lonely One, Who is encompassed by griefs from every side, revealeth unto thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا علی ان استمع ما یوحی الیک ربک المحزون الغریب الذی احاطته الاحزان من کل

first_line: O Nabíl, thy supplications have been laid before Us and thy cry hath reached Our ears, yet the answer thereto remaineth suspended until the appointed time, for certain souls at present [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ای نبیل عرایضت معروض و ندایت مسموع و اجابت آن معلق بوقت چه که بعضی حال در این

first_line: In these days the manifestations of divine grace and the effulgences of the Light of the All-Merciful Sun are manifest and visible from every direction [3.5s]
first_line_orig: این ایام ظهورات فضل الهی و تجلیات نور نیر رحمانی از هر جهتی ظاهر و هویدا هر

title: Lawh-i-Bulbulu'l-Firaq (Tablet of the Nightingale of Bereavement)
first_line: The nightingale of separation, perched upon the branch of the horizon, calls out in grief, you who are filled with yearning
first_line_orig: بلبل الفراق علی غصن الافاق ینادی هذا الفراق یا ملا الاشتیاق و طیر الوفا یتغن

first_line: These are the verses of God, sent down in truth from the realm of the Most Glorious Name, wherein is that which shall sever all the worlds from whatsoever [3.5s]
first_line_orig: تلک آیات الله قد نزلت بالحق من جبروت اسم بهیا و فیه ماینقطع العالمین عما

first_line: Praise befitteth the Lord of Names and the Sovereign Who doeth as He willeth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مالک اسما و سلطان یفعل ما یشاء را لایق و سزاست که ظلم معتدین و اعراض

first_line: Sanctified praise, exalted above the comprehension of created things and the understanding of contingent beings, befitteth the most luminous and holy court of the Desired One [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از ادراک کائنات و عرفان ممکنات لایق بساط انور اقدس حضرت مقصودی

first_line: Praise that is sanctified beyond all tongues and pens, and exalted above the comprehension and minds of all who dwell within the realm of contingent being, belongeth unto His most sacred court [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از السن و اقلام و منزه از ادراک و عقول من فی الامکان ساحت امنع

first_line: Praise and glorification befit the Desired One of all the worlds, Who, through the hands of His clear and binding laws, hath raised up a mighty stronghold [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد و ثنا مقصود عالمیان را لایق و سزاست که بایادی احکام شرع مبین حصن متین

first_line: This evanescent servant was gladdened by beholding thy letter. God willing, mayest thou remain forever eloquent in remembrance of the immortal Purpose [3.5s]
first_line_orig: خادم فانی بمشاهده کتاب آنجناب مسرور انشاء الله لازال بذکر مقصود بیزوال ناطق

first_line: A remembrance unto him who hath attained unto the lights of divine knowledge in the days of his Lord, the Most Merciful, that the fragrance of remembrance might draw him unto a station that calleth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکری لمن فاز بانوار العرفان فی ایام ربه الرحمن لیجذبه عرف الذکر الی مقام یدع

first_line: Glorified be God Who hath manifested His Cause and made all things speak forth that there is none other God but Him, the Truth, the Knower of things unseen [3.5s]... ...Happy is the man who will arise to serve My Cause, and glorify My beauteous Name. Take hold of My Book with the power of My might
first_line_orig: سبحان الله اظهر امره و انطق الاشیاء علی انه لا اله الا هو الحق علام الغیوب

first_line: O my God! Every night do I burn with the fire of separation from Thee, and every day am I gladdened by the wondrous tokens of Thy grace [3.5s]
first_line_orig: فیا الهی فی کل اللیالی احترق بنار فراقک و فی کل الایام ابتهج ببدایع افضالک

title: Second Tablet to Faris
first_line: Thy letter hath come before Our Countenance, and from it We have inhaled the fragrance of love and affection; wherefore this Tablet hath been sent down unto thee [3.5s]... ...The Breath hath been wafted, and the Breeze hath blown, and from Zion hath appeared that which was hidden, and from Jerusalem is heard the Voice of God
first_line_orig: قد حضر کتابک لدی الوجه و وجدنا منه عرف الحب و الوداد لذا نزل لک هذا اللوح

first_line: My Supreme Pen hath testified from the direction of the luminous Spot at the Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing that there is none other God but He [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد شهد قلمی الاعلی من شطر البقعه البیضاء من سدره المنتهی انه لا اله الا هو

first_line: The Ocean of Oneness hath surged, and the Ark hath sailed, and the fragrance of God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting, hath wafted. Blessed is he who holdeth fast [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد ماج بحر الاحدیه و سرت السفینه و هاج عرف الله المهیمن القیوم طوبی لمن تمسک

first_line: The Book sent down in truth from the presence of the Wronged One unto him who hath turned toward the Most Exalted Horizon and hearkened unto the rustling of the Divine Lote-Tree [3.5s]
first_line_orig: کتاب نزل بالحق من لدی المظلوم لمن اقبل الی الافق الاعلی و سمع حفیف سدره

first_line: A Book whose verses have been sent down in Arabic, and verily it is a chapter from the Mother Book from the presence of God, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful, wherein is cast [3.5s]
first_line_orig: کتاب نزلت آیاته عربیا و انه فصل من ام الکتاب من لدی الله العزیز الوهاب و فیه یلقی

first_line: The Book proclaimeth the truth and remindeth the people of the signs of God, the Lord of all worlds, and guideth them unto the upright path [3.5s]
first_line_orig: کتاب ینطق بالحق و یذکر الناس بایات الله رب العالمین و یهدیهم الی صراط نصب

first_line: To Him be praise, grandeur and glory, for having ordained for His chosen ones in His presence the blessing of nearness and reunion [3.5s]
first_line_orig: له الشکر و العظمه و البهاء بما قدر لاولیائه فی الحضور نعمه القرب و اللقاء و

first_line: The Purpose of all beings hath, on this blessed night of the month of Ramadan, willed to speak in the luminous tongue [3.5s]
first_line_orig: مقصود عالمیان در این شب مبارک ماه رمضان اراده فرموده بلغت نوراء

first_line: The letter which you had written to this servant, who standeth before the Throne, was mentioned in His presence, and signs of sorrow [3.5s]
first_line_orig: مکتوبیکه بعبد حاضر لدی العرش نوشنه بودید تلقاء وجه مذکور شد و اثار حزن

first_line: This is a remembrance from the Prisoner unto him who hath believed in God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting, that none should be worshipped save Him [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا ذکر من لدی المسجون الی الذی آمن بالله المهیمن القیوم ان لاتعبد الا ایاه

first_line: This is the Day wherein the Trumpet hath been sounded, and it is none other than My Most Exalted Pen, whereby they that lay in the graves have risen, despite those who denied [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا یوم فیه نفخ فی الصور و هو قلمی الاعلی و به قام اهل القبور رغما للذین

first_line: O My Name! The letter of the honored Afnán-Áqá, upon him be My glory and loving-kindness, which was addressed unto thee, hath been laid before Me [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا اسمی مکتوب جناب افنان آقا علیه بهائی و عنایتی که باسم شما بود عبد حاضر لدی

first_line: O thou who art mentioned before the Wronged One! Verily, the Most Exalted Pen hath willed to reveal unto thee the pearls of wisdom [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا ایها المذکور لدی المظلوم ان قلمی الاعلی اراد ان یظهر لک لئالی الحکمه

first_line: O thou who gazest upon the Countenance and standest at the Gate, hearken unto what hath been raised from the rustling of the divine Lote-Tree [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا ایها الناظر الی الوجه و القائم لدی الباب اسمع ما ارتفع من حفیف سدره

first_line: O Beloved of My Heart! That which thou didst write in mention of the solace of Mine eyes, Áqá Siyyid ?usayn, upon him rest the peace of God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا حبیب فوادی اینکه در ذکر قره عین آقا سید حسین علیه سلام الله مرقوم داشتید

first_line: O Zayn, upon whom rest My Glory and My loving-kindness! The souls aforementioned have attained unto the tokens of divine bounty and heavenly grace [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا زین علیک بهائی و عنایتی نفوس مذکوره باثار فضل الهی و عنایت ربانی فائز

first_line: O 'Abdu'l-Husayn! Upon thee be My Glory! The Herald uttereth this word, saying: "I have inscribed an essence in..." [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا عبد الحسین علیک بهائی حضرت مبشر باینکلمه ناطق میفرماید قد کتبت جوهره فی

first_line: O Muhammad-Sádiq! The world hath been illumined by the radiant rays of the Sun of Revelation, yet the people of the veil remain heedless thereof [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا محمد قبل صادق از پرتو انوار آفتاب ظهور عالم منور ولکن اهل حجاب از او غافل و

first_line: O Muhammad-Qulí! Upon thee be My glory! I bear witness that they who have turned unto Mine horizon and attained unto My presence and have drunk [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا محمد قلی علیک بهائی اشهد ان الذین اقبلوا الی افقی و فازوا بلقائی و شربوا

title: Revealed for the Most Great Festival
first_line: Praise be to Thee, O my God, for having cast in this Day the radiance of all Thy names upon all created things, O Thou Who art the Lord of glory
Praise be unto Him Who hath ascended the throne, once in the Ridván, and again in the garden, and at times in [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی استوی علی العرش مره فی الرضوان و اخری فی البستان و طورا فی

first_line: Praise be to God, Who hath raised the banner of divine knowledge upon the standard of learning and utterance, and hath adorned it with the ornament of wisdom and exposition [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی رفع رایة العرفان علی علم العلم و البیان و زینها بطراز الحکمة و التبیان

first_line: Praise be to God Who hath illumined the horizons through the resplendent Light that shineth from the horizon of the heaven of the Hijaz, whereby He hath shed His radiance [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی نور الافاق من النور اللائح المشرق من افق سماء الحجاز و به اضاء

first_line: O people of Bahá! Raise ye the pavilion of holiness upon the shore of this sea, unto which all seas flow [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا اهل البهاء ان ارفعوا سرادق القدس فی شاطی هذا البحر الذی الیه تذهب کل البحار

first_line: O Ali! Bear thou witness in thine inmost heart that verily there is none other God but Him, and that He Who appeared bearing the name of Ali before Nabil, verily He [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا علی ان اشهد فی نفسک بانه لا اله الا هو و ان الذی ظهر باسم علی قبل نبیل انه

first_line: God willing, through the loving-kindness and favors of the Lord of Names, the Cup-bearer of the Wine of Immortality that floweth from the Fountainhead of the Most Exalted Pen [3.5s]... ...This is the Chief of all days and the King thereof. Great is the blessedness of him who hath attained, through the sweet savor of these days, unto everlasting life
first_line_orig: انشاء الله بعنایت و الطاف مالک اسماء ساقی رحیق بقا که از معین قلم اعلی جاری

first_line: God willing, may you at all times and seasons repose beneath the shelter of the All-Merciful and arise in service to the Ancient Beauty [3.5s]
first_line_orig: انشاء الله در جمیع احیان و اوان در ظل رحمن مستریح باشید و بخدمت جمال قدم بین

first_line: O Muhammad! God willing, mayest thou be enkindled even as a fire in the love of the All-Merciful, and be as water beneath the shade of His Lote-Tree [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ای محمد انشاء الله بمثابه نار در محبت رحمن مشتعل باشی و مانند ماء در ظل سدره اش

first_line: O Muhammad! Hearken unto the melody of God that hath descended from the heaven of His glorious Command, and with its potency rend asunder the veils of idle fancy [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ای محمد بشنو نغمه الله را که از سماء عز امر نازل است و حجبات اوهام را بقوت

first_line: Praise be unto the All-Bountiful, All-Merciful Lord, worthy and befitting of praise, Whose Ocean of forgiveness surgeth eternally, and Whose Sea of pardon [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد خداوند کریم رحیمی را لایق و سزا که دریای عفوش لازال مواج و عمان مغفرت و

first_line: Praise befitteth and is worthy of the Beloved, Who hath quickened the hearts of the sincere ones and them that are nigh through the Kawthar of divine knowledge [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد محبوبی را لایق و سزاست که از کوثر عرفان قلوب مخلصین و مقربین را زنده و

first_line: Sanctified praise, transcending the mention of contingent things, the comprehension of created beings, and the knowledge of all existence, befitteth His most holy Court [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از ذکر ممکنات و ادراک کائنات و علم موجودات ساحت امنع اقدس را لایق

first_line: Sanctified praise, above all mention and utterance, befitteth the Object of all creation, Who through His consummate power hath revealed His words [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از ذکر و بیان مقصود امکان را لایق و سزاست که بقدرت کامله خود کلمات

first_line: Sanctified praise, from the realms of meaning and utterance, befitteth and beseemeth the Beloved of all possibility, through His blessed Name [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از عوالم معانی و بیان محبوب امکان را لایق و سزا است که باسم مبارکش

first_line: Praise befitteth the Desired One, Who hath ordained the glad tidings of His friends' well-being to be among the choicest bounties of the world [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقصودی را لایق و سزاست که مژده صحت دوستانرا از بهترین نعمتهای عالم مقرر

first_line: Praise befitteth and beseemeth the Creator of all possibilities, Who hath made utterance the Dawning-Place of wisdom, will and knowledge [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد موجد امکان را لایق و سزا که بیان را مطلع حکمت و اراده و علم فرمود اوست

first_line: Behold the remembrance of thy Lord's mercy unto His servant Muhammad, who migrated unto God and entered the City at the time when he departed therefrom [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکر رحمه ربک عبده محمد الذی هاجر الی الله و دخل فی المدینه حین الذی خرج عنها

first_line: Glorified be He Who hath sent down the verses in truth from the realm of transcendent glory and made them a testimony from His presence unto [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحان الذی نزل الایات بالحق من جبروت عز علیا و جعلها حجه من عنده علی

first_line: Glory be unto Thee, O Thou Who art the Lord of all names and the Fashioner of the heavens! Iam Thy servant and the son of Thy servant and Thy handmaid
first_line_orig: سبحانک اللهم یا اله الاسماء و فاطر السماء انا عبدک و ابن عبدک و ابن امتک

first_line: Praise be to Thee, O Lord my God! Thou beholdest what the tongue of no one except Thee can utter
first_line_orig: سبحانک اللهم یا الهی تری ما عجزت السن ما سواک عن ذکره و تشهد ما تکلکل عن

first_line: Glorified art Thou, O my God, Lord of mankind, Sovereign of destiny and Manifestation of the hidden Mystery! The mystics stand bewildered [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحانک اللهم یا سید البشر و مالک القدر و مظهر السر المستسر قد تحیر العارفون

first_line: The Hidden One beareth witness unto My Name, the Self-Subsisting, that verily there is no God but Me, the Almighty, the Best-Beloved. The Treasured One beareth witness thereof [3.5s]
first_line_orig: شهد المکنون لاسمی القیوم انه لا اله الا انا العزیز المحبوب شهد المخزون و انه

first_line: Glorified be He Who hath sent down the verses in truth, that His proof might be manifest unto all the worlds and His Cause thereby revealed [3.5s]
first_line_orig: فسبحان الذی نزل الایات بالحق لیکون حجته علی العالمین مبینا و لیظهر بها امره

first_line: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I make mention of Thee in this moment wherein the doves of Thy sacred sovereignty warble their melodies and the rains descend [3.5s]

title: Huwa Munfikhu'r-Ruh (Lawh-i-Nuqtih?)

first_line_orig: حمد خدا را که عیون حیوان غیبی که در حجبات ستر الهی مستور بود بتاییدات روح

first_line: Praise befitteth and beseemeth the Beloved of the world, Who, through the blessedness of the Most Great Name, hath quickened them that were dead [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد محبوب عالم را لایق و سزاست که بمبارکی اسم اعظم مرده گان را زنده نمود و

first_line: Praise, sanctified beyond all mention and utterance, befitteth and is meet for the Lord, Who hath, through the sweet fragrances, caused the world of contingent being [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از ذکر و بیان پاک یزدانرا لایق و سزاست که عالم امکانرا از نفحات

first_line: Praise be unto the Desired One, Who is worthy and befitting of all glorification, Who hath through His special favors singled out one party from among all the parties of the world [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقصودی را لایق و سزا که حزبی از احزاب عالم را بعنایات مخصوصه فائز

first_line: The mention of God hath arisen from the Sacred Tree in that spot which God hath blessed above all the regions of earth - there is no God but Him [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکر الله فی شجره القدس بقعه التی بارکها الله علی بقاع الارض الله لا اله الا

first_line: O wondrous Remembrance and new Adornment, O fresh Thought and boundless Knowledge, unto Him Whom our description cannot reach and Whose praise [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکر بدیع و طراز جدید و فکر تازه و علم بی اندازه آنکه وصف ما باو نرسد و ثنای

first_line: A remembrance from Our presence unto him who hath turned toward the Most Exalted Horizon and hath quaffed the sealed wine from the hand of divine bounty [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکر من لدنا لمن اقبل الی الافق الاعلی و شرب الرحیق المختوم من ید عنایه عطاء

first_line: Remember thou My servant who soared in the atmosphere of his Lord, the All-Merciful's love, with spirit and sweet fragrance, and whom the attraction of the Call did seize [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکری عبدی الذی طار فی هوآء محبه ربه الرحمن بالروح و الریحان و اخذه جذب الندآء

first_line: Glorified be He Who speaketh at the heart of the world and summoneth the peoples unto the eternal, everlasting Law [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحان الذی ینطق فی قطب العالم و یدع الامم الی الشریعه الباقیه الابدیه التی

first_line: Glory be unto God! In certain stations, the mention of detachment is sweeter than that of acquisition; nay, in one station man [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحان الله در بعضی از مقامات ذکر ترک احلی از اخذ است بلکه در یکمقام انسان از

first_line: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him. His is all creation and command; all are His worshippers. God testifieth that there is none other God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: شهد الله انه لا اله الا هو له الخلق و الامر کل له عابدون شهد الله انه لا اله

first_line: God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him, and He Who hath appeared in truth - He, verily, is the One mentioned in former ages [3.5s]
first_line_orig: شهد الله انه لا اله الا هو و الذی ظهر بالحق انه لهو المذکور فی القرون الاولی

first_line: The Tongue of Grandeur beareth witness to His Manifestation, to His establishment upon the throne, and to His dawning from the horizon of the world, yet the peoples [3.5s]
first_line_orig: شهد لسان العظمه بظهوره و استوآئه علی العرش و اشراقه من افق العالم ولکن الامم

first_line: By Him Who is the Great Announcement! The All-Merciful is come invested with undoubted sovereignty. The Balance hath been appointed
first_line_orig: ص و النبا العظیم قد اتی الرحمن بسلطان مبین و وضع المیزان و حشر من علی الارض

first_line: Most mighty ambassador, most noble minister, allow me to say that the tribulations of these servants have reach such a point that pen and ink are powerless to record them.
first_line_orig: عرض این بنده خدمت سفیر اعظم و وزیر اکرم آنکه بلایای این عباد به مقامی رسیده که قلم و مداد از تحریر آن عاجز

first_line: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Thou art He Who hath created the heavens through the Pen of Thy creation and the earths through the breaths [3.5s]
first_line_orig: فسبحانک اللهم یا الهی انت الذی خلقت السموات من قلم ابداعک و الارضین من نفحات

first_line: That which flowed from thy pen hath reached Him Who causeth the rivers of everlasting life to stream forth amidst all created things and the crystal waters of mercy [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد حضر ما جری من قلمک عند مجری انهار الحیوان بین الامکان و سلسبیل رحمه

title: Commemoration of the anniversary of the Declaration of the Bab
first_line: Lo, the Tongue of Glory hath called aloud and the Word of God hath cried out, proclaiming: The Kingdom is God’s
first_line_orig: قد نطق اللسان باعلی البیان و نادت الکلمه باعلی الندآء الملک لله خالق السماء و

first_line: All glory be unto Thee, O Lord of Names, Who hast turned joy to sorrow and raised up the pavilions of grief on Thy feast day [3.5s]
first_line_orig: لک البهاء یا مالک الاسماء بما بدلت الفرح بالغم و نصبت خیام الاحزان فی عیدک

first_line: We have come for the remembrance, and Our mention is a reminder unto the servants, guiding them towards the Remembered One, and when from the Most Exalted Horizon [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ما از برای ذکر آمده ایم و ذکر ما تذکر عباد است بسوی مذکور و چون از افق اعلی

first_line: The purpose of the victory that hath been mentioned in all the Tablets hath been clear to the loved ones of God, exalted be His remembrance [3.5s]... ...God, singly and alone, abideth in His Own Place, which is holy above space and time, mention and utterance, sign, description and definition, height and depth.
first_line_orig: مقصود از نصرتیکه در جمیع الواح ذکر شده معلوم احباء الله بوده که حق جل ذکره

first_line: The letter of your eminence reached this servant, and after being presented, these words flowed forth from the tongue (...) [3.5s]
first_line_orig: مکتوب آنجناب باین عبد واصل بعد از معروض داشتن باین کلمات دریات لسان (...)

first_line: The letter thou didst send unto this Wronged One hath reached the Most Great Prison and been perused [3.5s]
first_line_orig: مکتوبیکه باین مظلوم ارسال داشتی در سجن اعظم وارد و مشاهده شد

first_line: The missive of that faithful friend hath been received, and inasmuch as it testified to thy health and well-being, great joy was attained thereby [3.5s]
first_line_orig: نامه آن دوست باوفا رسید چون مشعر بر صحت و سلامتی آنجناب بود مسرت حاصل گشت از

first_line: The manifold points emanating from the inverted point, who consider themselves to be in the station of the Primal Point and Manifestation, lay claim to the station of Moses [3.5s]
first_line_orig: نقاط منشعبه از نقطه معکوسه که خود را در مقام نقطه و ظهور میدانند داعی مقام موسویت

first_line: The missive of your honor hath been received. Praise be to God that we are gathered beneath the shade of His grace and are sustained by the fruits of His bounty [3.5s]
first_line_orig: نوشته آنجناب رسید حمد خدا را که در ظل عنایت محشوریم و بثمره مکرمت متنعم و

first_line: This is a Book that hath been sent down in truth, that by it the lights of God, the All-Subduing, may illumine the hearts of them that have believed [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب قد نزل بالحق لیستضی ء به فی قلوب الذینهم آمنوا انوار الله المهیمن

first_line: This is a glorious Book sent down in truth from the presence of the Mighty, the All-Knowing. Verily, it is the Spirit of the Cause whereby the hearts are quickened [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب کریم نزل بالحق من لدن عزیز علیم انه لروح الامر یحیی به افئده

first_line: This is a Book from Our presence unto him who hath turned unto his Lord, the All-Merciful, in these days wherein the people are sorely perturbed [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من لدنا لمن اقبل الی ربه الرحمن فی هذه الایام التی فیها اضطرب اهل

first_line: This is a Book from the presence of Bahá unto him whom God hath shielded in these days [3.5s]

first_line: As the hope of reunion waxeth stronger, so doth it add intensity to the fire of longing; wherefore must the body be strong to bear it [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هر قدر امید وصال قوت گیرد آتش شوق را قوت افزاید لذا بدنی قوی باید تا حمل آن

first_line: O Amin! Upon thee be My glory! In these days time is even as a faithful bird, nay rather, as the supreme elixir in the eyes of the people of the world [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا امین علیک بهائی این ایام وقت بمثابه طیر وفا یا اکسیر اعظم نزد اهل دنیا

first_line: O Haydar-'Alí! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness. The Book of Certitude hath, in accordance with divine command, been made to conform and be corrected [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا حیدر قبل علی علیک بهائی و عنایتی کتاب ایقان حسب الامر بمطابقه و تصحیح آن

first_line: O Beloved of My heart! The answer to thy letters hath been penned, yet in this instance, mindful of postal limitations [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا محبوب فوادی جواب دستخطهای آنمحبوب نوشته شد ولکن این کره نظر بحجم پوسته

first_line: O Muhammad-Ridá! God willing, mayest thou be aided through the loving-kindness of the Best-Beloved of all worlds, and drink from the choice wine of His utterance [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا محمد رضا انشاء الله بعنایت محبوب عالمیان فائز باشی و از رحیق بیانش بیاشامی

first_line: Praise be to God Who hath subdued the world through His sovereignty and drawn the nations through His signs, before Whom all things stand in acknowledgment [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی سخر العالم بسلطانه و اجتذب الامم بایاته الذی اعترف کلشیء

first_line: The Mother of Utterance proclaimeth and saith: "The Sovereign hath come - dominion belongeth unto God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting!" The Mother of the Qur'an calleth aloud [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ام البیان ینطق و یقول قد اتی المالک الملک لله المهیمن القیوم ام الفرقان ینادی

first_line_orig: ان یا حسین اسمع ندآء هذا المظلوم الذی ابتلی بین یدی العباد و مااستنصر من احد

first_line_orig: این عبد دستخط آنحضرت را بساحت اقدس ارسال داشت و بانوار منظر اکبر منور و فائز

first_line: The praise of all who praise, the remembrance of them that remember, and the description of such as describe, in truth pertaineth unto creation, for the Source [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد حامدین و ذکر ذاکرین و وصف واصفین فی الحقیقه راجع بخلق است چه که مبدء

first_line: Sanctified praise, beyond all mention and utterance and exalted above all comprehension, be unto the most holy and most glorious court of the Object of all existence [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مقدس از ذکر و بیان و منزه از عرفان ساحت امنع اقدس ارفع مقصود عالمیان را

first_line: Praise and glory, remembrance and splendor be unto the most holy and exalted court of that Beloved One Who hath [3.5s]... ...The law of the Fast is ordained for those who are sound and healthy
first_line_orig: حمد و ثنا و ذکر و بها مخصوص ساحت اقدس امنع حضرت محبوبیست که عالم و امم را از

first_line: Praise and thanksgiving, in truth, on this Day which is mentioned as the Day of God in the Books of God, are specially reserved for His chosen ones [3.5s]

first_line_orig: ذکر من لدنا لمن توجه الی الوجه اذ اعرض عنه اکثر العباد لیقربه الی الله و

first_line_orig: ذکر من لدنا لمن فاز بلقاء المظلوم مره بعد مره و سمع الندآء و دخل المقام

first_line_orig: روحی لحضرتکم الفداء آنچه گرمی هوا در این سنه بر جسد سرایت کرد و علت ضعف

first_line: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him, and He Who speaketh in the Most Great Prison is verily the Source of affliction [3.5s]
first_line_orig: شهد الله انه لا اله الا هو و الذی ینطق فی السجن الاعظم انه لمرجع الباساء

first_line_orig: ع ط غصن اکبر لدی المظلوم حاضر نامه شما را عرض نمود و بشرف اصغا فائز گشت لله

first_line: Another passage concerning what His Holiness the Exalted One—may the spirit of all existence be a sacrifice unto Him—hath ordained regarding inheritance, is as follows [3.5s]

first_line: Thy letter hath reached Our presence and standeth as a testimony to thy love and devotion, thy humility and submissiveness, and thy steadfastness in the Cause [3.5s]
