title: Hur-i-'Ujab (The Wondrous Maiden)
first_line: The hallowed Beauty shone resplendent from behind the veil. How wondrous a thing, how wondrous indeed!
first_line_orig: قد طلع جمال القدس عن خلف الحجاب و ان هذا لشیء عجاب و انصعقت الارواح من نار

first_line: It hath been ordained that every matter shall have its appointed time. When its destined hour cometh, it shall appear with truth, and none can avert it. Thus hath it been decreed in the Tablet [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد قدر لکل امر میقات اذا جاء اجله یاتی بالحق و لامرد له کذلک قدر فی لوح

first_line: The ocean of bounty hath surged as the Supreme Pen moved in remembrance of him who ascended unto the Most Glorious Horizon, through grace [3.5s]

first_line: Praised be Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee by them who have circled round the throne of Thy will

first_line: The Book hath been revealed by the All-Merciful unto them that dwell upon the earth, that they may be acquainted with His Path, be guided unto His Testimony, and be taught [3.5s]
first_line_orig: کتاب انزله الرحمن لمن علی الارض لیعرفهم سبیله و یهدیهم الی دلیله و یعلمهم

first_line: This is the Book which the All-Merciful hath sent down, and verily it is God's proof amidst His creation and His testimony amongst His servants, and to this the tongue doth bear witness [3.5s]
first_line_orig: کتاب انزله الرحمن و انه لبرهان الله بین خلقه و حجته بین عباده و یشهد بذلک لسان

first_line: Thy letter hath attained the Divine Presence and hath been honored with the gaze of loving-kindness of the Lord of all Names. first_line_orig: کتابت لدی الوجه حاضر و بلحاظ عنایات مالک اسماء مشرف طوبی لنفس حضر لدی العرش

first_line_orig: لعمر الله کینونت گفتار اعترف بعجزه عن ذکر ربنا المختار انه لاتدرکه القلوب و

first_line: This is the Book of God, the All-Prevailing, the Self-Subsisting, which hath verily been sent down in truth from the presence of One mighty, well-beloved, and speaketh forth in truth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب الله المهیمن القیوم قد نزل بالحق من لدن عزیز محبوب و ینطق بالحق فی

first_line: This is the Book from Him Who is imprisoned, unto him who believed in the Spirit in His days and was quickened through His Most Great Word that [3.5s]... ...God hath prescribed unto everyone the duty of teaching His Cause
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من لدی المسجون الی الذی آمن بالروح فی ایامه و حی بکلمه الاعظم التی

first_line: This is a Book from Him Who is imprisoned unto him who hath believed in God and was numbered among the faithful in the Tablets [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من لدی المسجون الی الذی آمن بالله و کان من الموحدین فی الالواح

first_line: This is the Book sent down in truth - verily it is a remembrance unto all the worlds, wherein We give them to drink of the Living Waters of Kawthar which flow [3.5s]... ...We have caused thee to return to thy home as a token of Our mercy unto thy mother, inasmuch as We have found her overwhelmed with sorrow… Say, O My people! Show honour to your parents and pay homage to them
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب نزل بالحق انه لذکری للعالمین و فیه ما نسقیهم کوثر الحیوان الذی جری

first_line: This is a Book wherein all good is set forth in detail from God, the Most High, the Most Great, and through which every soul receiveth its portion [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب یذکر فیه کل خیر فصل من لدی الله العلی العظیم و یصل کل نفس رزقها علی

first_line: A luminous leaf that was adorned with the ornament of divine love, from whose sublime and exalted words the fragrance [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ورقه نورانیه که بطراز محبت رحمانیه مزین گشته بود و از کلمات علیه عالیه آن عرف

first_line: O Abú'l-Fa?l! Hearken unto that wherewith the Wronged One remembereth thee from the precincts of the Prison, and summoneth thee unto God, the Single One [3.5s]

first_line_orig: یا اسمی مطالب شما که در ورقه مذکور بنظر مظلوم رسید دیدیم و شنیدیم

first_line_orig: یا امتی و ورقتی علیک بهائی انا سمعنا ندائک اجبناک بهذه الورقه النورآء التی

first_line: O Badí', upon thee and upon thy mother be My glory! Thy letter bearing the name of God, upon Him be Bahá [3.5s]

first_line: O Ali! Upon thee be the peace of God and His loving-kindness! Know thou that, first and foremost, thou must in all circumstances be joyous and radiant [3.5s]... ...Thou shouldst under all conditions be filled with joy, exultation, and gladness. But the manifestation of this station is and hath ever been impossible unless thou holdest fast unto absolute reliance upon God
first_line_orig: یا علی علیک سلام الله و عنایته ذکر اول آنکه باید در جمیع احوال با فرح و نشاط

first_line: O Qhulam Qabl-'Alí! Hearken unto My call from the precincts of My prison once again, for verily it draweth thee nigh unto My court [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا غلام قبل علی اسمع ندائی من شطر سجنی مره اخری انه یقربک الی بساطی

first_line_orig: یا قائم الدین قد قام الدین و ظهر القیام و القوم فی سکر عجاب اخذت الزلازل قبائل

first_line: O Muhammad-Qabli-'Alí! Thou hast attained unto the mention of the Lord of Names and hast hearkened unto the rustling of the Most Exalted Pen [3.5s]

first_line: O Mulla! Hearken to the Call of the Lord of all beings from the precincts of the Prison. Verily, it draweth thee nigh unto God and purifieth thee [3.5s]

first_line: O Mihdi! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness! Praise be to God that the blessed month of Ramadan hath brought its refreshing waters [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا مهدی علیک بهائی و عنایتی الحمد لله رمضان المبارک رطوبات

first_line: O Nazir! Upon thee be the Glory of God, His mercy and His bounty. Thou hast ever been remembered in the presence of this Wronged One [3.5s]

first_line: O My leaf! Upon thee be My glory! Thou hast ever been, and art still, remembered in the presence of the Wronged One, and the glance of His loving-kindness is directed towards thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا ورقتی علیک بهائی لازال در ساحت مظلوم مذکور بوده و هستی لحاظ عنایت بتو

first_line: O My Leaf and My Handmaiden! Hearken unto My call from the precincts of My prison [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا ورقتی و یا امتی اسمعی ندائی من شطر سجنی

first_line: O Joseph! In the nights and days the verses of God have been sent down, His evidences made manifest, His call raised high, and His path [3.5s]

O Ahmad! We have hearkened unto thy call, and revealed unto thee the horizon of Our knowledge, and made mention of thee with that which shall cause thy remembrance to endure [3.5s]

first_line_orig: اسمت لدی العرش مذکور لذا قلم اعلی باسمت جاری و ساری هذا فضل کبیر ان اعرف قدره

first_line: Praise be unto God, Who hath sent forth the Beloved One with the banners of His verses and made Him, from His presence, a Herald to bring unto all the glad-tidings of His grace and mercy, which have preceded the earth and heaven. He is the Mystery [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی ارسل الحبیب برایات الایات و جعله من عنده مبشرا لیبشر الکل بفضله و رحمته التی سبقت الارض و السماء هو السر

first_line: Praise be to God Who hath, through His sovereignty, revealed that which lay hidden within the breasts and the furtive glances of the eyes, even as He hath sent it down in the Qur'an [3.5s]

first_line: Praise be to God Who hath sent down unto His servants the proof, made manifest unto them the path, and caused them to recognize the Dawning-Place of His Cause, the Dayspring of His verses, and the Source [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی انزل لعباده الدلیل و اظهر لهم السبیل و عرفهم مشرق امره و مطلع آیاته و مصدر

first_line: Praise be to God, Who hath spoken a Word whereby the fragrance of utterance was stirred, the ocean of certitude surged, and all things were moved to speech [3.5s]

first_line: O my God, O my God! Thou beholdest my turning towards Thy horizon and my orientation to the lights of Thy Countenance, and my rising to serve Thee and Thy loved ones [3.5s]

first_line: O my God! This is Thy servant upon whose heart's meadows the fragrant breezes of Thy holy love have wafted, and in the atmosphere of whose heart hath shone forth [3.5s]

first_line: In this day, which is the twenty-first of the month of Jamádíyu'l-Avval, this Tablet hath been adorned with the embellishments of the Pen. Praise be unto God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الیوم که بیست و یکم شهر جمادی الاولست این لوح بطراز قلم مزین الحمد لله

first_line: This is a day whose virtues have been extolled aforetime in the divine Books. These are days of supreme rejoicing [3.5s]
first_line_orig: امروز روزیست که از قبل فضایلش را ذکر نموده اند در کتب الهی این ایام جشن عظیم

first_line: In this day the blessed Lote-Tree of Bahá, which hath been planted by the hand of the Lord of Names in the supreme Paradise, hath spoken forth this exalted Word [3.5s]
first_line_orig: امروز سدره مبارکه بها که در فردوس اعلی بید مالک اسما غرس شده باینکلمه علیا

first_line: In this day the heaven of grace is uplifted, the ocean of bounty is surging, and the rays of the Sun of loving-kindness have encompassed all things [3.5s]
first_line_orig: امروز سماء کرم مرتفع و بحر جود مواج و پرتو آفتاب عنایت جمیع اشیا را اخذ

first_line: Praise be unto Thee, O Thou King of eternity and Lord of the world, Who art manifest in Thy Greatest Name, inasmuch as Thou hast enabled me to hearken unto Thy verses
first_line_orig: امروز مقصود من فی الارض و السماء و مالک ملکوت الاسماء باین کلمات عالیات نطق

first_line: Know thou that divine good-pleasure consisteth in this: that His good-pleasure in these days can be attained through naught else save through the pleasure of Him Who is the Manifestation of His Self [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان ارض برضی الله و ان رضائه فی تلک الایام لاتحقق الا برضاء مظهر نفسه الذی

first_line: Hearken unto that which is revealed unto thee from the holy sanctuary in the wilderness of divine knowledge, the spot wherein shineth forth and is kindled the Sacred Fire [3.5s]... ...By the righteousness of God! The world, its vanities and its glory, and whatever delights it can offer, are all, in the sight of God, as worthless
first_line_orig: ان استمع لما یوحی الیک عن شطر القدس بریه العرفان مقر الذی فیه یوقد و یضیء

first_line: Rejoice, O My loved ones, in that which the Most Exalted Pen doth make mention of you, in spite of those who have disbelieved in God, the Lord of all mankind [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان افرحوا یا احبائی بما یذکرکم القلم الاعلی رغما للذین کفروا بالله مولی الوری

first_line: Verily, the Divine Tree desireth to make mention of one of its fruits, and to gladden it with tidings of its tender mercy and bounty, and to make mention unto it of that which [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان السدره ارادت ان تذکر ثمره من ثمراتها و تبشرها بعنایتها و فضلها و تذکرها بما

first_line: Lo, the Book proclaimeth: "The Kingdom is God's, Lord of all worlds!" and all things cry out: "The Truth hath appeared and the Cause is in God's hands!" [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان الکتاب ینادی الملک لله رب العالمین و الاشیاء تصیح قد ظهر الحق و الامر بید الله

first_line: Verily, the Light calleth and the Fire doth summon! Blessed is the ear that hath heard and attained unto that which God desired in His Day [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان النور ینادی و النار تنادی طوبی لاذن سمعت و فازت بما اراده الله فی یومه

first_line: O Ibrahim! Hearken unto the call of thy Lord, the All-Bountiful, from the Kingdom of His utterance, the Impenetrable, the Ancient. There is no God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا ابراهیم ان استمع ندآء ربک الکریم من ملکوت بیانه الممتنع القدیم لا اله

first_line: O ye beloved of the All-Merciful! Hearken unto the Call from the precincts of the Prison. Verily, there is no God but Him, the All-Hearing, the All-Answering [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا احباء الرحمن ان استمعوا الندآء من شطر السجن انه لا اله الا نان السامع المجیب

first_line: O My loved ones! This is the Day whereof We have informed you in all the Tablets through the Most Holy and Exalted Pen. Be ye steadfast [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا احبائی الیوم یوم الذی بشرناکم فیکل الالواح من قلم قدس منیعا ان استقیموا علی

first_line: O My loved ones! We summon you, at all times, unto God, your Lord, the All-Merciful, and We desire naught else thereby [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا احبائی انا ندعوکم فی کل الاحیان الی الله ربکم الرحمن و مااردنا بذلک

first_line: O thou whose musk-laden and sweet-savoured verse was gracious and delicate as pure honey and most sweet - upon thee be peace [3.5s]
first_line_orig: مشکین مشکین شعر نمکین شما چون انگبین لطیف و مصفی و شیرین بود علیک

first_line: The purpose of creation hath ever been the recognition of God, and like unto a radiant light and a wafting fragrance, all remain heedless save whom God willeth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: مقصود از آفرینش عرفان الله بوده و چون نور ساطع و عرف متضوع کل غافل الا من شاء الله

first_line: Time and again hath thy mention been present before the Most Exalted Court, and that which beareth the fragrance of divine favor hath been graciously received [3.5s]
first_line_orig: مکرر ذکر شما در بساط اعلی بوده و اصغا شد ارسال مبارک انچه عرف عنایت

first_line: Mahd-i-'Ulya saith: "Write thou something else." I say: "There is naught else to write, for nothing else existeth in the realm..." [3.5s]
first_line_orig: مهد علیا میگوید چیز دیگر بنویس میگویم دیگر نیست تا بنویسم لیس غیره شیء فی الملک

first_line: We bear witness that the Afnán have testified to that which the Tree hath testified: verily there is none other God but Him, the All-Dominant, the Self-Subsisting [3.5s]
first_line_orig: نشهد ان الافنان شهدوا بما شهدت السدره انه لا اله الا هو المهیمن القیوم

first_line: This luminous Tablet have We made the bearer of pearls of wisdom and utterance. Whoso gazeth upon it is verily of the people of Bahá [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذه ورقه نوراء قد جعلناها حاملة للئالی الحکمة و البیان من ینظر الیها انه من اهل البهاء

first_line: Whosoever manifesteth from himself traces of malice and base desire, verily, he is remote from the Truth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هر نفسی از او اثار خباثت و شهوت ظاهر شود او از حق

first_line: O 'Alí-Qabli-Akbar! Upon thee be the glory of God, the Lord of Destiny. Verily, My Afnán, upon him be My glory... whenever he approacheth with spirit and sweet fragrance, and turneth with wisdom [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا علی قبل اکبر علیک بهاء الله مالک القدر ان افنانی علیه بهائی... هر هنگام بروح و ریحان وافع شود و بحکمت موافق توجه

first_line: Blessed be ye, O people of Bahá, ye who have quaffed the sealed wine by His Name, the Self-Subsisting, on this Day [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هنیئا لکم یا اهل البهاء انتم الذین شربتم الرحیق المختوم باسمه القیوم فی یوم

first_line: Thus have We revealed the manifestation of the Cause from this Epiphany that hath been raised in this atmosphere, whereupon the sanctified darkness was confined in this trusted land [3.5s]
first_line_orig: و کذلک اظهرنا تیهور الأمر عن هذا التاهور الذی ارتفع فی هذا الهوآء ثم احصرت منه دیجور القدس فی هذا البلد الأمین

first_line: Write ye, however, the permission of the union and give it unto Mirza Husayn, that he may deliver it - the account of the law [3.5s]
first_line_orig: و لکن نوشته اذن اتحادیه را بنویسید و بمیرزا حسین بدهید برساند حکایت قانون

first_line: O My loved ones! Adorn ye your tongues with truthfulness, your hands with generosity, your bodies with dignity, and your souls [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا احبائی زینوا لسانکم بالصدق و یدکم بالکرم و اجسادکم بالوقار و انفسکم

first_line: O Ism-i-Júd! His Holiness the Most Great Branch hath requested a sum which must needs be delivered unto Him, though it be from the trust of Khan [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا اسم جود حضرت غصن اعظم وجهی طلب نموده باید انجناب برسانند اگر چه وجه امانت خان

first_line: O My Afnán! Verily thy Lord, the Most Glorious, calleth thee unto the Supreme Horizon and maketh mention of thee with that whose fragrance shall never cease to endure [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا افنانی ان ربک الابهی یدعوک الی الافق الاعلی و یذکرک بما لاینقطع عرفه بدوام

first_line: O My Afnán! The Tree hath borne witness to thy turning unto it and thy firm adherence thereto. Blessed art thou, and goodly is thy portion [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا افنانی قد شهدت الشجره باقبالکم الیها و تمسککم بها طوبی لکم و ان لکم حسن

first_line: O 'Ali-Akbar! The divine Lote-Tree hath granted leave unto its leaf to hold fast unto it and to attain unto the presence of its countenance [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا علی اکبر سدرة المنتهی اذنت لو رقتها ان تتمسک بها و تحضر امام وجهها

first_line: O 'Alí-Akbar! The Sun of Permission hath dawned for the Leaf and them that are with her. Execute her command as befitteth, for verily He is the Preserver, the Helper [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا علی اکبر قد اشرق نیر الاذن للورقة من معها و بر امرها بما ینبغی انه هو الحافظ المعین

first_line: O 'Alí-Akbar! We have entrusted into thy grasp the reins of this virtuous cause; it is for thee to turn thereunto and for thee to manage its affairs. Verily, God is the All-Governing, the All-Wise [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا علی اکبر قد اودعنا زمام امر الخیر فی قبضتک لها ان تتوجه و لک ان تدبر امرها ان الله هو المدبر الحکیم

first_line: We bear witness, O 'Alí, that thou hast turned toward the Most Exalted Horizon and hearkened unto the call of thy Lord, the Most Glorious, and answered thy Master [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا علی نشهد انک اقبلت الی الافق الاعلی و سمعت ندآء ربک الابهی و اجبت مولی

first_line: O wayfarer! Upon thee be My glory, My mercy and My loving-kindness. We bear witness that thou hast turned thy face unto My countenance and hast attained that which was ordained [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا مسافر علیک بهائی و رحمتی و عنایتی نشهد انک اقبلت الی وجهی و فزت بما کان

first_line: My Most Exalted Pen beareth witness unto him who hath turned towards Mine All-Glorious Horizon, that verily he hath turned and attained unto that which was inscribed [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یشهد قلمی الاعلی لمن اقبل الی افقی الابهی بانه اقبل و فاز بما کان مسطورا

first_line: These are the verses of Revelation; they have been sent down from the realm of eternity, and none shall apprehend them save those who have soared… By God! No spot is left on My body that hath not been touched by the spears of thy machinations… What hath proceeded from thy pen hath caused the Countenances of Glory to be prostrated upon the dust
first_line_orig: تلک آیات الامر نزلت من جبروت البقا و لا یعقلها الا الذینهم طاروا بجناحین

first_line: ...This Day is God's Day, and this Cause His Cause. Happy is he who hath renounced this world, and clung to Him Who is the Dayspring of God's Revelation
O Hudhud! We make mention of thee through remembering Our sister, and her days, and how her heart was ablaze with the fire of her Lord's love
...In the beginning of every Revelation adversities have prevailed, which later on have been turned into great prosperity
The days are approaching their end, and yet the peoples of the earth are sunk in grievous heedlessness
The day is approaching when the faithful will behold the daystar of justice shining in its full splendor from the dayspring of glory.
Were We to make mention of what befell Us, the heavens would be rent asunder and the mountains would crumble
When the secret nursed in his (Mirza Yahya) bosom was revealed by God he disclaimed such an intention, and imputed it to that same servant (Ustad Muhammad-'Ali)
The divines of Persia ... have perpetrated what the Jews have not perpetrated during the Revelation of Him Who is the Spirit
Oh thou who hast pioneered! Listen to the voice of God from the shores of the Prison. There is no god but Him, the Mighty
first_line_orig: یا ایها المهاجر اسمع ندآء الله عن شطر السجن انه لا اله الا هو المهیمن القیوم

first_line: ...what has been revealed [regarding the most great elixir] was set forth for the purpose of imparting proof, so that this earth should not be deprived of visible testimony

title: Prophecy regarding the future of Iran as relayed by Shoghi Effendi
first_line: The most honored of all governments, the pride, the admiration and the envy of the peoples of the world
Soon shall the blasts of His chastisement beat upon you, and the dust of hell enshroud you.
from Whom God hath caused to proceed the knowledge of all that was and shall be
behave towards the government of the country in which they reside with loyalty, honesty and truthfulness

first_line_orig: اننی انا وجه الله الانور

first_line: Baha’u’llah

first_line: Incessantly doth the Call ascend from the Most Exalted Horizon, and He Who raiseth the Call - may the spirit of all else but Him be sacrificed for His sake - is seated upon the Throne of Utterance [3.5s]
first_line_orig: لازال ندا از افق اعلی مرتفع و صاحب ندا روح ما سواه فداه بر عرش بیان مستوی

first_line: O thou who art present before the Gate and steadfast in the Cause! Upon thee be the peace of God and His mercy. Glory hath appeared [3.5s]

first_line: A remembrance from Our presence unto him who desireth to know the Intended One, when He Who was concealed appeared with a sovereignty that conquered all contingent beings, that he might be enveloped by the fragrance [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکر من لدنا لمن اراد ان یعرف المقصود اذ ظهر المکنون بسلطان غلب الامکان لیاخذه عرف

first_line: O Shaykh! Upon thee be the Glory of God and His loving-kindness! In the visible world there hath appeared that which the possessors of wisdom, utterance and proof awaited [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا شیخ علیک بهاء الله و عنایته در عالم ظاهر شده آنچه که صاحبان حکمت و بیان و حجت

first_line: It hath been established through manifest proof that which hath shone forth from the horizon of certitude: that My praise and My mention reacheth not My intended purpose [3.5s]

first_line: O My Leaf! Hearken unto My call from the precincts of My prison; verily it draweth thee nigh unto God, the Lord of the mighty Throne. We testify that thou [3.5s]

first_line_orig: در این یوم نیر کتاب مبین ندا میفرماید و کل را بما یقربهم الی الله دعوت مینماید

first_line: Glorified be He Who hath sent down the verses in truth and made them a testimony from His presence unto the peoples of all the worlds, and through them hath descended [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحان الذی نزل الایات بالحق و جعلها حجه من عنده علی العالمین و بها نزل من

first_line: Take heed, O ye that have eyes to see! Take heed, O ye that are endued with sight! Reflect then, O ye that are possessed of thought [3.5s]
first_line_orig: فاعتبروا یا اولی الابصار ثم اعتبروا یا اولی الانظار ثم فکروا یا اولی الافکار

first_line: This is a Book that speaketh with truth, and wherein is mentioned that which draweth mankind nigh unto God, their Creator [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب ینطق بالحق و یذکر فیه ما یقرب الناس الی الله بارئهم

first_line: Praise be to God, Who hath sent down from the heaven of utterance the water whereby He hath quickened His servants and dispatched unto them His Messengers [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی انزل من سماء البیان ماء و احیی به العباد و ارسل الیهم الرسل

first_line: Praise be to God! The fragrances of the Divine Word are diffused, the aroma of the sacred vesture is spread abroad, and the light of His Cause is resplendent. Blessed are they who [3.5s]
first_line_orig: لله الحمد نفحات کلمه الهی متضوع و عرف قمیص منتشر و نور امر ساطع طوبی از برای

first_line: These are the verses of the Spirit that have been sent down in truth from the cloud of grievous sorrow, if thou wouldst but behold with the eye of the spirit [3.5s]
first_line_orig: تلک آیات الروح قد نزلت بالحق من سحاب حزن عظیم و لو تشهد ببصر الروح

first_line: The letter from that leaf of Paradise was received and perused. Though in these days sorrow hath encompassed in such wise [3.5s]
first_line_orig: مکتوب آن ورقه رضوان رسید و زیارت شد اگرچه در این ایام حزن بشانی احاطه نموده

first_line: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him. His are the grandeur and the power, the might and the dominion. He doeth whatsoever He willeth [3.5s]... And then the voice of the Divine Lote-Tree sounded, calling aloud and saying: Praise be unto God Who hath ordained marriage to be a portal
first_line_orig: شهد الله انه لا اله الا هو له العظمه و الاقتدار و القدره و الاختیار یفعل ما یشاء

first_line: Praise be unto the Most Great Name, Who through His exalted Word hath summoned the denizens of the mortal realm [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد اسم اعظم را لایق و سزاست که بکلمه علیا اهل ناسوت

first_line: In this day the Wronged One calleth from the prison-quarter unto the peoples of the world and summoneth them unto the Most Great Ocean [3.5s]
first_line_orig: امروز مظلوم از شطر سجن اهل عالم را ندا مینماید و ببحر اعظم دعوت میکند

first_line: By God, the True One! None of thy words concerning thy recognition of the Self of God and thy steadfastness in His Cause have been presented before the Throne [3.5s]
first_line_orig: تالله الحق ما حضر بین یدی العرش من کلماتک فی عرفانک نفس الله و اثباتک علی امره

first_line: This is the Book that speaketh with truth, wherein lieth mercy unto all the worlds, and God hath created from its letters that which hath been sent down [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب ینطق بالحق و فیه رحمه للعالمین و قد خلق الله من حرف عما نزل

first_line: O servant! Fear God in thine own self and abide beneath Our protection, that naught shall grieve thee nor disturb thy peace [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا عبد اتق الله فی نفسک و کن فی عصمه من لدنا بحیث لایحزنک شیء و لا یکدرک

first_line: A poem from that eminence was inscribed upon a leaf whereon We had graciously penned Our regard for this servant, and this servant [3.5s]
first_line_orig: شعری از آنجناب بر ورقه که نظر بالتفات این عبد مرقوم فرموده بودیم و این عبد

first_line: The Wronged One beareth witness unto that which God Himself testified before the creation of all things, that there is none other God but Him. He hath ever been sanctified [3.5s]
first_line_orig: شهد المظلوم بما شهد اللّه قبل خلق الأشیآء انّه لا اله الّا هو لم یزل کان مقدّساً

first_line: O Moses! Hearken unto the Voice of the Ancient Beauty, and arise to uphold the Cause of God with such steadfastness as shall cause the feet of them that waver to be made firm [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ای کلیم بشنو ندای جمال قدیم را و بایست بر امر الله بقیامیکه ارجل مضطربین

first_line: O handmaid of God! Bear thou witness that there is none other God but Him, and all before Him are worshippers prostrate. Therefore place thy trust in God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا امه الله اشهدی علی انه لا اله الا هو و کل له ساجدون فتوکلی علی الله

first_line: O 'Alí! Upon thee be God's salutations and His loving-kindness! Thou art witness, and the All-Knowing doth testify, that this Wronged One hath [addressed] the party of God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا علی علیک سلام الله و عنایته تو شاهد و عالم گواه که اینمظلوم حزب الله را

first_line: The remembrance of the Pen and Ink, ere the inscription of letters and words, hath been and shall ever be the remembrance of the Lord of Creation [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکر قلم و مداد قبل از نگارش حروف و الفاظ ذکر مالک ایجاد بوده و خواهد بود

first_line: These are the verses of holiness sent down from God, the One, the Incomparable, the Single, calling mankind unto Paradise [3.5s]
first_line_orig: تلک آیات القدس نزلت من لدی الله الواحد الفرد الاحد و یدعو الناس الی فردوس

first_line: This binding and irrevocable decree hath, in this very hour, been manifested from the precincts of the Most Great Prison: Bear ye witness that ye belong unto God, without doubt [3.5s]
first_line_orig: این حکم محکم مبرم در این حین از شطر سجن اعظم ظاهر نشهد انکم کنتم لله و لا شک

first_line: A wondrous remembrance from the servant unto him who hath believed in God and was among the guided ones, inscribed in the Tablets of the Spirit [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکر بدیع من العبد الی الذی آمن باللّه و کان من المهتدین فی الواح الرّوح مسطورا

first_line: This is an Epistle from the Primal Point unto him who hath believed in God and His signs, that he may stand firm in the Cause and be detached [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من نقطه الاولی الی الذی آمن بالله و آیاته لیستقیم علی الامر و ینقطع

first_line: Praise befitteth and is worthy of the Lord of Names and the Creator of Heaven, Who hath uttered the Most Exalted Word, whereupon arose the surging [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حمد مالک اسماء و فاطر سماء را لایق و سزاست که بکلمهٴ علیا نطق فرمود فی الحین ماج

first_line: O my God! Manifest Thou on this Festival Day Thy power and dominion over all who dwell in Thy heavens and upon Thy earth. Glory be unto Thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: فاظهر اللهم فی هذا العید قدرتک و سلطانک علی من فی سمائک و ارضک سبحانک

first_line: Praise be unto Him Who is the Aim and End of all creation, Who hath remembered and doth ever remember His loved ones [3.5s]... ...O beloved of my heart! According to what the illustrious Afnán, upon him rest all the Glory of the Most Glorious, hath written, a plot of land hath been purchased in the name of God
first_line_orig: حمد مقصود عالمیان را لایق و سزاست که اولیای خود را لازال ذکر نموده و مینماید... یا حبیب فؤادی حضرت افنان علیه منکلّ بهآء ابهاه

first_line: O 'Alí-Qablí-Akbar! Upon thee be My glory! Thy letter hath been received at the threshold by My Name Mahdí, upon whom rest My loving-kindness and mercy [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا علی قبل اکبر علیک بهائی نامه ات را اسمی مهدی علیه عنایتی و رحمتی بساحت

first_line: According to the command, those beloved and chosen ones must act in such wise as shall conduce to the joy and exultation of the state [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حسب الامر باید آن محبوبان و اولیا عمل نمایند آنچه را که سبب فرح و سرور دولت

first_line: Verily the decreed time has arrived and the Revealer of verses has come from the Heaven of His Cause with a power that will not be weakened by the tyrannies of the evil-doers
first_line_orig: قد اتی المیقات و اتی منزل الایات من سماء الامر بقوه لاتضعفها ظلم الاشرار

first_line: The lamentation of God hath verily been raised in truth from the Manifestation of His Self, Who hath fallen beneath the claws of hatred and was not [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حنین الله قد ارتفع بالحق من مظهر نفسه الذی وقع تحت مخالیب البغضا و لم یکن

first_line: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee by Him Whom Thou hast manifested and made His Revelation identical with Thine own Self-Revelation... in this Dispensation wherein the faces of the ungodly were darkened [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحانک اللهم یا الهی اسئلک بالذی اظهرته و جعلت ظهوره نفس ظهورک … فی هذا الظهور الذی فیه اسودت وجوه المشرکین

first_line: O spiritual youth! Thy desire and purpose have been graciously heard in the Most Holy and Most Exalted Court [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا جوان روحانی مطلب و مقصود شما در ساحت امنع اقدس بسرف اصغاء فائز

first_line: This infinitesimal atom beareth witness, at the effulgence of Thy Ancient Beauty in this darksome night, before the radiance [3.5s]
first_line_orig: شهادت میدهد این ذره دکا عند تشعشع جمال ازلیت تو در این لیل صما تلقاء تلالو

first_line: Verily, We have sent unto thee aforetime a Tablet, a single letter whereof surpasseth whatsoever hath been created and shall be created, and it is, indeed, a revelation [3.5s]
first_line_orig: و لقد ارسلنا الیک من قبل لوحا لایعادل بحرف منه ما خلق و یخلق و انه لتنزیل

first_line: Glorified art Thou, O Lord my God! This is one of Thy handmaidens and a leaf among Thy leaves who hath drawn nigh unto Thee and placed her trust in Thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحانک اللهم یا الهی هذه امه من امائک و طلقه من طلقاتک تقربت الیک و توکلت علیک

first_line: O Husayn! Upon thee rest My Glory! I testify that thou hast attained unto that which was concealed in the Tablet as inscribed by the Supreme Pen at the behest of God, the Lord of both worlds
first_line_orig: یا حسین علیک بهائی نشهد انک فزت بما کان مسطورا فی اللوح و مرقوما من القلم

first_line: O Mihdi! Bear thou witness that verily there is no God but Him. His is all creation and command, and all were created by His bidding, and all are His [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا مهدی فاشهد بانه لا اله الا هو له الخلق و الامر و کل خلقوا بامره و کل له

first_line: Glorified be He Who maketh mention of His handmaidens who have believed in Him, who have detached themselves from whatsoever is repugnant to His good-pleasure, and who have walked His paths [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحان الذی یذکر امائه اللواتی آمن به و انقطعن عما یکرهه رضاه و سلکن مناهج

first_line: Your letter hath reached Our presence, and We have perused its contents, and We shall respond unto thee with that which God shall cast [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد حضر عندنا کتابک و اطلعنا بما فیه و نجیبنک بما یلقی الله

first_line: A Book sent down in truth, wherein is that which draweth the world nigh unto the Most Great Name and causeth them to hearken unto the Call of God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: کتاب نزل بالحق و فیه ما یقرب العالم الی الاسم الاعظم و یسمعهم ندآء الله

first_line: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him, and He Who hath come from the heaven of divine utterance with proof and testimony [3.5s]
first_line_orig: شهد الله انه لا اله الا هو و الذی اتی من سماء البیان بالحجه و البرهان انه

first_line: O beloved friend, bear thou witness that the Light hath shone forth and become manifest, that the hidden hath been revealed and shall be unveiled, and that the heavens have been cleft asunder and are being rent [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان اشهد یا ایها الحبیب بان النور جلا و تجلی و البطون ظهر او تظهر و السماء شقا و تشقا

first_line: O letter Jim, nay rather O essence of Hell! The supplication of God's servants in the sacred precincts... Hast thou not heard that My proof is Mine own Self, My evidence is Mine own Being, and My testimony and manifestation are Mine own Reality [3.5s]
first_line_orig: حرف جیم بل جوهر حجیم عریضه غلا لله در ساحه قدس... اما سمعت بان حجتی ذاتی و برهانی نفسی و دلیلی و ظهوری

first_line: O Taqi! Know thou that thy letter hath been presented before the Throne, and the glances of God, thy Lord, have turned towards it [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا تقی فاعلم بان حضر بین یدی العرش کتابک و التفتت الیه لحظات الله ربک

first_line: This is an Epistle from this Wronged One unto him who hath emigrated in the path of God and was [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من هذا المظلوم الی الذی هاجر فی سبیل الله و کان

first_line: Praise be unto God Who hath enabled His loved ones to attain supreme steadfastness and hath strengthened them to exalt His Cause [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی وفق اولیائه علی الاستقامه الکبری و ایدهم علی اعلاء الامر

first_line: The Book hath been sent down through grace unto him who hath turned towards God on a Day wherein mankind hath turned away from the Lord of all worlds [3.5s]
first_line_orig: کتاب نزل بالفضل لمن اقبل فی یوم فیه اعرض الناس عن الله رب العالمین

first_line: This is an epistle from the servant unto her who hath believed in God, her Lord, and hath been numbered among the devout in the Mother Book [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من لدی العبد الی التی آمنت بالله ربها و کانت من القانتات فی ام الکتاب

first_line: Praised be God, Who hath adorned the heaven of love with the stars of unity and harmony, and hath ordained that in the world of being marriage be the chief instrument
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی نور العالم بنیر لاح و اشرق من فجر الظهور فی افق سماء بیان الرحمن

first_line: We have sent unto thee a Book by which the hearts of them that are endowed with understanding are irresistibly drawn, such as have been granted a portion in life [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد ارسلنا الیک کتابا منه تنجذب افئده العارفین من کان له نصیب فی الحیوه

first_line: O Rubábih! Hearken thou unto the melody of the Lord from the direction of thy Lord, the Almighty, the All-Bountiful, that the fragrances of the Lord of Lords may draw thee nigh [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا ربابه ان استمعی ندآء الرباب عن جهه ربک العزیز الوهاب لتجذبک نفحات رب الارباب

first_line: O Haydar, upon thee be My glory! A letter from his honor Sayyá? was written to 'Abdu'l-?á?ir, wherein he declared his repudiation [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا حیدر علیک بهائی نامه‌ئی جناب سیاح بعبد حاضر نوشته و در آن نامه اظهار تبری

first_line: Glorified art Thou, O my God! We are Thy servants, within Thy grasp, and we desire naught save that which Thou hast desired [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحانک اللهم یا الهی انا عبادک و فی قبضتک و ما اردنا الا ما اردته

first_line: O My Leaf! Hearken thou unto My call from the precincts of 'Akká. Verily, there is none other God but Me, the Creator of the heavens and the Lord of Names [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا ورقتی ان استمعی ندائی من شطر عکا انه لا اله الا انا فاطر السماء و مالک الاسماء

first_line: O Majíd! With Mine own hand have I nurtured thee, and within Mine exalted paradise have I planted thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ای مجید بدست خود تو را تربیت فرمودم و در رضوان منیع تو را غرس نمودم

first_line: The mention of the Divine Leaf upon the holy shore, amidst the branches of the Celestial Lote-Tree. O ye dwellers of the Throne, hearken ye [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکر ورقه الهویة فی شاطی القدس علی اغصان سدرة الفردوس ان یا اهل العرش فاسمعون

first_line: The Luminary of glad-tidings hath verily dawned, inasmuch as the branches have been united with the blessed Lote-Tree, and in remembrance of the Tree [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد اشرق نیر البشاره بما اتصلت الافنان بالسدره المبارکه و فی ذکر الشجره

first_line: The atoms have spoken even as the Revealer of Verses spoke when He came with clear proofs which none could match [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد نطقت الذرات بما نطق منزل الآیات اذ اتی بالبیّنات التی عجز عن الاتیان

first_line: O 'Alí, upon thee be My glory! The Wronged One complaineth not of tribulations, nor of that which hath befallen the favored ones in the path of God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا علی علیک بهائی ان المظلوم لایشکو من البلایا و ما ورد علی الاولیاء فی سبیل الله

first_line: O thou who hast attained! Thou hast been afflicted with separation, and I am Separation and care not; I am the Separator and fear not [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ای واصل بفراق مبتلی شدی و انا الفراق و لا ابالی و انا المفرق و لا اخاف

first_line: From the beginning that hath no beginning He hath been, and unto the end that shall have no end He shall ever be, and the purpose of all creation [3.5s]
first_line_orig: از اول خلق لا اول بوده و الی آخر لا آخر خواهد بود و مقصود از جمیع این آفرینش

first_line: Praise be unto God Who hath made the line, formed from the Primal Point manifest in the letter Bá, the adorning seal of His Name [3.5s]
first_line_orig: الحمد لله الذی جعل الخط المتکون من النقطه الاولیه الظاهره بالباء طراز الختم لاسمه

first_line: Thou hadst made reference in thy letter to agriculture. On this matter He hath laid down the following universal rule
first_line_orig: در فقره جناب ملا حسین و ابن ایشان علیهما بهاء الله مرقوم فرموده بودید

first_line: This is a remembrance from Our presence unto him who hath attained unto the lights of faith and hath acknowledged that which the peoples of the earth have denied, save whom He hath willed [3.5s]... ...God testifieth that there is none other God but Him, Who is potent to do whatsoever He willeth. He ruleth over His dominion as He pleaseth
first_line_orig: ذکر من لدنا لمن فاز بانوار الایمان و اعترف بما انکره اهل الارض الا من شاء

first_line: O 'Alí-Akbar! The Lord of Destiny remembereth thee from His Most Great Prison, and giveth thee glad tidings of His grace and bounty [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا علی اکبر یذکرک مالک القدر فی سجنه الاکبر و یبشرک بفضله و عطائه

first_line: A Tablet revealed by the Ancient King unto him who hath turned unto Him and attained unto His Day, which is mentioned in the Books of the Prophets [3.5s]
first_line_orig: لوح انزله مالک القدم لمن اقبل الیه و فاز بیومه المذکور فی کتب النبیین

first_line: O Dawud! The All-Loving Lord proclaimeth in the Perspicuous Book that which hath been sent down through the Most Exalted Pen as a stronghold [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا داود رب ودود میفرماید در کتاب مبین از قلم اعلی نازل شده آنچه که حصنی است

first_line: Thy missive, which was redolent with loving allusions and imbued with the dewdrops of attraction, hath been received and laid before the Throne [3.5s]
first_line_orig: مراسله شما که باشارات حبیه و رشحات جذبیه مرشح بود واصل شد و بین یدی العرش

first_line: O Qásim! His honour 'Alí-Akbar—upon him be My glory—hath made mention of thy love, kindliness and forgiveness [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا قاسم جناب علی اکبر علیه بهائی در مراتب محبت و شفقت و عفو شما ذکری نمود

first_line: A remembrance from the Servant unto her who believed and was guided, and returned unto the homeland of nearness in the vicinity of her Lord, the Most High, the Most Exalted [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکر من العبد الی التی آمنت ثم هدی و رجعت الی وطن القرب فی جوار ربها العلی الاعلی

first_line: Hearken unto that which maketh thee hear the melodies of God, wondrous melodies of glory, and revealeth unto thee from the direction of thy Lord that which hath been inscribed [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان استمع ما یسمعک نغمات الله من نغمات عز بدیعا و یوحی الیک من شطر ربک ما سطر

first_line: Say: I yield Thee thanks, O my God, and my Master, and my Mainstay, for having aided me to recognize the Dawning-Place of Thy signs
first_line_orig: قل لک الحمد یا الهی و سیدی و سندی بما ایدتنی علی عرفان مطلع آیاتک

first_line: O Prince! The Wronged One remembereth thee at the hour when sorrows have encompassed Him through that which the hands of them that have denied have wrought [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا میر یذکرک المظلوم فی حین احاطته الاحزان بما اکتسبت ایدی الذین انکروا

first_line: Glorified be He Who sendeth down verses as He willeth, whereby certain servants go astray while others are guided! Ever hath He been [3.5s]
first_line_orig: فسبحان الذی ینزل الایات کیف یشاء یضل منها عباد و یهتدی آخرون لم یزل کان

first_line: O leaf of love! Hearken unto the call of thy Lord from this Prison, that the melodies of the All-Merciful may draw thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا ورقه الحب اسمعی ندآء ربک عن شطر هذا السجن لتجذبک نغمات الرحمن

first_line: Glorified be He Who manifesteth whomsoever He willeth through whatsoever He willeth for the purpose of His Cause and the revelation of His wisdom [3.5s]
first_line_orig: سبحان الذی قد اظهر من یشاء بما یشاء للقیام بامره و الاظهار لحکمه

first_line: O Ibn Abhar! Upon thee be the Glory of God, the Lord of Destiny. Hearken unto that which God, the Lord of all worlds, calleth unto thee. Verily, We have cast [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا بن ابهر علیک بهآء اللّه مالک القدر ان استمع ما ینادیک به اللّه رب العالمین انا القینا

first_line: In this day, if it be said that the whole world hath become as a single eye, or a single ear, verily this would be true, for every [3.5s]
first_line_orig: امروز اگر گفته شود تمام عالم یک بصر است و یا یک سمع صحیح است چه که ذره

first_line: O Muhammad-Qablí-Táhir! He round Whom circle the Concourse on High and the dwellers of Paradise maketh mention of thee on this night [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا محمد قبل طاهر یذکرک فی هذا اللیل من طاف حوله الملا الاعلی و اهل الفرودس

first_line: The purpose of creation is the manifestation of this Most Exalted, Most Holy Day, which in the divine Books, Scrolls and Tablets is known as the Day of God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: مقصود از آفرینش ظهور این یوم امنع اقدس که در کتب و صحف و زبر الهی بیوم الله

first_line: The candle in its burning and the heart in its melting—it remaineth unknown what causeth this and wherefore it hath come to pass. Some there are who [3.5s]
first_line_orig: شمع در سوز و دل در گداز معلوم نه که سبب این چه و علت آن کدام قومی بر آنند

first_line: O Leaf! God willing, mayest thou be swayed and stirred by the breezes of the divine Will from the celestial Tree [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ای ورقه انشاء الله از نسایم اراده رحمانیه از سدره ربانیه متمایل و متحرک باشی

first_line: We have hearkened unto thy call and answered thee, for verily thy Lord is the All-Responding. He is with thee and aideth thee through the truth. Verily, He is the All-Powerful [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد سمعنا ندائک و اجبناک ان ربک لهو المجیب انه معک و ینصرک بالحق انه لهو المقتدر

first_line: I make mention unto thee of the dewdrops of light that shall draw thee unto the court of the Sovereign of joy [3.5s]
first_line_orig: انی اذکر علیک من رشحات النور ینجذبک الی ساحه سلطان السرور

first_line: O Majíd! The Spirit hath descended in His glory from My Kingdom, and He Who conversed with God with His signs, and the Beloved One with His ascension [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا مجید قد نزل الروح بمجده من ملکوتی و الکلیم بایاته و الحبیب بمعراجه

first_line: The Day hath indeed come, and the people have denied God, the Almighty, the All-Compelling. The signs have appeared and the verses have been sent down, yet the people [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد اتی الیوم و کفر القوم بالله المقتدر الجبار اتت العلامات و نزلت الایات و الناس

first_line: Your letter hath been received, and that which was set forth therein became evident. In all conditions one must fix one's gaze upon the Truth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: نوشته شما رسید و ما قضا فیه مبرهن گشت در جمیع احوال باید ناظر بحق

first_line: This is a Book that hath been sent down in truth unto him who hath attained the presence of his Lord, the All-Merciful, the Most Compassionate, and whom the breezes of revelation have enfolded [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب قد نزل بالحق لمن حضر لدی عرش ربه الرحمن الرحیم و اخذته نفحات الوحی

first_line: O Yahya! My Most Exalted Pen moveth amidst the peoples at eventide and at dawn, summoning all [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا یحیی تحرک قلمی الاعلی بین الوری فی العشی و الاشراق و دعا الکل

first_line: A remembrance of the servants who were drawn by the fragrances of the days of their Lord, the Lord of Names and Attributes, and who believed [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکری عباد الذین انجذبوا من نفحات ایام ربهم مالک الاسماء و الصفات و آمنوا

first_line: The mention of the Book, from the servant to her who hath believed in God and was numbered among the devout ones in the sacred scrolls, inscribed [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکر کتاب من العبد الی التی آمنت بالله و کانت من القانتات فی صحف القدس مسطورا

first_line: This is a Book that guideth the sincere unto the fountain-spring of their chosen Lord's mercy and shieldeth them from the intimations of those who [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب یهدی المخلصین الی سلسبیل رحمه ربهم المختار و یحفظهم من اشارات الذین

first_line: This is one of the nights of the Fast, and during it the Tongue of Grandeur and Glory proclaimed: There is no God beside Me, the Omnipotent Protector, the Self-Subsisting
first_line_orig: هذه لیله من لیالی الصیام و فیها نطق لسان العظمه و الکبریاء انه لا اله الا

first_line: O thou servant steadfast in the faith of God! Hearken unto the voice of him who calleth thee unto God, purely for His sake, seeking naught for any soul [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا عبد المومن بالله اسمع قول من یدعوک الی الله خالصا لوجهه و ما اراد لاحد

first_line: We make mention of him who hath turned unto the Countenance and believed in God, the One, the All-Informed. O seeker, verily the Sought One [3.5s]
first_line_orig: انا نذکر من اقبل الی الوجه و آمن بالله الفرد الخبیر ان یا طالب ان المطلوب

first_line: Shouldst thou behold Me, thou wouldst not recognize Me by reason of what hath befallen Me in the path of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Chosen One. I do not complain of what hath come upon Me [3.5s]
first_line_orig: لو ترانی لاتعرفنی بما ورد علی فی سبیل ربک العزیز المختار لااشکو بما ورد علی

first_line: O beloved ones of God! Ye are the lamps of darkness, created for these days wherein gloom hath encompassed them that dwell upon earth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا احباء الله انتم مصابیح الدجی قد خلقتم لهذه الایام التی فیها اخذت الظلمه من فی الارض

first_line: O servants of the All-Merciful! Sanctify your hearts from fancies and vain imaginings, that ye may taste the sweetness of the celestial stream of utterance, which floweth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا عباد الرحمن قدسوا قلوبکم عن الظنون و الاوهام لتجدوا لذه سلسبیل البیان انه جری

first_line: Your letter hath arrived and been read before the Throne. Therein didst thou adjure God to make thee one of them that circle round about Him [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد حضر کتابک و قرء تلقاء العرش اقسمت فیه الله بان یجعلک من الطائفین فی حوله

first_line: This is the Day of Victory! Arise to aid the Cause of thy Lord, the Most High, the Most Great. Say: O servants of the All-Merciful! The sun hath risen [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا یوم النصر قم علی نصره امر ربک العلی العظیم قل یا عباد الرحمن قد اشرقت شمس

first_line: O thou who art endowed with insight! Know thou that We have attained unto the Most Exalted Horizon, while they imagine that I am in prison [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا بصیر فاعلم بانا وردنا فی المنظر الاعلی و الذین یتوهمون انی فی السجن

first_line: O servant! Hearken unto My call from the precincts of the prison, that the call may draw thee nigh unto the luminous vision of thy Most Glorious Lord. Verily, He is the Almighty [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا غلام اسمع ندائی عن جهه السجن لیقربک الندا الی منظر ربک الابهی انه لهو المقتدر

first_line: This is a Book from Our presence unto him who hath been attracted by the verses of his Lord, who hath turned towards the Kaaba of his Purpose, and hath attained [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من لدنا الی الذی انجذب من آیات ربه و اقبل الی کعبه المقصود و فاز

first_line: Glory be to the Lord of the world; and thanks be to the Hands of His Cause; and praise be to the Trustees of His House of Justice
Hearken thou unto the Call of thy Lord, the Most Glorious, then sever thyself from the world - these are among the mighty signs of thy Lord, sent down from on high [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان استمع ندآء ربک الابهی ثم انقطع عن الدنیا تلک من آیات ربک الکبری نزلت عن

first_line: In the midst of tribulation, We have summoned all created beings unto God, the Lord of the First and the Last. To this doth bear witness [3.5s]
first_line_orig: انا فی بحبوحة البلآء دعونا اهل الانشآء الی اللّه مالک الآخرة و الأولی یشهد بذلک

first_line: Know thou, O thou who gazest upon the Countenance, that calamities have encompassed Us, and amidst their depths We summon mankind [3.5s]
first_line_orig: فاعلم یا ایها الناظر الی الوجه بان البلایاء احاطتنا و نحن فی غمراتها ندع الناس

first_line: Say: O my God, my God! All praise be unto Thee for having caused me to hear Thy Call, and guided me unto Thy Path, and shown me the traces of Thy Pen [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قل الهی الهی لک الحمد بما اسمعتنی ندآئک و هدیتنی الی صراطک و اریتنی آثار قلمک

first_line: The Supreme Pen yearneth to make mention of all the servants of God, both men and women, yet hath been hindered through oppression [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قلم الاعلی یحب ان یذکر عباد الله و امائه کلهم و کلها ولکن منع بالظلم

first_line: This is a Book sent down in truth, and verily it is a revelation from God, the Lord of the worlds [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب نزل بالحق و انه تنزیل من لدی الله رب العالمین

first_line: O Muhammad-'Alí! The world is in upheaval; the darkness of the vain imaginings of mankind hath seized it with the grasp of a mighty oppressor [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا محمد قبل علی عالم منقلب ظلمت اوهام انام را اخذ نموده اخذ ظالم قهار

first_line: We have, on this day, arisen to proclaim the remembrance of God, the Lord of all worlds, and when the verses descended, We stood present before the Throne [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد اصبحنا الیوم ناطقا بذکر الله رب العالمین و اذا نزلت الایات قد حضر لدی العرش

first_line: I testify that thou hast witnessed the dawn of Kufa and the eventide of Karbila. Render thanks unto thy Lord, the All-Merciful, for having made thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: اشهد بانک انت ادرکت فجر الکوفه و عشی الکربلا ان اشکر ربک الرحمن بما جعلک

first_line: O thou who art enkindled with the fire of My love, who gazeth upon My countenance and traverseth the lands for My nearness and reunion with Me [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا ایها المشتعل بنار حبی و الناظر الی وجهی و السایر فی البلاد لقربی و لقائی

first_line: This is an epistle from the Prisoner unto him whom the clamor of men hath not hindered from drawing nigh unto his Lord, the Possessor [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من لدی المسجون الی الذی مامنعه ضوضاء العباد عن التقرب الی ربه مالک

first_line: This is a Book from Our presence unto him who migrated with God until he entered into the Most Great Prison—this exalted station [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من لدنا الی الذی هاجر مع الله الی ان دخل فی السجن الاعظم هذا المقام

first_line: This is a Book from Us unto him who hath inhaled the fragrance of the garment of Our Name, the Most Merciful, and thereby hath attained unto paradise [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من لدنا الی الذی وجد عرف قمیص اسمنا الرحمن و به بلغ الی رضوان

first_line: O Rahim! Hearken unto the call of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, from the Prison precincts. Verily, there is none other God but He, the Omnipotent, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا رحیم اسمع ندآء ربک الرحیم عن جهه السجن انه لا اله الا هو المقتدر العزیز الکریم

first_line: These are the days the like of which the eye of creation hath never seen, nor hath any among contingent beings perceived their likeness [3.5s]
first_line_orig: این ایام ایامیست که چشم امکان شبه آن ندیده و احدی از ممکنات مثل آن ادراک ننموده

first_line: After the completion of this letter appeared the blessed script of the beloved of Fu'ád, Jináb-i-Mullá-'Alí-Akbar - upon him be the glory of God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: بعد از اتمام این مکتوب دستخط حضرت محبوب فواد جناب ملا علی اکبر علیه بهاء الله

first_line: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I call upon Thee at this moment when the Sun of Thy Lordship hath dawned from the horizon of heaven [3.5s]
first_line_orig: فسبحانک اللهم یا الهی انادیک حینئذ حین الذی استشرق شمس ربوبیتک عن افق سماء

first_line: The days have come wherein souls are sorely troubled and faces are altered, save those who have detached themselves unto God and held fast [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد اتت ایام فیها اضطربت النفوس و تغیرت الوجوه الا من انقطع الی الله و تمسک

first_line: One of My branches, who hath been named Badí'u'lláh, appeared before Us with thy letter and laid it before Our presence, whereupon We responded to thee [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد حضر احد اغصانی الذی سمی ببدیع الله بکتابک و عرضه امام الوجه اجبناک

first_line: Thy letter attained unto Our presence in the Most Great Prison and was honoured by the hearing of the Ancient of Days. This deed of thine, in the sight of God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: نامه ات تلقاء وجه در سجن اعظم بشرف اصغاء مالک قدم فائز شد این عمل تو عندالله

first_line: This is a Book from Our presence unto him who hath held fast to the Sure Handle in these days wherein eyes are blinded [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من لدنا الی الذی تمسک بالعروه الوثقی فی هذه الایام التی فیها عمت الابصار

first_line: A remembrance unto him who hath attained unto My days, turned towards My sanctuary and voiced My praise, that he may rejoice in the bounties of his Lord, the Mighty, the All-Wise [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ذکری لمن فاز بایامی و اقبل الی شطری و نطق بثنائی لیفرح بعنایات ربه العزیز الحکیم

first_line: This is an epistle from the Lord of Names unto him who hath quaffed, in His path, the cup of destiny, that he may soar upon twin wings [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من لدن مالک الاسماء الی الذی شرب فی سبیله کاس القضا لیطیر بجناحین

first_line: Say: verily Bahá doth not await the beginning of whatsoever tribulation hath been ordained for Him, nor doth He seek deliverance, and He saith: "O my God!" [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قل ان البهاء لاینتظر البدآء فیما قضی له من البلا و لایطلب الفرج و یقول یا الهی

first_line: God hath heard thy mention and thy praise, then thy call. He, verily, heareth whatsoever proceedeth from the tongues of His loved ones, and He is the Best [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قد سمع الله ذکرک و ثنائک ثم ندائک انه یسمع ما یخرج من السن احبائه و انه خیر

first_line: Verily, in the departure of the Ancient Beauty from the Land of Mystery and His entrance into the Most Great Prison are signs unto the nations [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان فی خروج جمال القدم من ارض السر و دخوله فی الحبس الاعظم لایات للامم

first_line: ...O My brother! How great, how very great, can the law of obligatory prayer be, when, through His mercy and loving kindness
Blessed is he who hath turned toward the Most Great Ocean, every drop whereof proclaimeth that He is the God of the heavens and of the earth [3.5s]
first_line_orig: طوبی لمن اقبل الی البحر الاعظم الذی کل قطره منه ینادی انه اله السموات و الارضین

first_line: It is hereby submitted that Thou didst request the text of the petition of the honoured Manekji Sahib, in the dispatch whereof there occurred a delay [3.5s]
first_line_orig: عرض میشود این که صورت عریضه جناب مانکجی صاحب را خواستید در ارسال آن توقف رفت

first_line: Hearken thou to My call from the direction of the Prison, that the call of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, may draw thee to the Dawning-Place of His most beauteous Names [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان استمع ندائی عن جهه السجن لیجذبک ندآء ربک الرحمن الی مطلع اسمائه الحسنی

first_line: This is a Book from God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting, unto him who seeketh his Lord and hath borne in His path what none before him did bear [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من لدی الله المهیمن القیوم لمن اراد ربه و حمل فی سبیله ما لاحمله السابقون

first_line: Say: O Concourse of Creation! By God, the True One, the Glory hath come unto you to purify you from selfish desire and draw you nigh unto God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: قل یا ملاء الانشاء تالله الحق قد جائکم البها لیطهرکم عن الهوی و یقربکم الی الله

first_line: All praise be to the one true God Who hath assisted His loved ones to observe the Fast and hath aided them to fulfill that which hath been decreed in the Book
O Husayn! This is not a day of sorrow. Rejoice thou amidst the concourse of the worlds, then soar aloft upon two wings [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا حسین لیس الیوم یوم الاحزان ان استبشر بین ملا الاکوان ثم اصعد بجناحین

first_line: O seeker! The Sought One calleth thee and saith: Cast all else behind thee, then quaff the wine of inner meaning [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا طالب ان المطلوب ینادیک و یقول دع الوری عن وراک ثم اشرب حمیا المعانی

first_line: Verily, We make mention of him who hath turned unto God and laid fast hold on the Most Firm Handle which We have manifested through this Most Great Name [3.5s]
first_line_orig: انا نذکر من اقبل الی الله و تمسک بالعروه الوثقی التی اظهرناها بهذا الاسم العظیم

first_line: O Joseph! The Wronged One counseleth thee to embrace the shining Faith and the resplendent Law. We beseech God, exalted be He [3.5s]
first_line_orig: یا یوسف ان المظلوم یوصیک بالمله البیضاء و الشریعه الغراء نسئل الله تعالی

first_line: God hath willed thine exodus from the Land of Mystery, lest thou shouldst hear the Great Terror in those days when the ungodly seized control [3.5s]
first_line_orig: و قد اراد الله خروجک من ارض السر لئلا تسمع فزع الاکبر فی ایام التی اخذ المشرکون

first_line: O Dhabih! Forget not the bounty of thy Lord, and turn not unto tribulation. By My life, through it hath My Cause been exalted throughout the ages [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا ذبیح لاتنس فضل ربک و لاتلتفت الی البلا لعمری به علا امری فی القرون

first_line: The letter from that handmaiden of God arrived at a time when, owing to the sorrows that had descended, the divine fragrances were cut off and the pen was stilled from motion [3.5s]
first_line_orig: نامه آن امه الله رسید در حینیکه از احزان وارده نفحات الهیه مقطوع و قلم از حرکت

first_line: Hearken thou unto the melody of Glory in the ocean of faithfulness, if ye be of them that are steadfast, and turn not unto anyone [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان استمعی تغنی البهاء فی طمطام الوفا ان کنتم من القانتات و لا تلتقی الی احد

first_line: O Ahmad! We have indeed made mention of thee aforetime and have shown thee the manifest and straight path of God [3.5s]
first_line_orig: ان یا احمد قد ذکرناک من قبل و عرفناک سبیل الله الواضح المستقیم

first_line: We bear witness, even as God Himself hath testified, that there is none other God but Him, in acknowledgment of His oneness and in recognition of His singleness and grandeur [3.5s]
first_line_orig: انا نشهد بما شهد الله انه لا اله الا هو اقرارا بوحدانیته و اعترافا بفردانیته و عظمته

first_line: This is a Book from before Bahá unto one among the handmaidens of God, that the melodies of her Lord may attract her and draw her nigh unto her Creator [3.5s]
first_line_orig: هذا کتاب من لدی البهاء الی امه من اماء الله لتجذبها نغمات ربها و تقربها الی موجدها

first_line: O My handmaiden! Hearken unto My call from the direction of My Throne, then soar in the atmosphere of My companionship and traverse the kingdoms of My nearness [3.5s]
